import sys, json, uuid, hashlib, datetime, re, time

# >>> content-budget v1 (R-IG-1, GH #1085)
CHARS_PER_TOKEN = 3


def budget_chars(input_soft, share):
    """Characters a producer may hand a model whose usable window is
    `input_soft` tokens (the catalog row, cut by the curator), for a section
    that takes `share` of that window. None when no window is known: the
    producer then delivers its content whole."""
    try:
        soft = int(float(input_soft))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    if soft <= 0:
        return None
    return int(soft * share * CHARS_PER_TOKEN)


def clip(text, limit, hint="budget of the window"):
    """`text` whole when it fits `limit` (None: no limit); else its head and
    a mark naming what was shown, the total and how to get the rest."""
    text = "" if text is None else str(text)
    if limit is None or len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    limit = max(0, int(limit))
    return text[:limit] + "...[cut: %d of %d chars shown; %s]" % (
        limit, len(text), hint)

# THE WINDOW OF ONE MODEL (curator, GH #888; a policy per role, GH #892). This
# cell decides what the model behind the hive sees on every call and keeps the
# record of what it saw:
#
#   * the hot path (`win-hashes` -> `win`): the system part is the `slots` the
#     ledger holds (plus the pins and the tool stubs of the current plan) and
#     the slots of the call's own session it was parked with, sent only when a
#     family changed and then as a `$replace` root -- the families that carry
#     rows of a round (`history`, `pinned`) and those that hold a session's
#     slots (`roster`, `consult`, `instructions`) on every call (GH #925);
#     the messages are
#     the wall after the plan's cover, in `seq` order, over every session
#     (OR-KX-K4), each shown the way the plan says. Deterministic, no model call.
#     Between two rebuilds only the END of the window moves (OR-KX-G4) -- a
#     provider's prefix cache keys on exactly that, so everything that changes a
#     block in the middle (a release, a shrunk tool result, a stub, a pin moving
#     into the system part, an expiry) is decided at a rebuild -- and at one
#     second place: the session boundary (GH #1335, `session_bounds`) frames
#     the person's texts of other sessions, so a block in the middle changes
#     at the first call of a new session and when another session first
#     stands in the wall.
#   * the record: one `calls` row and its `call_blocks` per call, written in
#     the same emission as the call itself, BEFORE the brain has it. A block the
#     window shows in another form than the wall holds it (its short id in
#     front, a one-line form) is a block of kind `view`, so the record names
#     only blocks the ledger holds and rebuilds the request byte for byte.
#   * the tap (`tap`): the usage the brain reported fills that row later, and
#     a stamped `cache_expires_at` orders the clock: ONE standing order per
#     round under an id of that round (`clock_id`), re-armed per call (`add`
#     with `rearm`, GH #904), carrying the call's round to the rebuild it
#     starts (GH #925).
#   * the rebuild (`rb-*`, `sum`): when the cache has gone cold or the prompt
#     crossed a line of the model's package (`input_soft`, GH #1038) -- without
#     one, `compress_at` of the model's own window --, the plan of the window
#     is made anew from the role's
#     knobs (`window_plan`): the segments in the horizon in their tier form,
#     the newest `keep_recent` rounds raw, the model's own releases and pins
#     applied, and -- when the plan is still over `rebuild_to` of the usable
#     window -- old tool results shrunk, unused tools stubbed and the summary
#     given up, in that order. A summary is made by `./summarizer` -- never in
#     the hot path, at most one rebuild per round at a time (OR-KX-K5), and a
#     failed summary leaves the window as it was (OR-KX-K6). A rebuild reads
#     only the rows of the round its call was made in (`rebuild_where`, GH
#     #932 review I-1): the cut, the rows held, the ages, the shrunk results
#     and the aim follow the rows that round may see, and a release or pin of
#     another round is kept in the plan per audience (`marks_on`) but never
#     shapes a window of a round that may not see it.
#   * ONE PLAN PER ROUND (GH #943): the plan, the rebuild lock, the call the
#     clock is armed for, the pending actions, the summary slot and its
#     binding are state keyed by `round_key` -- the first 12 hex digits of
#     the sha256 of the canonical round; a call without a round has the key
#     of `[]`. Why: with one plan per hive, the cut (`cover`) and what was
#     shrunk or stubbed were set by the round whose call started the rebuild,

# THE AUDIENCE GATE (GH #925). Every row of `wall`, `calls`, `marks`,
# `summaries` and `pins` carries the audience of the round that caused it
# (`audience_set`, a canonical JSON array), and a reader hands a row to a round
# iff the row has one and it names `*` or holds the round as a subset -- the
# affinity rule (templates/affinity/README.md, GH #154/#306). The round is
# `context.audience_set` of the message being served: this hive's edges set
# and delete only `cur_*`, so it rides the context through every ledger round
# trip exactly like `cur_origin`, and it is never guessed from a row. These
# functions are the same text in every cell of this hive that writes or reads
# rows; a lock holds them to one table. A ledger read asks the store first
# (`round_where`, GH #932), so a row the round may not see never comes back,
# and the gate in Python stays as the second line.


def audience_of(value):
    """An audience in its canonical form -- a JSON array of strings, sorted,
    no duplicates, no whitespace -- or None when there is none. The round
    arrives as TEXT (a JSON array in a string) and a column comes back as
    text; a list is taken as it is. Absent, empty text, a scalar or
    unparsable text is NOT DECLARED: the empty list is a declared round, None
    is no round at all (affinity `as_set`, GH #306)."""
    if isinstance(value, str):
        if not value.strip():
            return None
        try:
            value = json.loads(value)
        except ValueError:
            return None
    if not isinstance(value, list):
        return None
    return json.dumps(sorted({str(x) for x in value if str(x)}), separators=(",", ":"))


def allowed(round_value, origin):
    """The gate: a row whose audience is `origin` may reach the round
    `round_value` iff both are declared and the origin names `*` or holds the
    round as a subset. A row from before the rule has no origin and never
    leaves (OR-BD-5); a round nobody declared passes nothing."""
    r, o = audience_of(round_value), audience_of(origin)
    if r is None or o is None:
        return False
    o = set(json.loads(o))
    return "*" in o or set(json.loads(r)) <= o


def passes(row, round_value, session):
    """One reader's verdict on one row. With a declared round it is the gate;
    without one, only a row of the running session that declares no round
    either (or names `*`) passes -- the window and the handover keep a
    round-less conversation going and show nothing from elsewhere (OR-BD-4).
    A row of a declared round never reaches a call nobody declared a round
    for, though it stands in the same session (review M-7: the words of {e,b}
    reached a round-less call of that session, and a round-less recall took
    the addendum of an {e,a} gap). A row that names no session never passes
    a round-less read."""
    if audience_of(round_value) is None:
        if not session or str(row.get("session_id") or "") != session:
            return False
        own = audience_of(row.get("audience_set"))
        return own is not None and (own == "[]" or "*" in json.loads(own))
    return allowed(round_value, row.get("audience_set"))


ROUNDLESS = ["[]", "[\"*\"]"]


def round_where(round_value, session):
    """The store half of the audience gate (GH #932): the `where` terms a
    ledger read adds so that only rows this round may see come back -- page
    bounds, `scanned`, window and renewal sizes and turn counts then hang on
    visible rows alone, and a hidden row costs nothing a reader can count.
    With a declared, non-empty round it is `covers` (the affinity rule in the
    store). Without one -- or with a declared EMPTY round, which `covers`
    refuses -- only rows of the running session that declare no round either
    (`[]`, PP-BD-12) or name `*` come back; a row from before the rule (NULL)
    never does. None: nothing may be read at all (no round and no session).
    The Python gate below stays as the second line."""
    r = audience_of(round_value)
    if r is not None and r != "[]":
        return {"audience_set": {"covers": json.loads(r)}}
    if not session:
        return None
    return {"session_id": session, "audience_set": {"in": list(ROUNDLESS)}}


def audience_meet(values):
    """The audience of a row made of other rows (a summary, a handover
    block): the INTERSECTION of its sources, so it can never be wider than
    any of them (OR-BD-3). A source naming `*` is neutral; one source without
    an audience, or no source at all, makes the result None."""
    out, universal = None, False
    for v in values:
        c = audience_of(v)
        if c is None:
            return None
        s = set(json.loads(c))
        if "*" in s:
            universal = True
            continue
        out = s if out is None else out & s
    if out is None:
        return '["*"]' if universal else None
    return json.dumps(sorted(out), separators=(",", ":"))


def meet_of_rows(values):
    """`audience_meet` for a row written from other rows (GH #932, PP-BD-12).
    Since PP-BD-12 `[]` marks a round-less row, which round-less calls of its
    session read; an EMPTY meet is that mark only when every source that
    names no `*` is round-less itself. An empty meet of declared rounds
    ({a} and {b}, or {e,a} and a round-less row) names nobody: None, and the
    row reaches no round -- before PP-BD-12 such a `[]` reached none either."""
    out = audience_meet(values)
    if out == "[]":
        for v in values:
            c = audience_of(v)
            if c is not None and c != "[]" and "*" not in json.loads(c):
                return None
    return out


# The round this message serves (GH #925, OR-BD.A.1): `context.audience_set`,
# read anew at every step and never from a row. Lower case on purpose: the
# pure half is loaded with the upper-case constants and without a context
# (OR-KX-G13).
the_round = ctx.get("audience_set")


def with_audience(row, value):
    """An insert row with the audience of the round `value` in its canonical
    form; a call without a round writes `[]` (PP-BD-12) -- the row declares
    no round, so a round-less read of its own session finds it through the
    store filter (`round_where`), and NULL is left to rows from before the
    rule (OR-BD-5)."""
    aud = audience_of(value)
    return dict(row, audience_set=aud if aud is not None else "[]")


def with_meet(row, value):
    """An insert row with an audience made of other rows (`audience_meet`):
    None there means NOT DETERMINABLE, not "no round" -- the column stays
    NULL and the row reaches no round (OR-BD-5, GH #932 keeps this apart
    from the round-less `[]` of `with_audience`)."""
    aud = audience_of(value)
    if aud is not None:
        row = dict(row, audience_set=aud)
    return row


def _knob(key, default):
    v = P.get(key, default)
    return default if v is None else v


def _int(key, default):
    v = _knob(key, default)
    if isinstance(v, str) and not v.strip():
        return default
    return int(float(v))

HORIZONS = ["day", "task", "all"]
IDENTITY_BUDGETS = ["full", "split"]
TIER_FORMS = ["raw", "summary", "none"]


def unset(v):
    return v is None or (isinstance(v, str) and not v.strip())


def role_named(params):
    """The role an instance runs, `""` for none. An unknown name is said and
    runs as none: a typo must not silently pick another role's presets."""
    role = str((params or {}).get("role") or "").strip()
    if role not in ROLES:
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: unknown role %r -- runs without one\n" % role)
        return ""
    return role


def knob_of(params, key):
    """One knob of `params`: the value set on it, else the preset of its role."""
    params = params if isinstance(params, dict) else {}
    v = params.get(key)
    if unset(v):
        return ROLES[role_named(params)][key]
    return v


def number_of(params, key):
    try:
        return float(knob_of(params, key))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return float(ROLES[role_named(params)][key])


def switch_on(v):
    """One switch (#1370): JSON true, "1", "true" or "on" is on, anything else
    off -- the rule of the presenter's `knob()`. A set writes its switches as
    JSON true (soul2me 0.45 `04-assistant.json`), and `str(True)` is "True":
    a read `== "1"` kept them off without a word."""
    return str(v).strip().lower() in ("1", "true", "on")


def flag_of(params, key):
    v = knob_of(params, key)
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return v
    return str(v).strip().lower() not in ["", "0", "false", "off", "no"]


def tiers_of(params):
    """The tier list: a JSON list or a comma-separated string of forms. A form
    this policy does not know makes the preset stand, and says so."""
    v = knob_of(params, "tiers")
    items = v if isinstance(v, list) else str(v).split(",")
    out = [str(x).strip() for x in items if str(x).strip()]
    if not out or any(x not in TIER_FORMS for x in out):
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: tiers %r not understood -- the preset stands\n" % (v,))
        out = [x.strip() for x in ROLES[role_named(params)]["tiers"].split(",")]
    return out


def horizon_of(params):
    h = str(knob_of(params, "horizon")).strip()
    if h not in HORIZONS:
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: horizon %r not understood -- the preset stands\n" % h)
        h = ROLES[role_named(params)]["horizon"]
    return h


def identity_budget_of(params):
    """`identity_budget` (GH #935): `full` or `split`. Any other value makes
    the preset stand, and says so -- like `horizon`."""
    b = str(knob_of(params, "identity_budget")).strip()
    if b not in IDENTITY_BUDGETS:
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: identity_budget %r not understood -- the preset stands\n"
                         % b)
        b = ROLES[role_named(params)]["identity_budget"]
    return b

# (GH #1038, KF1 review M2/M3). After a `length` continuation the llm cell

# projection of the call (every system leaf and every message), estimated the
# way the llm cell estimates a request before it refuses one over
# `input_hard` (`estimate_tokens`, the token-estimate block below, GH #1098:
# one estimate for every template -- high on purpose). The window of a turn is the smaller of the two: the estimate
# stays above the real count, the sum far above it. And because the cell
# refuses on that estimate, not on measured tokens, `hard` is also due when
# the estimate of the NEXT window -- this one plus the answer -- reaches
# HARD_HEADROOM of `input_hard`: the tenth left over is for what the

# >>> token-estimate v1 (GH #1098)
# The one token estimate of the templates: a request as the llm cell
# estimates it before it refuses one over `input_hard` (`window.rs`
# `estimate_prompt_tokens`) for a model whose catalogue row states no rates
# of its own -- UTF-8 bytes of every string and object key, 4 for a number
# or a bool, over CHARS_PER_TOKEN of the content-budget block (the same
# three bytes a token every budget of the templates is sized with), rounded
# up; a string starting `data:` (an inline image) counts IMAGE_TOKENS, the
# cell's own `llm::window::IMAGE_TOKENS`.
IMAGE_TOKENS = 1024


def estimate_tokens(value):
    """Tokens of `value` (any JSON value) by the rule above."""
    nbytes, images, todo = 0, 0, [value]
    while todo:
        v = todo.pop()
        if isinstance(v, str):
            if v.startswith("data:"):
                images += 1
            else:
                nbytes += len(v.encode("utf-8"))
        elif isinstance(v, dict):
            for k, x in v.items():
                nbytes += len(str(k).encode("utf-8"))
                todo.append(x)
        elif isinstance(v, (list, tuple)):
            todo.extend(v)
        elif isinstance(v, (bool, int, float)):
            nbytes += 4
    return tokens_of_bytes(nbytes) + images * IMAGE_TOKENS


def tokens_of_bytes(nbytes):
    """Tokens of `nbytes` bytes (or characters) of text: over
    CHARS_PER_TOKEN, rounded up."""
    return -(-max(0, int(nbytes)) // CHARS_PER_TOKEN)
# <<< token-estimate v1


def window_of(tokens_prompt, projected):
    """The window of a turn: the measured prompt, unless the policy's own
    projection of the call is smaller -- then the measure is a sum over a
    continuation, and the projection stands. Either alone when the other is
    missing; None with neither."""
    tp = tokens_prompt if isinstance(tokens_prompt, (int, float)) \
        and not isinstance(tokens_prompt, bool) and tokens_prompt > 0 else None
    est = projected if isinstance(projected, (int, float)) and projected > 0 else None
    if tp is None or est is None:
        return tp if est is None else est
    return min(tp, est)


def _price(v):
    """A price of a step as a float, None when it is no number or below 0."""
    if isinstance(v, bool) or not isinstance(v, (int, float)) or v != v or v < 0:
        return None
    return float(v)


def price_steps_of(v):
    """The price ladder off the tap (GH #1431, `hop.price_tiers`): the steps
    with a whole `above_input` of at least 0 and a `cost_in` above 0, each
    with its `cost_cached_in` / `cost_cache_write` when it names one (a
    cached price of 0 is a price), ordered by `above_input`. A step that is
    none of that is left out; no valid step is no ladder ([])."""
    out = []
    for s in v if isinstance(v, list) else []:
        if not isinstance(s, dict):
            continue
        above, ci = s.get("above_input"), _price(s.get("cost_in"))
        if isinstance(above, bool) or not isinstance(above, int) or above < 0 \
                or ci is None or ci <= 0:
            continue
        step = {"above_input": above, "cost_in": ci}
        for k in ("cost_cached_in", "cost_cache_write"):
            c = _price(s.get(k))
            if c is not None and (c > 0 or k == "cost_cached_in"):
                step[k] = c
        out.append(step)
    return sorted(out, key=lambda s: s["above_input"])


def limits_of(usage):
    """The answering model's limits and prices off the tap's usage: a value
    that is no number is absent, and so is one at or below zero -- except a
    cached price of 0, which is a price. The price ladder (GH #1431) only
    when the tap carries one."""
    out = {}
    for k in LIMIT_KEYS:
        v = (usage or {}).get(k)
        if v in (None, "") or isinstance(v, bool):
            continue
        try:
            n = float(v)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            continue
        if n > 0 or (n == 0 and k == "cost_cached_in"):
            out[k] = n
    steps = price_steps_of((usage or {}).get("price_tiers"))
    if steps:
        out["price_tiers"] = steps
    return out

# Review m1 of c3b (OR-d38-3.o15.5): the window a model reported, kept per
# way by the tap beside the bare `context_window` (the last answer's).
WAY_WINDOW_KEY = "context_window:"


def cut_budget(cell, way, st, frozen=None):
    """The budget of a call to `cell` on `way` (GH #1450 Z1.7), one object
    every reader takes its number from: `soft`/`hard` -- a brain call that
    kept its turn's system keeps that system's window; else the catalogue
    row of the cell (`catalog:<cell>`, before the tap's copy of it,
    OR-d38-3.c3b.5); else the tap's state of the way --, `line` the hard
    limit the call is guarded at, the fallback row's when none is known
    (GH #1225, K-3), `rate` the row's `chars_per_token`, else the tap's
    (0 when neither knows one), `target` the role's WINDOW_TARGET.
    The row is read field by field (review o15-R1 M4): a field it lacks is
    the tap's; its `input_soft` is cut to the window the model reported
    (`context_window`), the rule the tap keeps for its own copy (GH #1040
    review M1, review o15-R1 I1 b) -- the window the way's own model
    reported (`context_window:<way>`, review m1 of c3b): the bare key is the
    last answer's, whichever cell gave it; a way that never reported one is
    not cut."""
    row = catalog_row(cell, st)
    with_row = bool(cw_int(row.get("input_soft")))
    tap_soft = st.get(window_key("input_soft", way), "") or st.get("input_soft", "")
    tap_hard = st.get(window_key("input_hard", way), "") or st.get("input_hard", "")
    if frozen is not None:
        soft, hard = frozen["soft"], frozen["hard"]
    elif with_row:
        soft, hard = cw_int(row.get("input_soft")), row.get("input_hard") or tap_hard
        usable = cw_of(st.get(WAY_WINDOW_KEY + way))
        if usable > 0:
            soft = min(soft, usable)
    else:
        soft, hard = tap_soft, tap_hard
    return {"soft": soft, "hard": hard,
            "line": cw_int(hard) or int(FALLBACK_LIMITS.get("input_hard") or 0),
            "rate": (rate_of(row.get("chars_per_token")) if with_row else 0)
            or rate_of(st.get("chars_per_token")),
            "target": WINDOW_TARGET}


# >>> cut v1 (GH #1450, D38 C3b, R-38-4 Nr. 3/5)
# STAGE 2: THE CUT OF ONE CALL. Stage 1 (the plan) is model-free; the cut
# takes the call's blocks to its target's window -- the catalogue row of the
# target cell, else the window known so far -- and never adds one: every id
# it sends is one of the call's blocks, every block it leaves out it names
# with its reason. Pure: no ledger op, no state, the one clock its own
# station time (`cut_ms`, monotonic). The wire (cache breakpoints, dialect)
# stays the llm cell's; `cache_at` is the boundary of the stable prefix --
# the last block before the running round -- for the snapshot only
# (OR-d38-3.c3b.3).
def cut_timed(spent, fn, *args):
    """`fn(*args)`, its time added to `spent[0]` (seconds): `cut_ms` is the
    sum of the cut's own functions, nothing of `win` between them (review
    o15-R1 M5)."""
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        return fn(*args)
    finally:
        spent[0] += time.perf_counter() - t0


def cut(blocks, wall, stages, row, target, budget, current, spent, tools=None):
    """The cut of a call as a record: `blocks` the call's blocks in their
    order, `wall` its wall rows, `stages` the wall positions the window held
    after the render, the hard guard and the way's scope, `row` the target's
    catalogue row ({} without one), `budget` `{soft, target, hard}`,
    `current` the running round `(session_id, turn_id)`, `spent` the
    seconds the cut's other functions took (`cut_timed`), `tools` the names
    the call's tool scope allows (None: no scope). `stages[3]`, when given,
    is the order the wall positions are sent in (after `ambient_first`):
    `ids` and `cache_at` follow it (review o15-R1 M1)."""
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    seq_hash, cur = {}, set()
    for r in wall or []:
        if isinstance(r, dict):
            h = str(r.get("hash") or "") or block_hash(element_of(r) or {})
            seq_hash[int(r.get("seq") or 0)] = h
            if (str(r.get("session_id") or ""), str(r.get("turn_id") or "")) == tuple(current):
                cur.add(h)
    rendered, guarded, scoped = (set(seq_hash[p] for p in st if p in seq_hash)
                                 for st in stages[:3])
    ids, dropped, seen, cur_ids = [], [], set(), set()
    for b in blocks:
        bid, o = str(b.get("id") or ""), b.get("origin") or {}
        if bid in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(bid)
        if o.get("source") == "wall":
            h = str(o.get("hash") or "")
            if h not in scoped:
                dropped.append({"id": bid, "why": "quick_scope" if h in guarded
                                else "overflow_cut" if h in rendered else "not_shown"})
                continue
            if h in cur:
                cur_ids.add(bid)
        ids.append(bid)
    if len(stages) > 3:
        # The wall blocks in the order they are sent; the others keep their
        # place (the system part and the identity stand before the wall).
        rank = {}
        for i, p in enumerate(stages[3]):
            rank.setdefault(seq_hash.get(p), i)
        wall_of = dict((str(b.get("id") or ""), str((b.get("origin") or {}).get("hash") or ""))
                       for b in blocks if (b.get("origin") or {}).get("source") == "wall")
        sent = iter(sorted((bid for bid in ids if bid in wall_of),
                           key=lambda bid: rank.get(wall_of[bid], len(rank))))
        ids = [next(sent) if bid in wall_of else bid for bid in ids]
    mode = row.get("cache_mode") or None
    cache_at = None
    if mode not in (None, "none"):
        before = []
        for bid in ids:
            if bid in cur_ids:
                break
            before.append(bid)
        cache_at = before[-1] if before else None
    return {"target": target, "model": row.get("model") or None, "ids": ids,
            "dropped": dropped, "budget": budget, "cache_mode": mode,
            "cache_ttl_s": row.get("cache_ttl_s"), "cache_at": cache_at, "tools": tools,
            "cut_ms": round((spent[0] + time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0, 3)}


def cut_items(items, wall, plan, fixed, head_el, way, line, current, lead, own, drop=None):
    """The rules of the target over the rendered items of a call, in their
    order (GH #1450 Z1.5): the guard at HARD_HEADROOM of the line `line`
    (`guard_cut`, the oldest whole rounds, GH #1225), then the quick way's
    scope (`quick_items`, GH #1347), then order and frame (Z1.6, R-38-4
    Nr. 3: they move and format, they leave nothing out). Returns the items
    to send, the items before the order (`unmoved`, the bridge filters them
    itself), the guard's `overflow` record (None under the line) and the
    wall positions after each stage for `cut`. `fixed`/`head_el` are the
    system leaves and the identity the estimate counts beside the items;
    `lead` the notes block's text, `own` the person's own words. `drop`
    (D38 V5, None when off) maps the positions the guard and the quick
    filter kept to the positions that leave before the order."""
    stages = [[it[0] for it in items]]
    whole = estimate_tokens({"system": fixed,
                             "messages": head_el + [el for _, el, _, _ in items]})
    overflow = None
    if line > 0 and whole >= HARD_HEADROOM * line:
        items, gone = guard_cut(items, wall, plan_cover(plan, []) if plan else 0,
                                lambda els: estimate_tokens({"system": fixed,
                                                             "messages": head_el + els}),
                                HARD_HEADROOM * line)
        after = estimate_tokens({"system": fixed,
                                 "messages": head_el + [el for _, el, _, _ in items]})
        overflow = {"before": whole, "after": after,
                    "limit": int(HARD_HEADROOM * line), "rounds": len(gone),
                    "from_seq": min([s for g in gone for s in g] or [0]),
                    "to_seq": max([s for g in gone for s in g] or [0])}
    stages.append([it[0] for it in items])
    if way == "quick":
        items = quick_items(items, wall, int(QUICK["keep_recent"]), current)
    stages.append([it[0] for it in items])
    if drop is not None:
        # D38 V5 (review d38_o28-R1 M1, pin gh_d38_pins_c): the recall pairs
        # leave here, behind the guard and BEFORE the order -- `ambient_first`
        # folds a pair of the oldest sent round into the person's words, and
        # dropped behind it the folded quote went twice while the snapshot
        # and the hop named it dropped.
        gone = drop(set(it[0] for it in items))
        if gone:
            items = [it for it in items if it[0] not in gone]
            stages = [[p for p in st if p not in gone] for st in stages]
    # GH #1333 (review I-1/I-2): the ambient pairs move last, on what is sent
    # -- after the guard's cut and the quick filter, so the request still
    # opens with the person's words and the quick way never sees a recall.
    # The bridge filters the unmoved items itself.
    unmoved = items
    keys = round_keys(wall)
    items = ambient_first(items, keys, lead)
    # GH #1335: the session boundary, last and on what is sent -- text only.
    items = session_bounds(items, keys, current[0], session_spans(wall), lead)
    # GH #1337: the person's words framed, last -- text only.
    items = person_frame(items, own, keys, tuple(current), SHORT_IDS)
    stages.append([it[0] for it in items])
    return items, unmoved, overflow, stages


def cut_bridge(unmoved, wall, b_way, current):
    """The window of a bridge (GH #1248), cut where every call is cut
    (review o15-R1 I3): the quick way's scope over the items before the
    order (`quick_items`), no lookups -- a result of an earlier turn is
    content it could repeat as this one's (GH #1260, OR-WG-9, B-L3) --, on
    a consult and a tool round the person's turn alone (`bridge_window`).
    Returns the messages and the wall positions they come from."""
    b_items = quick_items(unmoved, wall, int(QUICK["keep_recent"]), current)
    b_items = [it for it in b_items
               if str(it[1].get("type") or "") not in ("tool_call", "tool_result")]
    msgs = bridge_window(b_way, [el for _, el, _, _ in b_items])
    kept = set(id(el) for el in msgs)
    return msgs, [p for p, el, _, _ in b_items if id(el) in kept]


def cut_tools(way, spec, scope, spec_tools, families, folded, offered, needs, it_now):
    """The tool scope of the quick way's target (GH #1450 Z1.8) and whether
    the call is its tool round: the spec call sees `spec_tools` only, never
    a tool round (GH #1275); a quick call the families' scope (`quick_scope`)
    and, when its stamp needs a tool with no result in the round yet and a
    tool left to call, the required tool round (GH #1260, OR-WG-6: the fast
    model called its tool in 0 of 5 lab turns and 7 of 10 probe calls, 10 of
    10 only when required, lab BL1). Every other way: (None, False)."""
    if way != "quick":
        return None, False
    if spec:
        return spec_cut(scope, spec_tools, folded, offered), False
    q = quick_scope(families, scope, folded, offered)
    tool_round = "tool" in needs and it_now < 1 and bool(q.get("allow"))
    if tool_round:
        q["require"] = True
    return q, tool_round


def cut_scope(way, slim, q_scope, clarify, deny):
    """The `tool_scope` the call sends (GH #1450 Z1.8) as (present, scope):
    the plan's on a brain call, the quick way's own on a quick call, none on
    every other way; a clarify turn asks one question -- no tool, nothing
    opened (GH #1279); while the session's consult runs no speaking call can
    start another one (`deny`, the names the lead denies, GH #1280/#1447)."""
    has, scope = "tool_scope" in slim, slim.get("tool_scope")
    if way == "quick":
        has, scope = True, q_scope
    elif way != "brain":
        has, scope = False, None
    if clarify and way == "brain":
        has, scope = True, clarify_scope(scope)
    if deny and way in ("brain", "quick"):
        has, scope = True, with_deny(scope, names_list(deny))
    return has, scope


def scope_names(scope):
    """The tool names a scope allows, for the snapshot; None = no scope."""
    if not isinstance(scope, dict) or not isinstance(scope.get("allow"), list):
        return None
    return [str(x) for x in scope["allow"]]


def cut_system(leaves, sent, way, slots_failed):
    """The system part a call sends for its target (GH #1450 Z1.9) as
    (system, fams, changed, removed, clear_sent): the families whose hash
    moved against `sent` (the policy's `system_hash_sent`), the gated and
    the session families whole on every call, a quick call its whole tree,
    a consult none; `clear_sent` = the caller clears `system_hash_sent`
    (the state stays the policy's, the cut is pure)."""
    fams = family_hashes(leaves)
    changed = sorted(f for f in fams if sent.get(f) != fams[f])
    removed = sorted(f for f in sent if f not in fams)
    if slots_failed:
        # The slots are unknown, not gone: the model keeps the families it
        # holds; only the gated ones go whole below, as on every call.
        changed, removed = [], []
    system, clear_sent = {}, False
    for f in changed:
        system[f] = family_node(f, leaves)
    for f in removed:
        system[f] = {"$replace": True}
    # THE GATED FAMILIES GO WHOLE, ON EVERY CALL (GH #925, review I-2). The
    # model's `llm` keeps ONE system tree, and it answers a call with what
    # that call's message left in it. Two calls of two rounds overlap (two
    # channels of one brain): each reads `system_hash_sent` before the
    # other's `done` lands, so a diff against it lets A's leaf -- a summary
    # only A's round may see -- stand when B is answered. A state keyed per
    # round alone would not close that: B still reads it before A writes it.
    # So the families that carry rows of other rounds are sent in every call
    # as their whole `$replace` root, empty when the round sees nothing; the
    # same leaves are the same text, so the provider's prefix cache stays.
    # The families that hold a session's slots go whole for the same reason
    # (review I-4): the `llm` keeps the legend, the consults and the peer rule
    # of whichever call came last, so each call sends its own, empty included.
    # The other families hold neither and keep the diff.
    for f in GATED_FAMILIES + SESSION_FAMILIES:
        system[f] = family_node(f, leaves)
    if way != "brain":
        # GH #1247: the quick window goes whole (a model of its own, or the
        # brain without the contract), and `system_hash_sent` is cleared so the
        # brain's next call sends its whole tree again; a consult carries no
        # system part -- cogny answers under its own.
        system = {f: family_node(f, leaves) for f in fams} if way == "quick" else {}
        changed, removed = [], []
        if way == "quick":
            # Re-check I1 (the class of GH #925): `./quick` is an `llm` of its
            # own and keeps ONE system tree too -- a family this call does not
            # name stands as the last call left it. Sent only with leaves, the
            # summary or the pin of one round stood for the quick turn of the
            # next. So the gated and the session families go whole here as
            # well, empty when the round sees nothing.
            for f in GATED_FAMILIES + SESSION_FAMILIES:
                system[f] = family_node(f, leaves)
            clear_sent = True
    return system, fams, changed, removed, clear_sent

def rebuild_to_of(limits):
    """The aim of a `soft` or `hard` rebuild in tokens, out of the package:
    `input_soft` times `rebuild_to` / `compress_at`. 0 = no aim (no soft
    limit, `rebuild_to` 0)."""
    soft = (limits or {}).get("input_soft", 0)
    if soft <= 0 or REBUILD_TO <= 0 or COMPRESS_AT <= 0:
        return 0
    return int(round(soft * REBUILD_TO / COMPRESS_AT))


def cost_aim_of(limits):
    """The aim of a `cost` rebuild in tokens: `input_soft` times `rebuild_to`
    (OR-HK-25). Lower than a soft rebuild's on purpose: with the soft share
    as its aim (talky 0.35 / 0.5 = 0.7 of soft) the rule fired only at a
    cached price above 23 % of the input price -- never at the usual 10 %
    (KF2 review B2); with this one it is due from 0.7 (talky, consult) or
    0.5 (coding, research) of soft at 10 % and ten turns. 0 = no aim."""
    soft = (limits or {}).get("input_soft", 0)
    if soft <= 0 or REBUILD_TO <= 0:
        return 0
    return int(round(soft * REBUILD_TO))


def step_of(tokens, limits):
    """The step of the price ladder a window of `tokens` falls in (GH
    #1431): the last step whose `above_input` `tokens` exceeds -- the base
    step (`above_input` 0) for any window above 0. {} without a ladder."""
    hit = {}
    if isinstance(tokens, bool) or not isinstance(tokens, (int, float)):
        return hit
    for s in (limits or {}).get("price_tiers") or []:
        if tokens > s.get("above_input", 0):
            hit = s
    return hit


def prices_of(tokens, limits):
    """`(cost_in, cost_cached_in)` for a window of `tokens`: its step's when
    a ladder is stamped (a step without a cached price reads at its input
    price, as the llm cell stamps it), else the stamped `cost_in` /
    `cost_cached_in` as before."""
    lim = limits or {}
    s = step_of(tokens, lim) or lim
    ci = s.get("cost_in", 0)
    return ci, s.get("cost_cached_in", ci)


def _turn_units(window, cached, limits):
    """`turn_cost` times 1e6 (tokens x cents per million): the cost rule
    floors a quotient of two of these, and a division by 1e6 before the floor
    could tip it by one at an exact bound (fix round 1, review M-1)."""
    if isinstance(window, bool) or not isinstance(window, (int, float)):
        return None
    ci, cc = prices_of(window, limits)
    if ci <= 0:
        return None
    c = cached if isinstance(cached, (int, float)) and not isinstance(cached, bool) else 0
    c = min(max(c, 0), window)
    return (window - c) * ci + c * cc


def turn_cost(window, cached, limits):
    """The input of one turn in cents (GH #1431): the fresh part at the
    input price, the cached part at the cached price, both of the step the
    window falls in -- the provider prices a request by all its input tokens,
    cache reads included. None without an input price or a window."""
    u = _turn_units(window, cached, limits)
    return None if u is None else u / 1e6


def write_price_of(tokens, limits):
    """The price of writing a rebuilt window of `tokens` into the cache
    (GH #1431): its step's `cost_cache_write`, else its step's input price --
    the rule of before counted the rebuild at `cost_in`."""
    lim = limits or {}
    w = (step_of(tokens, lim) or lim).get("cost_cache_write", 0)
    return w if w > 0 else prices_of(tokens, lim)[0]


def amortise_after(window, rebuild_to, cost_in, cost_cached_in, limits=None):
    """The turn on which one rebuild has paid for itself: keeping the window
    costs `(window - rebuild_to) * cost_cached_in` a turn more than the
    rebuilt one, the rebuild `rebuild_to * cost_in` once -- the smallest N
    with `(window - rebuild_to) * cost_cached_in * N > rebuild_to * cost_in`.
    None when keeping costs nothing more. With a price ladder in `limits`
    (GH #1431) each side is priced at its own step: the held and the rebuilt
    window, both cached, by `turn_cost`, and the rebuild at the cache-write
    price of the aim's step (`write_price_of`); without one, the rule of
    before, byte for byte."""
    if not (limits or {}).get("price_tiers"):
        keep = (window - rebuild_to) * cost_cached_in
        if keep <= 0:
            return None
        return int((rebuild_to * cost_in) // keep) + 1
    held, rebuilt = _turn_units(window, window, limits), _turn_units(rebuild_to, rebuild_to, limits)
    if held is None or rebuilt is None or held - rebuilt <= 0:
        return None
    return int((rebuild_to * write_price_of(rebuild_to, limits)) // (held - rebuilt)) + 1


def target_aim_of(limits):
    """The aim of a `target` or `day` rebuild in tokens (GH #1272): the
    role's `window_target` times `rebuild_to` / `compress_at` -- the
    proportion a `soft` rebuild keeps to `input_soft` --, never above the
    aim of a `soft` rebuild when the package names one. 0 = no aim
    (`window_target` or `rebuild_to` 0)."""
    if WINDOW_TARGET <= 0 or REBUILD_TO <= 0 or COMPRESS_AT <= 0:
        return 0
    aim = int(round(WINDOW_TARGET * REBUILD_TO / COMPRESS_AT))
    rb = rebuild_to_of(limits)
    return min(aim, rb) if rb > 0 else aim


def curate_mark(window, limits, n=None, next_estimate=0, day_due=False, target_at=0):
    """What a turn's window calls for, as `{mark, rebuild_to}`: `hard` over
    `input_hard` -- or when `next_estimate`, the llm cell's estimate of the
    next window, reaches HARD_HEADROOM of it --, `soft` at `input_soft`,
    `day` when the turn is on another UTC day than the last rebuild of a
    role with a day horizon (`day_due`, GH #1272), `target` at the role's
    `window_target` under soft (GH #1272), `cost` under soft when the cached
    rest over `n` turns (`amortise_turns`) costs more than one rebuild to
    the lower aim of `cost_aim_of` (then `rebuild_to` is that aim), else
    `none` -- and `none` without a window. Without a soft limit only `day`
    and `target` are read: the window, not the model, drives cost and
    latency (GH #1272); both aim at `target_aim_of`, or at the soft aim
    when the role has no target. `target_at` is the lowest window of the
    round since its last `target` order -- the window the rebuild left --
    while the window stayed over the target since: then `target` waits until
    the window has grown by `window_target` - the aim from there (reviews
    I-1, I-3, GH #1272) -- a rebuild that kept the window over the
    target with the rounds it keeps raw would condense next to nothing on
    every turn and break the cache each time; the mark is then `none` with
    `hold` = `target_at`. With a price ladder on the tap (GH #1431, R-38-2
    "UX before price") `cost` never fires while the window is at or under
    the role's `window_target` or held over it: the target sets the size of
    the window, not the price -- a `cost` rebuild in the hold would order the
    aim the `target` rebuild just missed on every turn (fix round 1, I-1)."""
    n = AMORTISE_TURNS if n is None else n
    lim = limits or {}
    rb = rebuild_to_of(lim)
    soft = lim.get("input_soft", 0)
    if isinstance(window, bool) or not isinstance(window, (int, float)):
        return {"mark": "none", "rebuild_to": rb}
    ta = target_aim_of(lim)
    target_due = WINDOW_TARGET > 0 and window >= WINDOW_TARGET and (soft <= 0 or window < soft)
    held = target_due and isinstance(target_at, (int, float)) and target_at > 0 \
        and window < target_at + max(WINDOW_TARGET - ta, 0)
    target_due = target_due and not held
    if soft <= 0:
        # GH #1272: before the abort of a window without a package.
        if day_due:
            return {"mark": "day", "rebuild_to": ta}
        if target_due:
            return {"mark": "target", "rebuild_to": ta}
        return dict({"mark": "none", "rebuild_to": rb}, **({"hold": int(target_at)} if held else {}))
    mark = "none"
    hard = lim.get("input_hard", 0)
    if hard > 0 and (window > hard or (next_estimate or 0) >= HARD_HEADROOM * hard):
        mark = "hard"
    elif window >= soft:
        mark = "soft"
    elif day_due:
        mark, rb = "day", ta or rb
    elif target_due:
        mark, rb = "target", ta
    elif lim.get("cost_in", 0) > 0 and lim.get("cost_cached_in", 0) > 0 \
            and not (lim.get("price_tiers")
                     and (held or (WINDOW_TARGET > 0 and window <= WINDOW_TARGET))):
        cb = cost_aim_of(lim)
        if cb > 0 and window > cb:
            due = amortise_after(window, cb, lim["cost_in"], lim["cost_cached_in"], lim)
            if due is not None and n >= due:
                mark, rb = "cost", cb
    return dict({"mark": mark, "rebuild_to": rb},
                **({"hold": int(target_at)} if held and mark == "none" else {}))


def cost_cents(window, cached, limits):
    """The estimate of a turn's input in cents: `turn_cost` (GH #1431), the
    one price of a turn the cost rule reads too."""
    return turn_cost(window, cached, limits)

def stamp_after(stamp, ms):
    """A stored stamp `ms` milliseconds later, in the form `FMT`; empty for
    a stamp that does not parse (the mark then goes at the next call)."""
    us = epoch_us(stamp)
    if us is None:
        return ""
    return (datetime.datetime(1970, 1, 1, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
            + datetime.timedelta(microseconds=us + ms * 1000)).strftime(FMT)


def names_list(v):
    """A list of names from a list or a comma string, blanks dropped."""
    if isinstance(v, str):
        v = v.split(",")
    return [str(x).strip() for x in (v if isinstance(v, list) else []) if str(x).strip()]


def quick_items(items, wall, keep, current=None):
    """The quick window: the wall without the memory's rows; the running
    round whole -- the person's words and every call/result pair of it --
    and before it the last `keep` elements of the earlier rounds, the cut
    never between a tool call and its result: it moves back to the call of
    every result it would orphan, so an older pair at the boundary stays
    whole. `current` is the call's round `(session_id, turn_id)`; without
    one, or when no element is of it, the newest round of the items.

    GH #1347: `keep` counted over the whole window cut the formulation round
    of three `weather` calls side by side (one question + 3 calls + 3
    results = 7 elements) to its last four: one call and the three results.
    The question and two calls fell out, two results stood without their
    call, and the answer named one or two of the three cities; with the
    whole round the same model named all three (a replay of the formulation
    request)."""
    kinds = {int(r.get("seq") or 0): str(r.get("kind") or "")
             for r in (wall or []) if isinstance(r, dict)}
    # T4-08 (GH #1247): a candidate pair is a `memory_recall` pair in the
    # wall, but no recall -- the quick round keeps it.
    kept = [it for it in items if kinds.get(it[0], "") not in QUICK_NO_KINDS
            or str(it[1].get("id") or "").startswith("call_candidates_")]
    keys = round_keys([r for r in (wall or []) if isinstance(r, dict)])
    rounds = [keys.get(it[0]) for it in kept]
    cur = tuple(current) if current else None
    if cur not in rounds:
        cur = next((k for k in reversed(rounds) if k is not None), None)
    first = next((i for i, k in enumerate(rounds) if cur is not None and k == cur),
                 len(kept))
    before = kept[:first]
    if keep <= 0 or len(before) <= keep:
        return kept
    start = len(before) - keep
    call_at = {str(it[1].get("id") or ""): i for i, it in enumerate(before)
               if str(it[1].get("type") or "") == "tool_call"}
    moved = True
    while moved:
        moved = False
        for it in before[start:]:
            if str(it[1].get("type") or "") != "tool_result":
                continue
            at = call_at.get(str(it[1].get("id") or ""), start)
            if at < start:
                start, moved = at, True
                break
    return before[start:] + kept[first:]


def recall_unneeded(hop, ctx):
    """True when a stamped turn names no `memory` need (GH #1441): a path, no
    `memory` in `needs`, and not a `talk` turn whose stamp is a fallback (A11:
    the route did not judge the needs, so its empty `needs` say nothing)."""
    path = str(hop.get("path") or ctx.get("path") or "").strip()
    if not path or "memory" in names_list(hop.get("needs") or ctx.get("needs")):
        return False
    return not (path == "talk" and str(hop.get("fallback") or "").strip())

# hint stage shows `{op}` alone, and a model that sees no `args` cannot call
# the search (a lab turn asked for the news and made no tool call).

                         else "web,weather")


def family_in(name, names):
    """A tool name (`web_search`) or a family (`web`) among `names`."""
    return name in names or name.split("_")[0] in names


def menu_name(name, folded, menu=()):
    """GH #1346: the entry of the folded menu that carries the tool `name`.
    The `llm` cell matches scope names exactly against the menu it gets
    (`tool_scope.rs`, `matches_name`), and with the fold on an op of a folded
    family is on it only as its family: a stub run stamped `set_timer`, the
    collector had folded `set_pin` and `set_timer` into `set`, and the model
    got `[orga, story_read, weather, web]` -- no timer. A name on the menu
    (`menu`, the call's `tools.*` leaves) or a folded family itself stays; a
    name under a folded family (`folded`, the seam's `tools_folded`, longest
    family first like the collector's `family_of`) becomes that family; any
    other name stands for itself."""
    if name in menu or name in folded:
        return name
    for f in sorted(folded, key=len, reverse=True):
        if name.startswith(f + "_") and len(name) > len(f) + 1:
            return f
    return name


def menu_names(names, folded, menu=()):
    """`menu_name` of every name, stated order, each entry once."""
    out = []
    for n in names:
        v = menu_name(n, folded, menu)
        if v not in out:
            out.append(v)
    return out


def quick_scope(families, scope, folded=(), menu=()):
    """The quick call's `tool_scope` (R-WM-1, the curator owns what is
    visible): the class's tools (`quick_tools`) and the stamp's families,
    inside the channel's own allow when it names one; its deny stays. The
    class's tools stand at the ops stage, a stamped family outside the class
    at the hint stage. Every name is stated as the folded menu names it
    (`menu_name`, GH #1346): what the scope allows is on the menu the model
    gets, as its family or under its own name."""
    scope = scope if isinstance(scope, dict) else {}
    quick = menu_names(QUICK_TOOLS, folded, menu)
    want = quick + [f for f in menu_names(families, folded, menu) if f not in quick]
    allow = want
    if scope.get("allow"):
        allow = [n for n in menu_names(names_list(scope.get("allow")), folded, menu)
                 if family_in(n, want)]
    out = {"allow": allow}
    if scope.get("deny"):
        out["deny"] = names_list(scope.get("deny"))
    # GH #1248 (T4-12, R-WM-1): a family outside the class in the hint form --
    # name, first sentence, `{op}` -- a short menu for the first token.
    out["hint"] = [n for n in allow if not family_in(n, quick)]
    return out

# own) stood in front of every fast answer: the quick voice was asked only

def spec_cut(scope, tools, folded=(), menu=()):
    """The spec call's `tool_scope`: the lead's `spec_tools` (`tools`) only,
    inside the channel's allow, its deny kept, cut with the call's menu;
    never `require`, never the class's `quick_tools` and no hint stage."""
    scope = scope if isinstance(scope, dict) else {}
    want = menu_names(tools, folded, menu)
    allow = want
    if scope.get("allow"):
        allow = [n for n in menu_names(names_list(scope.get("allow")), folded, menu)
                 if family_in(n, want)]
    out = {"allow": allow}
    if scope.get("deny"):
        out["deny"] = names_list(scope.get("deny"))
    return out


def spec_release(held, session, turn):
    """The held answer out, twice: `spec_release` leaves the hive for the
    composite's splitter, `spec_tap` enters `./intake` as `in_llm`, so the
    wall, the episodes and the usage take it exactly like a quick answer."""
    head = dict(held.get("hop") or {})
    head.update({"finish_reason": str(held.get("finish") or ""),
                 "curator_call": str(held.get("call") or ""),
                 "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn, "iter": "0"})
    if held.get("episode_turn_id"):
        head["episode_turn_id"] = str(held.get("episode_turn_id"))
    msgs = [m for m in held.get("messages") or [] if isinstance(m, dict)]
    return [{"header": dict(head, route="spec_release"), "messages": msgs},
            {"header": dict(head, route="spec_tap"), "messages": msgs}]


def spec_mark(cid, session, turn, row, verdict, why, stamp, held=None):
    """One `quick_spec` mark per turn that speculated: when it fired, when
    it was decided, kept or dropped, and why -- and (#1279) what the spec
    call cost, null while its answer is not in."""
    value = {"call": str(row.get("call") or ""),
             "fired_ms": epoch_ms(row.get("fired_at")),
             "done_ms": epoch_ms(stamp), "verdict": verdict,
             "reason": why,
             "cost": ((held or {}).get("hop") or {}).get("cost")}
    if held and not held.get("answer") and held.get("finish"):
        # GH #1382: a spec answer that failed says how (R034 lab run 2: a
        # provider timeout after 3 001 ms read only as `no_answer`).
        value["spec_error"] = {"finish": str(held.get("finish")),
                               "error_code": str(held.get("error_code") or "")}
    return (cid, ins("marks", with_audience({
        "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 7, "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn,
        "kind": "quick_spec",
        "value": canonical(value),
        "at": stamp}, the_round)))


def late_spec_mark(cid, session, turn, call, held):
    """GH #1398 (V1): one `late_spec_discarded` mark for a spec answer that
    came after its turn was decided without it (its row went with the drop):
    discarded, never released, and nothing is sent on it."""
    stamp = now()
    return (cid, ins("marks", with_audience({
        "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 8, "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn,
        "kind": "late_spec_discarded",
        "value": canonical({"call": call, "finish": str(held.get("finish") or ""),
                            "cost": (held.get("hop") or {}).get("cost")}),
        "at": stamp}, the_round)))


def with_shown(sends, text):
    """GH #1432: the model calls of `sends` with the sentence a speculation
    already showed as their own last message, already delivered. Telegram
    round 4 (turns 2 and 5): the first spec sentence went out as a partial,
    the spec call timed out (`handle_ms=6502 first_partial_ms=4833`), the
    stored call -- and in turn 5 the brain after it -- wrote the answer anew
    in other words, and the rim, which cuts only an answer that begins with
    the shown text, sent it whole: the content twice. With the sentence as
    its own words the model writes on from there (on a Claude wire the llm
    cell makes it the note `TRAILING_ASSISTANT_NOTE`, GH #1282). A bridge
    and every send that is no model call stay as they are."""
    out = []
    for m in sends or []:
        head = (m.get("header") or {}) if isinstance(m, dict) else {}
        if isinstance(m, dict) and str(head.get("route") or "") in ("quick", "brain") \
                and not str(head.get("curator_call") or "").endswith("-bridge") \
                and isinstance(m.get("messages"), list):
            m = dict(m, messages=list(m["messages"]) + [
                {"origin": "assistant", "type": "text", "text": text}])
        out.append(m)
    return out


# GH #1432 / #1447: the ledger copy of a shown spec sentence, read by
# `./intake` (`shown_read`); the lead's own row has the same key.
SPEC_SHOWN_KEY = "spec_shown:"


def lead_spec(kind, session, turn, call_, **more):
    """An event of the turn's speculation for `./lead` (GH #1447), whose rows
    (`spec:`, `spec_held:`, `spec_fb:`, `spec_shown:`, `delta:`) live in its
    own store: a spec answer or partial, a stored fallback, a delta stamp.
    The round rides along for the marks the answer (`spec_act`) asks for."""
    return {"header": {"route": "lead_spec", "call": call_}, "messages": [],
            "event": dict(more, kind=kind, s=session, t=turn, call=call_, round=the_round)}


def spec_act(a, call_):
    """GH #1447: what a move of the lead's speculation rows means for the
    ledger and the sends -- the `quick_spec` mark, the booking, the release,
    the stored call (with the shown sentence), the records of a call that
    never goes, the early interrupt's claim."""
    do = str(a.get("do") or "")
    session, turn = str(a.get("s") or ""), str(a.get("t") or "")
    row = a.get("row") if isinstance(a.get("row"), dict) else {}
    held = a.get("held") if isinstance(a.get("held"), dict) else {}
    fb = a.get("fb") if isinstance(a.get("fb"), dict) else {}
    if do == "book":
        # GH #1279: the spec call is booked on arrival like any answer the
        # tap takes -- kept or dropped, its money is spent.
        return [lstore([("h-use", upd("calls", a.get("use") or {}, {"call_id": call_}))],
                       "done", call_, "")]
    if do == "partial":
        # GH #1411 / #1415: the partial of an awaited spec call goes on.
        out = [{"header": dict(a.get("hop") or {}, route="partial"),
                "messages": [m for m in a.get("messages") or [] if isinstance(m, dict)]}]
        if a.get("shown"):
            # GH #1432 / #1447: the first shown sentence, copied to the
            # ledger for `./intake` (the wall, gh1432 pin 6); the lead keeps
            # its own row. `./intake` takes the copy down when it used it.
            key = SPEC_SHOWN_KEY + "%s#%s" % (session, turn)
            out.append(lstore([("p-shown", dict(ins("state", {
                "key": key, "value": canonical({"call": call_, "text": str(a.get("shown"))})}),
                if_absent={"key": key}))], "done", call_, ""))
        return out
    if do == "settle":
        # The awaited decision: keep -- release the held answer; drop -- the
        # stored normal call goes (GH #1432: with the shown sentence).
        keep, why = bool(a.get("keep")), str(a.get("why") or "")
        ops = [spec_mark("s-mark", session, turn, row, "kept" if keep else "dropped", why,
                         now(), held)]
        if a.get("shown_gone"):
            # GH #1432: a kept answer takes the shown sentence down (the
            # ledger copy, see `do == "partial"`).
            ops.append(("s-dsh", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                                  "where": {"key": SPEC_SHOWN_KEY + "%s#%s" % (session, turn)}}))
        if keep:
            # GH #1279: the stored call never went -- its record, its block
            # list, its -esc copy and its projection go with it.
            ops += [(c.replace("u", "f", 1), o) for c, o in
                    unsent_ops("s-u", sends_calls(fb.get("sends")))]
        sends = spec_release(held, session, turn) if keep else list(fb.get("sends") or [])
        if not keep and a.get("s_text"):
            sends = with_shown(sends, str(a.get("s_text")))
        if not keep:
            ops += horizon_go(fb)
            sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: spec answer of turn %s dropped (%s) -- the stored"
                             " call goes\n" % (turn, why))
        return [lstore(ops, "done", call_, "")] + sends
    if do == "discard":
        ops = [spec_mark("h-mark", session, turn, row, "dropped", "no_answer", now(), held)] \
            if a.get("mark") else []
        if a.get("late"):
            ops.append(late_spec_mark("h-late", session, turn, call_, held))
        return [lstore(ops, "done", call_, "")]
    if do == "unsent":
        ops = unsent_ops("s-u", sends_calls(fb.get("sends")))
        return [lstore(ops, "done", call_, "")] if ops else []
    if do == "fb_go":
        ops = horizon_go(fb)
        return ([lstore(ops, "done", call_, "")] if ops else []) + list(fb.get("sends") or [])
    if do == "delta":
        mine = a.get("mine") if isinstance(a.get("mine"), dict) else {}
        d_stamp = now()
        if a.get("won"):
            return [lstore([delta_mark("d-mark", session, turn, call_, "reused", d_stamp)]
                           + horizon_go(mine), "done", call_, "")] + list(mine.get("sends") or [])
        ops = unsent_ops("d-u", sends_calls(mine.get("sends")))
        out = []
        if fb:
            out = list(fb.get("sends") or [])
            ops += horizon_go(fb)
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: the delta call %s of turn %s lost its row (%r) -- never"
                         " sent\n" % (call_, turn, str(a.get("lost") or "none")))
        return [lstore(ops + [delta_mark("d-mark", session, turn, call_, "refired", d_stamp,
                                         "lost")], "done", call_, "")] + out
    if do == "ie":
        ds_turn = turn
        ie_at = now()
        if a.get("skip"):
            # A crisis question with no call to send it to, or on a stamp that
            # is no judgement of the text (GH #1407): no early interrupt (the
            # guard at the turn's end stays the net), one ledger line.
            sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: an early interrupt of turn %r skipped (%s)\n"
                             % (ds_turn, a.get("skip")))
            return [lstore([("ie-skip", ins("marks", with_audience({
                "seq": epoch_us(ie_at) + 12, "session_id": str(a.get("session") or ""),
                "turn_id": ds_turn, "kind": "interrupt_skipped",
                "value": canonical({"reason": str(a.get("skip"))}), "at": ie_at},
                the_round)))], "done", "", "")]
        ie_msg = a.get("msg") if isinstance(a.get("msg"), dict) else {}
        if audience_of(the_round) is not None:
            ie_msg = dict(ie_msg, header=dict(ie_msg.get("header") or {},
                                              audience_set=audience_of(the_round)))
        # The claim of the turn's one early interrupt; it leaves in `ie-send`
        # only where the claim took. Its time and the words of the partial
        # are booked at the turn's end (`ie-close`).
        ie_key = INTERRUPT_KEY + ds_turn
        return [lstore([("ie-claim", dict(ins("state", {"key": ie_key, "value": canonical({
            "at": ie_at, "delta_n": int(a.get("delta_n") or 0), "parked_at": ie_at})}),
            if_absent={"key": ie_key}))], "ie-send", "", canonical(ie_msg))]
    sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: a spec act %r it does not know -- dropped\n" % do)
    return []

def with_deny(scope, deny):
    """A speaking call's `tool_scope` with the names the lead's verdict denies
    while a consult is pending (GH #1280, GH #1447 `deny`): the channel's own
    allow and deny kept; a scope whose `allow` does not hold the consult tool
    has nothing to take away and stays as it is."""
    out = dict(scope) if isinstance(scope, dict) else {}
    if not deny or ("allow" in out and not family_in(deny[0], names_list(out.get("allow")))):
        return scope
    have = names_list(out.get("deny"))
    out["deny"] = have + [n for n in deny if n not in have]
    return out

# >>> speaker v1 (GH #1248, T4-10)
# AFTER A TOOL RESULT THE CURATOR NAMES THE SPEAKER. A quick round that
# called a tool keeps the quick voice only while the result can be spoken as
# it is: every tool call of the turn has its result (no open gap), the newest
# result is neither empty nor an error, and the round is within
# `quick_max_iter` iterations. Anything else goes to the brain, with ONE
# `escalate` mark that says why (`iterations`, `gap`, `unspeakable`), and the
# turn stays with the brain for the rest of its round (state
# `escalated:<session>` = the turn).


def knob_int(name, default):
    """A number knob: the param, else the literal beside it."""
    v = P.get(name)
    try:
        return default if unset(v) else int(str(v))
    except ValueError:
        return default




def is_error_result(text):
    """A tool result nobody can speak as it is: empty, or an error object as
    its text -- read off its structure, never its words. A result that failed
    in plain prose is named by the collector's `tool_errors` slot instead
    (#1279, `failed_ids`)."""
    t = str(text or "").strip()
    if not t:
        return True
    try:
        v = json.loads(t)
    except Exception:
        return False
    return isinstance(v, dict) and bool(v.get("error") or v.get("error_code"))


def failed_ids(slot):
    """GH #1279: the call ids of this iteration's tool results that came
    back with an `error_code` in their header -- the collector's `tool_errors`
    slot of the curate (`{tool_call_id: error_code}`), parked with the call by
    `./intake`. Only this iteration's codes travel there, so a later, healthy
    turn is never read as failed. A malformed slot names nothing."""
    if not isinstance(slot, dict):
        return set()
    return {str(k) for k, v in slot.items() if str(k) and str(v or "").strip()}


def speaker(way, it, wall, turn, failed=frozenset()):
    """(way, reason) of a call: before any tool result (`it` 0) and off the
    quick way nothing changes; after one, quick only for a speakable result --
    never after a result the collector named failed (`failed`), whatever
    its words are."""
    if way != "quick" or it < 1:
        return way, ""
    calls, results, last = set(), set(), None
    mine = [r for r in (wall or []) if isinstance(r, dict)
            and str(r.get("turn_id") or "") == turn
            and str(r.get("kind") or "") not in QUICK_NO_KINDS]
    for r in sorted(mine, key=lambda r: int(r.get("seq") or 0)):
        el = element_of(r)
        if not isinstance(el, dict):
            continue
        if el.get("type") == "tool_call":
            calls.add(str(el.get("id") or ""))
        elif el.get("type") == "tool_result":
            results.add(str(el.get("id") or ""))
            last = el
    if calls - results:
        return "brain", "gap"
    if last is None or failed or is_error_result(last.get("text")):
        return "brain", "unspeakable"
    return "quick", ""


def tool_failed(wall, turn, failed=frozenset()):
    """GH #1279: whether a tool of this iteration failed -- named by the
    collector's `tool_errors` slot (`failed`, prose or not), or the newest
    tool result of the turn is an error object as its text; never an empty
    one alone. Such a turn leaves the quick voice for the brain with the
    note `TOOL_ERROR_NOTE`."""
    if failed:
        return True
    last = None
    mine = [r for r in (wall or []) if isinstance(r, dict)
            and str(r.get("turn_id") or "") == turn]
    for r in sorted(mine, key=lambda r: int(r.get("seq") or 0)):
        el = element_of(r)
        if isinstance(el, dict) and el.get("type") == "tool_result":
            last = el
    if last is None:
        return False
    return bool(str(last.get("text") or "").strip()) and is_error_result(last.get("text"))

# THE QUICK VOICE'S OWN PROMPT AND ITS MOMENT. A slot `instructions.quick`
# (a set renders its quick prompt there) is the quick voice's instructions
# with `quick_instructions_slot` "1": on a call of `./quick` (the quick way, a
# spec call, a bridge) it stands in for the other leaves of `instructions`
# (the brain's prompt) and for the fixed leaf `QUICK_TEXT`, the sidecar
# contract and the session's own slots kept; "0" (the default) leaves the
# quick voice's leaves as they were. The brain never gets the slot, switch or
# not -- it reads the whole family. `frame` -- now and place -- is a slot of the quick
# voice only when `place` or `timezone` names one.
QUICK_SLOT = switch_on(P.get("quick_instructions_slot"))
FRAME_PATH = "frame"
FRAME_HEAD = "[now and place -- facts of this moment, not something the person said]"
PLACE = str(P.get("place") or "").strip()
TIMEZONE = str(P.get("timezone") or "").strip()


def of_quick_slot(path):
    return path == QUICK_LEAF or path.startswith(QUICK_LEAF + ".")


def without_quick_slot(leaves):
    """The brain's leaves: never `instructions.quick` (it reads the whole
    family, so the slot would be its prompt too)."""
    return [x for x in leaves if not of_quick_slot(x[0])]


def quick_leaves(leaves):
    """The leaves of a call of `./quick`: with the slot `instructions.quick`
    the other leaves of `instructions` go, except the sidecar contract and
    the session's own slots; without it, or with `quick_instructions_slot`
    off, the leaves as they are."""
    if not QUICK_SLOT or not any(of_quick_slot(x[0]) for x in leaves):
        return leaves
    return [x for x in leaves if not in_family(x[0], "instructions") or of_quick_slot(x[0])
            or in_family(x[0], CONTRACT_PATH) or session_bound(x[0])]


def frame_text(stamp):
    """The facts of `frame`: the call's own stamp in `timezone` (UTC when it
    names none or one this python does not know) and `place`."""
    lines = [FRAME_HEAD]
    us = epoch_us(stamp)
    if us is not None:
        # wall-clock: timezone -- the call's stamp, read once by `now()`.
        at = datetime.datetime(1970, 1, 1, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc) \
            + datetime.timedelta(microseconds=us)
        zone = "UTC"
        if TIMEZONE:
            try:
                import zoneinfo
                at, zone = at.astimezone(zoneinfo.ZoneInfo(TIMEZONE)), TIMEZONE
            except Exception:
                sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: timezone %r unknown -- UTC\n" % TIMEZONE)
        lines.append("now: %s, %s (%s)" % (at.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), at.strftime("%A"), zone))

def with_frame(leaves, stamp):

    without `place` and `timezone`."""

        return leaves

    return sorted(leaves + [(FRAME_PATH, text, block_hash({"path": FRAME_PATH, "text": text}))],

def person_of(round_value):
    """The one person of the round (its entry that is no `agent:`); empty
    when the round names none or more than one."""
    people = [x for x in loads(audience_of(round_value) or "[]", [])
              if not str(x).startswith("agent:")]
    return str(people[0]) if len(people) == 1 else ""


def clarify_pair(wall, row, session, turn, path, round_value):
    """`(args, why)` of the affinity proposal of a clarify pair: the
    assistant's final answer to the clarify turn (its sidecar block left out)
    and the person's words of this turn; args None and the reason when one of
    them is missing."""
    asked_turn = str(row.get("turn") or "")
    mine = sorted([r for r in wall or [] if isinstance(r, dict)
                   and str(r.get("session_id") or "") == session],
                  key=lambda r: int(r.get("seq") or 0))
    question, answer = "", []
    for r in mine:
        el = element_of(r) or {}
        if el.get("type") != "text":
            continue
        kind, rt = str(r.get("kind") or ""), str(r.get("turn_id") or "")
        if kind == "assistant" and int(r.get("final") or 0) == 1 and rt == asked_turn:
            question = stripped_text(str(el.get("text") or "")).strip()
        elif kind == "user" and rt == turn and str(el.get("text") or "").strip():
            answer.append(str(el.get("text") or "").strip())
    who = person_of(round_value)
    if not question:
        return None, "no_question"
    if not who:
        return None, "no_person"
    return {"op": "propose",
            "id": "clarify:" + str(uuid.uuid5(NAMESPACE, "%s#%s" % (session, asked_turn))),
            "source_ref": "curator:clarify:%s#%s" % (session, asked_turn),
            "entity_ref": who, "field_path": CLARIFY_FIELD,
            "value": {"question": question, "answer": "\n".join(answer), "class": path,
                      "session_id": session, "asked_turn": asked_turn,
                      "answered_turn": turn}}, ""


def clarify_bundle(session, c_raw, args, turn, put_ops):
    """The pair's own bundle: the row taken by its key and the value read --
    the proposal leaves only when this chain took it (phase `clarify-pair`),
    so a clarify turn is proposed exactly once; a new clarify turn's row is
    put after the take, never before it."""
    msg = None
    if args is not None:
        msg = {"header": {"route": "propose", "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn},
               "messages": [{"origin": "assistant", "type": "tool_call",
                             "id": "clarify-" + str(args["value"]["asked_turn"]),
                             "text": canonical(args)}]}
        if audience_of(the_round) is not None:
            msg["header"]["audience_set"] = audience_of(the_round)
    return lstore([("c-del", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                              "where": {"key": CLARIFY_KEY + session, "value": c_raw}})]
                  + list(put_ops), "clarify-pair", "", canonical(msg) if msg else "")


def usage_fields(u):
    """The `calls` columns of a model answer's usage, as the tap books them
    (`cost` as its JSON text, anything else no cost)."""
    fields = {}
    for k in ("model", "tokens_prompt", "tokens_completion", "tokens_cached",
              "tokens_cache_write", "cost", "cache_expires_at"):
        if u.get(k) is not None:
            fields[k] = u.get(k) if k != "cache_expires_at" else str(u.get(k))
    if "cost" in fields:
        c = fields.pop("cost")
        try:
            if not isinstance(c, bool):
                fields["cost"] = canonical(c if isinstance(c, (int, float)) else float(str(c)))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            pass
    return fields

def horizon_defaults(v):
    """`horizon_defaults_ms`: family -> milliseconds, a JSON text or an
    object; a value that is no positive number is said and left out."""
    if isinstance(v, str):
        try:
            v = json.loads(v or "{}")
        except ValueError:
            sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: horizon_defaults_ms is no JSON object -- {}\n")
            v = {}
    out = {}
    for k, x in (v.items() if isinstance(v, dict) else []):
        try:
            ms = int(x)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            ms = 0
        if ms > 0 and not isinstance(x, bool):
            out[str(k)] = ms
        else:
            sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: horizon_defaults_ms[%r] = %r is no positive"
                             " number of ms -- left out\n" % (k, x))
    return out


def horizon_quantile_of(v):
    """`horizon_quantile`: 51..100; anything else is said and read as 75 --
    never the median (A9)."""
    try:
        q = int(str(v if v is not None else "75").strip())
    except ValueError:
        q = 0
    if not 50 < q <= 100:
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: horizon_quantile %r is not in 51..100 -- 75\n" % (v,))
        q = 75
    return q


HORIZON_DEFAULTS = horizon_defaults(P.get("horizon_defaults_ms")) if HORIZON_ADVISE else {}
HORIZON_QUANTILE = horizon_quantile_of(P.get("horizon_quantile")) if HORIZON_ADVISE else 75


def quantile_ms(values, q):
    """The nearest-rank `q`-th percentile of `values` (ms), None for none."""
    vs = sorted(int(x) for x in values or []
                if isinstance(x, (int, float)) and not isinstance(x, bool) and x >= 0)
    if not vs:
        return None
    return vs[max(0, -(-q * len(vs) // 100) - 1)]


def horizon_plan(families, rounds):
    """`(family, ms)` of a horizon turn: per family the quantile of its
    booked rounds, else its default; the longest wins. `ms` None when no
    family has either (nothing is said, the round is still booked under the
    first family)."""
    best = None
    for f in families:
        booked = rounds.get(f) if isinstance(rounds, dict) else None
        ms = quantile_ms(booked, HORIZON_QUANTILE) if isinstance(booked, list) else None
        if ms is None:
            ms = HORIZON_DEFAULTS.get(f)
        if ms is not None and (best is None or ms > best[1]):
            best = (f, ms)
    return best or (families[0] if families else "", None)
def horizon_go(stored):
    """The horizon ops (`horizon_sent` mark, turn row) a stored call carries
    (GH #1400): written only when its sends go."""
    ops = (stored or {}).get("horizon_ops") if isinstance(stored, dict) else None
    return [tuple(o) for o in ops or [] if isinstance(o, list) and len(o) == 2]

# THE FACT COMES STRAIGHT FROM THE TOOL. On the phone (d53 battery round 1,
# DIAG-A B-P2-1) the fact of a tool turn came out of the SECOND model round:
# tool_result -> start of round 2 took 77-327 ms, then the model wrote its
# answer and the sidecar in 2 774-6 675 ms, and only the splitter's `sidecar
# section fact` reached the voice -- although `tools/weather` hands back its
# finished sentence as `summary`. Once (01-P2) the model wrote `context`
# instead and no fact came at all (B-P4-4). `fact_from_tool` names tools or
# families (`weather`, `web_search`): the first tool result of a duplex
# call's turn from a listed tool whose JSON carries a non-empty `summary`
# leaves at once as ONE `live_feed` with `hop.section` `fact`,
# `hop.fact_source` "tool" and the summary as `payload` -- the body the
# splitter's sidecar has. Round 2 still runs for the answer; the voice drops
# a later `fact` of the same `hop.turn_id` (`fact_deduped`). At most one per
# turn: the claim `pending:fact_tool:<session>#<turn>` (`if_absent`,
# `parked_at` for the A13 sweep), mark `fact_from_tool {tool}` where it took.
# A failed or error result is never a fact. `""` (the default): nothing read
# or written.
FACT_FROM_TOOL = names_list(P.get("fact_from_tool"))
FACT_TOOL_KEY = "pending:fact_tool:"


def tool_fact(wall, turn, failed=frozenset()):
    """(tool, summary) of the first tool result of `turn` on the wall from a
    tool of `fact_from_tool` that carries a `summary`, or None. A result the
    collector named failed (`failed`) or an error object is never one."""
    names, mine = {}, [r for r in (wall or []) if isinstance(r, dict)
                       and str(r.get("turn_id") or "") == turn]
    for r in sorted(mine, key=lambda r: int(r.get("seq") or 0)):
        el = element_of(r)
        if not isinstance(el, dict):
            continue
        el_id = str(el.get("id") or "")
        if el.get("type") == "tool_call":
            names[el_id] = call_name(el)
            continue
        if el.get("type") != "tool_result" or el_id in failed:
            continue
        name = names.get(el_id, "")
        if not name or not family_in(name, FACT_FROM_TOOL) or is_error_result(el.get("text")):
            continue
        try:
            res = json.loads(str(el.get("text") or ""))
        except Exception:
            continue
        summary = res.get("summary") if isinstance(res, dict) else None
        if isinstance(summary, str) and summary.strip():
            return name, summary.strip()
    return None

    """The state rows of a rebuild with `delegation_park_by_call` "1"
    (OR-d38-3.o15.8): a delegation row of another scope -- a call the rebuild
    never knows -- counts as the session's when its own audience passes the
