            d_why = "memory" if same and dl.get("memory") else ""
            if same and not d_why:
                d_verdict = "reused"
                seam_hop = delta_hop(seam_hop, d_stamp)
                slim["hop"] = seam_hop
                ctx["turn_notes"] = seam_hop["turn_notes"]
            else:
                d_verdict = "refired"
                d_ops.append(delta_mark("f-dmark", session, turn, call, d_verdict, stamp,
                                        d_why))
        if d_verdict != "reused":
            _ALSO.append(lead_note("delta_end", session, turn, raw=dl.get("raw")))
            if d_ops:
                _ALSO.append(lstore(d_ops, "done", call, ""))
    if LIVE_FEED and LEAD.get("live"):
        # GH #1279: the turn is a duplex call's -- its tap sends the live feed.
        _ALSO.append(lstore(put("f-live", LIVE_TURN_KEY + "%s#%s" % (session, turn),
                                canonical({"call_id": str(seam_hop.get("call_id")
                                                          or ctx.get("call_id"))})),
                            "done", call, ""))
    if LEAD.get("interrupt_on_delta") and turn and str(seam_hop.get("spec") or "") != "1" \
            and str(slim.get("iter") or "0") == "0":
        # GH #1404: the turn's end (its normal curate) -- an early interrupt
        # of the turn is booked on a read of its claim (phase `ie-close`);
        # nothing here sends one.
        _ALSO.append(lstore([("ie-st", sel("state", ["key", "value"], {"key": {"in": [
            INTERRUPT_KEY + turn]}}))], "ie-close", call,
            canonical({"s": session, "t": turn, "e": stamp})))
    dg_id = str(seam_hop.get("delegation_id") or ctx.get("delegation_id") or "")
    dg_label = round_label(turn)
    dg_scope = delegation_scope(session, seam_hop.get("call_id") or ctx.get("call_id"))
    if dg_id and dg_label and str(slim.get("iter") or "0") == "0":
        # GH #1407: a delegation round opens -- its turn's own path parks
        # until the round's deadline.
        dg_park = {"delegation_id": dg_id, "round": turn,
                   "until": round_deadline(turn), "parked_at": stamp}
        if DELEGATION_BY_CALL:
            # OR-d38-3.o15.8: the park carries the round's audience -- a
            # rebuild knows no call (OR-d38-3.v.25) and tells the row by it.
            dg_park["audience_set"] = the_round
        _ALSO.append(lstore(put("f-dlg", DELEGATION_KEY + "%s#%s" % (dg_scope, dg_label),
                                canonical(dg_park)), "done", call, ""))
    dg_row = loads(state.get(DELEGATION_KEY + "%s#%s" % (dg_scope, turn), ""), {}) \
        if turn and not dg_label else {}
    if isinstance(dg_row, dict) and dg_row.get("delegation_id") \
            and int(dg_row.get("until") or 0) > now_ms():
        # GH #1407: a delegation of this turn is open -- the turn path sends
        # no call beside it; the delegation answers the turn.
        dg_iter = str(slim.get("iter") or "0")
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: call %s of turn %s parks beside delegation %s\n"
                         % (call, turn, dg_row.get("delegation_id")))
        # Review I-2: a park at iteration 0 comes before the spec decision
        # below -- the turn's speculation ends here as at a drop, or its rows
        # (`spec:`/`spec_held:`, no `pending:` rows, the A13 sweep never
        # reaps them) stay with no curate left to decide them.
        dg_srow = LEAD.get("spec_row") if isinstance(LEAD.get("spec_row"), dict) else {}
        dg_held = LEAD.get("spec_held") if isinstance(LEAD.get("spec_held"), dict) else {}
        dg_spec = []
        if LEAD.get("spec_raw"):
            _ALSO.append(lead_note("spec_end", session, turn))
            if str(dg_srow.get("state") or "") in ("fired", "held", "await"):
                dg_spec.append(spec_mark(
                    "f-psmark", session, turn, dg_srow, "dropped", "parked:delegation", stamp,
                    dg_held if str(dg_held.get("call") or "") ==
                    str(dg_srow.get("call") or "") else None))
        emit([lstore([("f-drop", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                                  "where": {"key": "pending:" + call}}),
                      ("f-dpark", ins("marks", with_audience({
                          "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 14, "session_id": session,
                          "turn_id": turn, "kind": "turn_parked",
                          "value": canonical({"delegation_id": str(dg_row.get("delegation_id")),
                                              "iter": int(dg_iter) if dg_iter.isdigit() else 0}),
                          "at": stamp}, the_round)))] + dg_spec, "done", call, "")])
    ft_call = str(seam_hop.get("call_id") or ctx.get("call_id") or "")
    # Review I-1: never in a delegation round (nor any event round, keyed
    # `<turn>~<deadline>~<hex8>`): the voice speaks ONE answer per delegation
    # (`settle_delegation`), the delegation's own; a tool fact there took its
    # place or came twice. Round 2 of the delegation answers, fact included.
    if FACT_FROM_TOOL and turn and ft_call and str(slim.get("iter") or "0") != "0" \
            and not dg_id and not dg_label \
            and str(seam_hop.get("engine") or ctx.get("engine") or "") == "duplex" \
            and str(seam_hop.get("spec") or "") != "1":
        # GH #1407: a tool result is in -- a listed tool's summary is the
        # turn's fact now, not after round 2. It leaves in `ft-send` only
        # where the turn's claim took: once per turn, whatever iteration.
        ft = tool_fact(wall, turn, failed_ids(slim.get("tool_errors")))
        if ft:
            ft_key = FACT_TOOL_KEY + "%s#%s" % (session, turn)
            ft_head = {"route": "live_feed", "section": "fact", "call_id": ft_call,
                       "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn, "fact_source": "tool"}
            if audience_of(the_round) is not None:
                ft_head["audience_set"] = audience_of(the_round)
            _ALSO.append(lstore([("ft-claim", dict(ins("state", {
                "key": ft_key, "value": canonical({"tool": ft[0], "at": stamp,
                                                   "parked_at": stamp})}),
                if_absent={"key": ft_key}))], "ft-send", call, canonical({
                    "msg": {"header": ft_head, "messages": [], "section": "fact",
                            "payload": ft[1]},
                    "s": session, "t": turn, "tool": ft[0], "e": stamp})))
    # F2d: `seam_path`, not `path` -- the leaves below loop over `path`.
    seam_path = str(seam_hop.get("path") or ctx.get("path") or "").strip()
    answered = str(seam_hop.get("consult_id") or ctx.get("consult_id") or "")
    # GH #1447: the way, its reason and the escalation are the lead's verdict;
    # the window checks only what the wall shows (`speak_check`).
    way = str(LEAD.get("way") or "brain")
    is_clarify = bool(LEAD.get("clarify"))
    way_reason = "memory" if LEAD.get("reason") == "memory" else ""
    way_ops = []
    try:
        it_now = int(str(slim.get("iter") or "0"))
    except ValueError:
        it_now = 0
    escalated = str(LEAD.get("escalate") or "")
    esc_detail = {}
    # GH #1279: the tool results of this iteration the collector named
    # failed (`tool_errors` of the curate, parked in `slim`).
    failed_now = failed_ids(slim.get("tool_errors"))
    if ESCALATE in flags:
        # How the tool round ended (and its error) rides behind the reason
        # into the mark (GH #1260, #1352).
        esc_detail = loads(base.partition(":")[2], {})
        if not isinstance(esc_detail, dict):
            esc_detail = {}
    elif LEAD.get("speak_check"):
        way, escalated = speaker(way, it_now, wall, turn, failed_now)
        if escalated:
            _ALSO.append(lead_note("escalated", session, turn))
    # GH #1279: a quick turn whose tool failed goes to the brain with a note,
    # never with the quick voice's words about the failure.
    tool_err = escalated == "unspeakable" and tool_failed(wall, turn, failed_now)
    # GH #1279: the pair of a clarify turn of the session -- at the first curate
    # of the person's next turn (iteration 0, no spec, no escalation) that
    # carries their words; its bundle rides beside every emission from here.
    c_raw = state.get(CLARIFY_KEY + session, "")
    c_row = loads(c_raw, {})
    c_first = it_now == 0 and ESCALATE not in flags \
        and str(seam_hop.get("spec") or "") != "1"
    c_put = put("f-clar", CLARIFY_KEY + session, canonical({"turn": turn, "call": call,
                                                            "at": stamp})) \
        if is_clarify and c_first else []
    if c_raw and c_first and str(c_row.get("turn") or "") != turn:
        c_args, c_why = clarify_pair(wall, c_row, session, turn, seam_path, the_round)
        if c_args is not None and not c_args["value"]["answer"]:
            # No words of the person in this turn (an inner turn): the pair
            # waits for their next one.
            pass
        else:
            if c_args is None:
                sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: clarify turn %s -- no proposal (%s)\n"
                                 % (c_row.get("turn"), c_why))
            _ALSO.append(clarify_bundle(session, c_raw, c_args, turn, c_put))
            c_put = []
    way_ops += c_put
    # (#1275, quick_spec; GH #1447): what becomes of this turn's speculation
    # is the lead's verdict (`spec`) on its own rows, which it moves itself
    # (`lead_writes`); the marks and the sends are the window's.
    l_spec = str(LEAD.get("spec") or "")
    s_raw = str(LEAD.get("spec_raw") or "")
    s_row = LEAD.get("spec_row") if isinstance(LEAD.get("spec_row"), dict) else {}
    s_held = LEAD.get("spec_held") if isinstance(LEAD.get("spec_held"), dict) else {}
    # A spec curate whose delta stamp it reuses is the turn's normal curate
    # now (`delta_hop` took `spec` off the seam).
    is_spec = l_spec == "call" and str(seam_hop.get("spec") or "") == "1"
    spec_wait = None
    spec_fams = []
    s_drop = [("f-drop", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                          "where": {"key": "pending:" + call}})]
    if l_spec == "parked:delta":
        # GH #1279: the turn was called from its delta stamp -- this normal
        # curate parks, and the row (its guard until now) goes in the lead.
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: turn %s was called from its delta stamp (call %s)"
                         " -- no second call\n" % (turn, s_row.get("call")))
        emit([lstore(s_drop, "done", call, "")])
    if l_spec == "parked:decided":
        # The normal curate of the turn came first: it decided alone.
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: spec curate of turn %s after its decision"
                         " -- no call\n" % turn)
        emit([lstore(s_drop, "done", call, "")])
    if l_spec == "parked:called":
        # GH #1279 / #1371: the turn's normal call is given and its row is
        # not this call's own `await` -- this spec curate came after it.
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: spec curate of turn %s after its call"
                         " -- no call\n" % turn)
        emit([lstore(s_drop, "done", call, "")])
    if is_spec:
        # The spec call goes on the quick way, whatever a stamp would say.
        way, escalated, way_ops = "quick", "", []
    elif l_spec == "kept":
        # Kept: the held answer is this turn's answer; no call.
        emit([lstore(s_drop + [spec_mark("f-smark", session, turn, s_row, "kept", "kept",
                                         now(), s_held)],
                     "done", call, "")] + spec_release(s_held, session, turn))
    elif l_spec.startswith("dropped:"):
        s_why = l_spec[len("dropped:"):]
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: spec answer of turn %s dropped (%s)\n"
                         % (turn, s_why))
        # GH #1279: the row went in the lead -- a spec answer still on its
        # way finds no row and is discarded (booked on arrival, M2).
        way_ops += [spec_mark("f-smark", session, turn, s_row, "dropped", s_why, stamp,
                              s_held if str(s_held.get("call") or "") ==
                              str(s_row.get("call") or "") else None)]
    elif l_spec == "wait":
        # A quick turn whose spec answer is not in yet: the normal call is
        # built and stored in the lead, the answer decides on arrival.
        spec_wait = names_list(seam_hop.get("needs") or ctx.get("needs"))
        spec_fams = names_list(seam_hop.get("families") or ctx.get("families"))
    # GH #1447: the errand's mark is the lead's (ended, lapsed or standing).
    pending = LEAD.get("pending") if isinstance(LEAD.get("pending"), dict) else {}
    pending_raw = canonical(pending) if pending else ""
    # Review M1 of F2: the window of THIS call's way. A brain call of a turn
    # that kept its system takes the window that system was fitted to; a
    # way without a window of its own yet takes the brain's, as before.
    frozen = turn_system_of(state.get(turn_system_key(session, turn), ""), turn,
                            the_round) if way == "brain" else None
    # Review o15-R1 M5: `cut_ms` sums the cut's own functions only.
    c_spent = [0.0]
    c_budget = cut_timed(c_spent, cut_budget, cut_cell(way, is_spec), way, state, frozen)
    contract_cap = budget_chars(c_budget["soft"], SIDECAR_SHARE)
    contract_cuts = []
    stubs = set(plan.get("stubs") or [])
    # The round's own summary slot as the leaf `history.summary`, another
    # round's not at all (GH #943, OR-BC.W.2).
    for r in own_slots(rows(lg, "w-slots"), the_rk):
        h = str(r.get("hash") or "")
        b = blocks.get(h)
        el = element_of(b) if b else None
        if el is None:
            continue
        path, text = str(r.get("path") or ""), str(el.get("text") or "")
        if session_bound(path):
            # A session's slot from before review I-4: the call carries its own.
            continue
        if path in bound and (bound[path] is None or bound[path][0] != h
                              or not allowed(the_round, bound[path][1])):
            continue
        if path.startswith("tools.") and path[6:] in stubs:
            leaf = {"path": path, "text": stub_text(text)}
            h = block_hash(leaf)
            views.append((leaf, h, "system"))
            text = leaf["text"]
        if path == CONTRACT_PATH:
            fitted, c_cuts = fit_contract(text, contract_cap)
            if c_cuts:
                leaf = {"path": path, "text": fitted}
                h = block_hash(leaf)
                views.append((leaf, h, "system"))
                text = fitted
                contract_cuts += c_cuts
        leaves.append((path, text, h))
    pins = [p for p in rows(lg, "w-pins") if allowed(the_round, p.get("audience_set"))]
    pinned, tail = pin_split(pins, blocks, plan, now_ms())
    # The slots of this call's session come from its parked turn alone (review
    # I-4), a block of their own each like a pin leaf, so `call_blocks` names
    # what the ledger holds.
    for path, text in session_slots_of(slim) + pinned:
        leaf = {"path": path, "text": text}
        h = block_hash(leaf)
        views.append((leaf, h, "system"))
        leaves.append((path, text, h))
    leaves.sort(key=lambda x: path_key(x[0]))
    if way == "brain":
        # GH #1279: the quick voice's prompt is never the brain's.
        leaves = without_quick_slot(leaves)
    # THE IDENTITY BUDGET (GH #935): `full` drops the `identity_short*`
    # leaves and changes nothing else -- a ledger without them builds the
    # system part of 1.3.0 byte for byte; `split` sends the short form and
    # puts the whole pack first in `messages` as a snapshot.
    # The snapshot state of THIS session (review I-4) holds its element: no
    # block read, and an element that is not the one its hash names is none
    # (`identity_slots` then takes a fresh snapshot -- never the wrong text).
    id_aud = audience_of(the_round) or "[]"
    id_snap = loads(state.get("identity_full:" + session, ""), {})
    id_stored = id_snap.get("element")
    if not isinstance(id_stored, dict) or block_hash(id_stored) != id_snap.get("hash"):
        id_stored = None
    id_key = {"session": session,
              "epoch": window_epoch(plan, session, str(id_snap.get("epoch") or "")),
              "renewed": state.get("renewed_last:" + session, ""), "audience": id_aud}
    ident = identity_slots(IDENTITY_BUDGET, leaves, id_snap, id_key, id_stored,
                           state.get("identity_short_missing:" + session, ""))
    if len(ident["leaves"]) != len(leaves) or ident["full"] is not None:
        leaves = sorted(ident["leaves"], key=lambda x: path_key(x[0]))
        for path, text, h in leaves:
            if path == IDENTITY_FAMILY and ident["full"] is not None:
                # The short form as the `identity` leaf: a block of its own,
                # so `call_blocks` names what the ledger holds.
                views.append(({"path": path, "text": text}, h, "system"))
    # Released as THIS round sees it (review I-1): a release another round
    # said shapes only the windows of rounds that may see it.
    # R-IG-1: the window's own share of the sidecar is measured against the
    # usable window kept in state (`input_soft`), and every block it leaves
    # out is said on the call's hop (`cuts`).
    c_at = len(cuts)
    items = render(c_plan["blocks"], wall, dict(P, input_soft=c_budget["soft"]), plan,
                   (session, turn), tail, round_canon(the_round), cuts)
    # GH #1337: the person's words as `render` left them, for their frame.
    own = own_words(items)
    # GH #1303: the notes block, on the speaking ways only (a consult's errand
    # and a bridge carry none: the bridge of a tool round is built from the
    # quick way's items, and the quick way takes its own share, 0 -- no block,
    # so its words need no frame either, GH #1337 review I-1). The calls of one brain turn show the block of
    # its first call (GH #1298: the person's turn is part of the prefix a
    # signed thinking is bound to); a `turn` note is the turn's that first
    # saw it, shown or not.
    turn_key = "%s#%s" % (session, turn)
    notes_in, notes_out, note_ops, notes_kept = [], [], [], None
    # GH #1335: the block that opens the person's newest message; what moves
    # into that message later goes behind it.
    lead = ""
    if way in ("brain", "quick"):
        if way == "brain" and frozen is not None:
            kept_notes = frozen.get("notes") or {}
            n_block = str(kept_notes.get("block") or "")
            notes_in = list(kept_notes.get("in") or [])
            notes_out = list(kept_notes.get("dropped") or [])
        else:
            # GH #1439: the state line opens the block; beside the handover
            # leaf the line leaves the topic and the promises to it.
            s_text = ""
            if STATE_BLOCK and STATE_LINES > 0:
                s_now = epoch_ms(stamp) or now_ms()
                s_rows = dict((str(r.get("key") or ""), str(r.get("value") or ""))
                              for r in rows(lg, "w-sdlg") + rows(lg, "w-sdlgc"))
                s_rows[ERRAND_ROW + session] = pending_raw if pending else ""
                s_texts = dict((h, str((element_of(b) or {}).get("text") or ""))
                               for h, b in blocks.items())
                s_marks = sorted(rows(lg, "w-stopic") + rows(lg, "w-smarks"),
                                 key=lambda r: -int(r.get("seq") or 0))
                s_parts = ("open", "set_today") if any(x[0] == HANDOVER_PATH for x in leaves) \
                    else STATE_PARTS
                s_age = None
                if TOPIC_AGING and "w-sage" in lg:
                    s_wall = rows(lg, "w-sage")
                    s_age = (s_wall, call_opened_of(next((r.get("value")
                                                          for r in rows(lg, "w-sopen")), "")),
                             len(s_wall) >= TOPIC_AGE_ROWS)
                s_text = state_block(state_of_rows(s_marks, pins, s_texts, s_rows, the_round,
                                                   session, s_now, day_of(stamp), s_age,
                                                   (slim.get("hop") or {}).get("call_id")
                                                   or ctx.get("call_id") or "",
                                                   names_list((slim.get("hop") or {}).get("needs")
                                                              or ctx.get("needs"))),
                                     s_parts, STATE_LINES)
            pool = ([state_note(s_text)] if s_text else []) \
                + live_notes(rows(lg, "w-notes"), the_round, epoch_ms(stamp) or 0, turn_key) \
                + turn_notes_of(ctx.get("turn_notes")) \
                + ([clarify_note()] if is_clarify and CLARIFY_NOTE else []) \
                + ([{"id": "tool_error", "source": "curator", "text": TOOL_ERROR_NOTE,
                     "scope": "turn", "priority": 0, "at": ""}] if tool_err else [])
            n_share = float(QUICK["notes_share"]) if way == "quick" else NOTES_SHARE
            n_block, shown_n, dropped_n = note_block(
                pool, budget_chars(c_budget["soft"], n_share) if n_share > 0 else 0)
            notes_in = [note_ref(n) for n in shown_n]
            notes_out = [note_ref(n) for n in dropped_n]
            for i, n in enumerate(pool):
                r = n.get("row")
                if r is not None and n["scope"] == "turn" and not str(r.get("used_turn") or ""):
                    note_ops.append(("f-nuse%d" % i, upd(
                        "notes", {"used_turn": turn_key},
                        {"source": str(r.get("source") or ""),
                         "note_id": str(r.get("note_id") or ""),
                         "audience_set": str(r.get("audience_set") or ""), "used_turn": ""})))
            notes_kept = {"block": n_block, "in": notes_in, "dropped": notes_out}
        items = with_note_block(items, wall, n_block)
        lead = n_block
        if notes_out:
            cuts.append({"what": "notes", "shown": len(notes_in),
                         "total": len(notes_in) + len(notes_out), "unit": "notes"})
    # GH #1279: the slot `instructions.quick` takes the place of the fixed leaf.
    q_slot = QUICK_SLOT and any(of_quick_slot(x[0]) for x in leaves)
    # GH #1450 Z1.8: the tool scope is the cut's, for its target.
    q_scope, tool_round = cut_timed(
        c_spent, cut_tools, way, is_spec, slim.get("tool_scope"),
        names_list(LEAD.get("spec_tools")),
        names_list(seam_hop.get("families") or ctx.get("families")),
        names_list(seam_hop.get("tools_folded") or ctx.get("tools_folded")),
        set(x[0][6:] for x in leaves if x[0].startswith("tools.")),
        names_list(seam_hop.get("needs") or ctx.get("needs")), it_now)
    if way == "quick" and not is_spec:
        # GH #1260 (OR-WG-6): THE TOOL ROUND carries no contract and no
        # `instructions.quick`: the answer comes in the next round, and the
        # bridge beside it says the sentence.
        if tool_round:
            leaves = [x for x in leaves if x[0] != CONTRACT_PATH
                      and not x[0].startswith(CONTRACT_PATH + ".")]
        else:
            # GH #1260 (OR-WG-2): the contract stays, fitted above like the
            # brain's (`fit_contract`, the window's `SIDECAR_SHARE`) -- a quick
            # answer is an answer and leaves its block for the splitter.
            if not q_slot:
                leaves = sorted(leaves + [(QUICK_LEAF, QUICK_TEXT,
                                           block_hash({"path": QUICK_LEAF,
                                                       "text": QUICK_TEXT}))],
                                key=lambda x: path_key(x[0]))
    if way == "quick":
        # GH #1279: the quick voice's own instructions and its moment.
        leaves = with_frame(quick_leaves(leaves), stamp)
    if pending and way in ("brain", "quick"):
        # #1198: while a consult runs, the speaking model is told so.
        leaves = sorted(leaves + [(CONSULT_PENDING, pending_text(pending),
                                   block_hash({"path": CONSULT_PENDING,
                                               "text": pending_text(pending)}))],
                        key=lambda x: path_key(x[0]))
    if way == "brain" and frozen is not None:
        # GH #1298: the system part stands over the tool rounds of a turn.
        leaves = without_quick_slot(frozen["leaves"])
    elif way == "brain" and turn and not is_clarify:
        way_ops += put("f-tsys", turn_system_key(session, turn), canonical({
            "turn": turn, "round": round_canon(the_round),
            "leaves": [list(x) for x in leaves], "soft": c_budget["soft"], "hard": c_budget["hard"],
            "cuts": contract_cuts, "notes": notes_kept}))
        # Review m3 of F2: every fresh write of the row names it in the
        # session's list of open rows and takes down every row listed
        # longer than `pending_sweep_s` -- a round that ended on a
        # hand-over or lost its answer left it; a turn still running
        # beside this one (two channels of one session) keeps its own.
        # Delta review m5: also the first brain call of an escalated turn
        # (`it_now` >= 1), whose row no first call listed.
        stamp_ms = epoch_ms(stamp) or 0
        open_rows = []
        listed = loads(state.get(TURN_SYSTEM_LAST + session, ""), [])
        for i, x in enumerate(listed if isinstance(listed, list) else []):
            if not (isinstance(x, list) and len(x) == 2) or x[0] == turn:
                continue
            if stamp_ms - (epoch_ms(x[1]) or 0) >= PENDING_SWEEP_S * 1000:
                way_ops.append(("f-tsysold%d" % i, {
                    "operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                    "where": {"key": turn_system_key(session, str(x[0]))}}))
            else:
                open_rows.append([str(x[0]), str(x[1])])
        way_ops += put("f-tsyslast", TURN_SYSTEM_LAST + session,
                       canonical(open_rows + [[turn, stamp]]))
    # Review m1 of F2: the contract cuts of what is SENT -- the kept ones
    # when the system stands -- where they stood before the window's own.
    cuts[c_at:c_at] = frozen["cuts"] if frozen is not None else contract_cuts
    # The guard measures the leaves that are sent (review m1 of F2).
    # THE GUARD AT input_hard (GH #1225, K-2, OR-KF-6). A wall over the hard
    # line of the model -- a day longer than the window before its rebuild
    # came, a rebuild that failed -- was sent whole, and the llm cell refused
    # it (`input_over_hard`): the turn was lost. At HARD_HEADROOM of
    # `input_hard` (the margin `curate_mark` orders `hard` at) the oldest raw
    # rounds beyond `keep_recent` -- whole rounds, never the newest -- leave
    # THIS call until it is under the margin: said on the hop (`cuts`) and
    # as one `overflow_cut` mark; the turn is never refused and never parked.
    # The plan is not touched: the call's projection (`window_est`) keeps
    # the whole wall, so the tap's `curate_mark` orders the rebuild `hard`.
    # GH #1450 Z1.5: the guard and the quick scope are rules of the cut.
    def iw_drop(kept):
        # D38 V5 after the guard (review d38_r1 condition 3), before the order
        # (review d38_o28-R1 M1): the quotes are checked against the raw turns
        # whose rows the cut kept -- the raw text, so a row sent in its
        # released or shrunk form counts as said (review K3, as before the
        # guard). A candidate whose own round the guard cut is the guard's
        # cut, not a `recall_in_wall` (review K1). Dropping a pair only lowers
        # what is sent; `overflow.after` and `window_est` still count it
        # (review K2): conservative, a `hard` rebuild a little early, never
        # over the line.
        k_said = said_hashes(element_of(r) or {} for r in wall
                             if int(r.get("seq") or 0) in kept)
        gone = [b for b in iw_cand
                if w_seq.get(str((b.get("origin") or {}).get("hash") or ""), -1) in kept
                and recall_in_wall(w_el(b).get("text"), k_said)]
        gone_ids = set(str(w_el(b).get("id") or "") for b in gone) - {""}
        in_wall.extend([b for b in c_plan["blocks"] if b in gone
                        or (b.get("kind") == "tool_call" and str(w_el(b).get("id") or "") in gone_ids)])
        c_plan["blocks"] = [b for b in c_plan["blocks"] if b not in in_wall]
        return set(w_seq.get(str((b.get("origin") or {}).get("hash") or ""), -1)
                   for b in in_wall) - {-1}

    items, unmoved, overflow, c_stages = cut_timed(
        c_spent, cut_items, items, wall, plan, [[path, text] for path, text, _ in leaves],
        [ident["full"]] if ident["full"] is not None else [], way, c_budget["line"], (session, turn),
        lead, own, iw_drop if iw_cand else None)
    if overflow is not None:
        overflow = dict(overflow, call=call)
        cuts.append({"what": "overflow_cut", "shown": overflow["after"],
                     "total": overflow["before"], "unit": "tokens",
                     "rounds": overflow["rounds"]})
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: call %s over %d of input_hard -- %d oldest rounds"
                         " left out (%d -> %d tokens, GH #1225)\n"
                         % (call, overflow["limit"], overflow["rounds"], overflow["before"],
                            overflow["after"]))
    if in_wall:
        cuts[iw_at:iw_at] = [{"what": "recall_in_wall", "shown": 0, "total": 1, "unit": "rows",
                              "block": str(b.get("id") or "")} for b in in_wall]
    views += [(el, h, "view") for _, el, h, view in items if view]
    # GH #1450 Z1.9: the system families are the cut's, for its target.
    system, fams, changed, removed, c_clear = cut_timed(
        c_spent, cut_system, leaves, loads(state.get("system_hash_sent", ""), {}), way,
        slots_failed)
    if c_clear:
        way_ops += put("f-sent0", "system_hash_sent", "{}")
    pending_actions = state.get(rkey("actions_pending"), "")
    actions = loads(pending_actions, [])
    if changed or removed:
        actions.append("system:" + ",".join(changed + removed))
    try:
        it = int(str(slim.get("iter") or "0"))
    except ValueError:
        it = 0
    ops = view_ops(views, stamp, blocks)
    # GH #1247 (T4-11): a consult carries the errand, not talky's identity.
    full_el = ident["full"] if way not in ("consult", "research") else None
    # GH #1256: a consult or research call shows no identity (`full_el` is
    # None above), so it takes no snapshot either. Writing one off the
    # missing element killed the policy in phase `win` (AttributeError on
    # the first call of a `split` session) and dropped the errand and the
    # bridge with it: the turn dead-lettered `no_route`, the person heard
    # nothing. The next speaking call of the session finds no snapshot and
    # takes it, as after a rebuild.
    if ident["snap"] is not None and full_el is not None:
        # A new snapshot (GH #935): its block PUT with this call's stamp --
        # always, past the `_VIEWS` cache, so `call_blocks` names a block the
        # ledger holds -- and the state of this session PUT whole, the
        # element in it (review I-4: what the next call of the session sends
        # again is read from there, not off the newest block of its kind).
        fh = ident["snap"]["hash"]
        ops += [block_put("i-bi", fh, IDENTITY_FULL_KIND, len(str(full_el.get("text") or "")),
                          canonical(full_el), stamp)]
        ops += put("i-si", "identity_full:" + session,
                   canonical(dict(ident["snap"], element=full_el)))
    if ident["mark"]:
        # `split` without a short form runs as `full` and says so once per
        # session (GH #935): the mark carries the round, `[]` without one.
        # Its `seq` is one past the call's own (review M-4): a round-less
        # call writes `missing_audience` at `epoch_us(stamp)` beside it, and
        # `marks` has no key to order two rows of one `seq`.
        ops += [("i-miss", ins("marks", with_audience({
                    "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 1, "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn,
                    "kind": "identity_short_missing", "value": call, "at": stamp}, the_round)))]
        ops += put("i-mi", "identity_short_missing:" + session, session)
    ops.append(("f-call", ins("calls", with_audience({
        "call_id": call, "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn, "iter": it,
        "trigger": "curate", "started_at": stamp, "model": "", "tokens_prompt": None,
        "tokens_completion": None, "tokens_cached": None, "tokens_cache_write": None,
        "cost": None, "cache_expires_at": "", "system_hash": block_hash(fams),
        "actions": actions}, the_round))))
    if audience_of(the_round) is None:
        # OR-BD-4: a call without a round says so, once, beside its record --
        # as a row that declares no round (`[]`, PP-BD-12).
        ops.append(("f-noaud", ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(stamp), "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn,
            "kind": "missing_audience", "value": call, "at": stamp}, None))))
    if overflow is not None:
        # GH #1225 (K-2): one mark per call the guard cut.
        ops.append(("f-ovf", ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 2 + len(missing), "session_id": session,
            "turn_id": turn, "kind": "overflow_cut", "value": canonical(overflow),
            "at": stamp}, the_round))))
    if failed:
        # GH #1225 (A3): one mark per call that went without what the store
        # refused, past the seqs of the call's other marks.
        ops.append(store_error_mark("f-err", phase, failed, session, turn, 3 + len(missing)))
    for i, r in enumerate(missing):
        # GH #1225 (K-8): one mark per wall row left out without its block,
        # past the seqs of the call's other marks (`i-miss`, `f-noaud`).
        ops.append(("f-miss%d" % i, ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 2 + i, "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn,
            "kind": "missing_block",
            "value": canonical({"call": call, "hash": str(r.get("hash") or ""),
                                "seq": int(r.get("seq") or 0)}),
            "at": stamp}, the_round))))
    listed = [h for _, _, h in leaves] + [h for _, _, h, _ in items]
    if full_el is not None:
        # The snapshot stands first among the messages (GH #935).
        listed.insert(len(leaves), block_hash(full_el))
    for pos, h in enumerate(listed):
        ops.append(("f-b%d" % pos, ins("call_blocks", {"call_id": call, "pos": pos, "hash": h})))
    if changed or removed:
        ops.append(("f-sent", upd("state", {"value": canonical(fams)},
                                  {"key": "system_hash_sent"})))
    if actions and pending_actions not in ("", "[]"):
        # Taken only if nobody added one since it was read.
        ops.append(("f-act", upd("state", {"value": "[]"},
                                 {"key": rkey("actions_pending"), "value": pending_actions})))
    ops.append(("f-drop", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                           "where": {"key": "pending:" + call}}))
    head = dict(slim.get("hop") or {})
    head["route"] = way
    head["curator_call"] = call
    if tool_round:
        # GH #1260 (OR-WG-9): the required call says it is one. talky lifts
        # `interim` into the context: the dispatcher says no answer of it that
        # carries no call, `./intake` keeps such prose out of the wall, and
        # `tap` gives the round to the brain -- from this copy of its parked
        # turn (`pending:<call>-esc`; `f-drop` takes the call's own).
        head["interim"] = "tool"
    if way == "quick" and not is_spec:
        # GH #1352: every call of the quick voice keeps that copy, not only the
        # tool round's: a quick call that ends without an answer (an error, a
        # content filter) goes to the brain from it in `tap`. Measured in a
        # lab run: the quick voice ran into its
        # `tool_call_limit` (17 calls over the dispatcher's 16), the error left
        # for the drain, and the person got no answer at all.
        ops += put("f-escslim", "pending:" + call + ESC_SUFFIX,
                   state.get("pending:" + call, ""))
    ops += way_ops
    if seam_path:
        # GH #1247 (T4-07): one `route` mark per call that had a path.
        ops.append(("f-route", ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 4 + len(missing), "session_id": session,
            "turn_id": turn, "kind": "route",
            "value": canonical(dict({"call": call, "path": seam_path, "way": way},
                                    **({"reason": way_reason} if way_reason else {}))),
            "at": stamp}, the_round))))
    if LEAD:
        # GH #1447 (R-38-4 Nr. 6): one `lead` mark per call -- the station's
        # handle_ms, for the battery; never a verdict of a test.
        ops.append(("f-lead", ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 16 + len(missing), "session_id": session,
            "turn_id": turn, "kind": "lead",
            "value": canonical({"call": call, "way": way,
                                "handle_ms": int(LEAD.get("handle_ms") or 0)}),
            "at": stamp}, the_round))))
    if escalated:
        # GH #1248 (T4-10): one `escalate` mark per call the quick voice gave
        # up, with the reason.
        ops.append(("f-escm", ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 5 + len(missing), "session_id": session,
            "turn_id": turn, "kind": "escalate",
            "value": canonical(dict({"call": call, "path": seam_path, "from": "quick",
                                     "to": "brain", "reason": escalated, "iter": it_now},
                                    **{k: str(v) for k, v in esc_detail.items()
                                       if k in ("finish", "error") and v})),
            "at": stamp}, the_round))))
    if notes_in or notes_out:
        # GH #1303: one mark per window that had notes -- what it showed and
        # what it left out, ids and scopes, never the texts.
        ops.append(("f-notes", ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 6 + len(missing), "session_id": session,
            "turn_id": turn, "kind": "notes",
            "value": canonical({"call": call, "notes_in": notes_in,
                                "notes_dropped": notes_out}),
            "at": stamp}, the_round))))
    ops += note_ops
    if way in ("consult", "research"):
        # GH #1247 (T4-11, R-WP-5, R-27-3): the whole errand straight to the
        # backend, under its own consult id; the answer comes back on
        # `in_advice` like a consult the model asked for, and until then the
        # session's speaking calls carry `consult.pending` (#1198).
        cid = "k-" + call
        head["consult_id"] = cid
        head["consult_class"] = way
        head["consult_wait_ms"] = str(wait_ms(way))
    # GH #1044: the usable window `./push` hands the memory on its ask (state
    # `input_soft`, kept from the last answer and cut to the model's window,
    # GH #1085) rides on the model call as well. The composite lifts
    # it into the call's context and stamps it on the model's own
    # `memory_recall` -- the one road to the memory that never passes
    # `./push`, about a fifth of all brain calls in a measured benchmark run.
    # Empty: no package, the memory keeps its old sizes.
    head["recall_input_soft"] = state.get("input_soft", "")
    if cuts:
        head["cuts"] = cuts
    for k, v in (("session_id", session), ("turn_id", turn), ("iter", str(it))):
        if k not in head:
            head[k] = v
    out = {"header": head, "messages": ([full_el] if full_el is not None else [])
           + [el for _, el, _, _ in items]}
    if system:
        out["system"] = system
    c_has_scope, c_scope = cut_timed(c_spent, cut_scope, way, slim, q_scope,
                                     is_clarify and way == "brain", LEAD.get("deny"))
    if c_has_scope:
        out["tool_scope"] = c_scope
    # GH #1038: what this call holds, estimated like the llm cell does --
    # every system leaf (the model keeps the whole tree, `out` carries only
    # what changed) and every message; the tap reads it back by the call.
    # A call the guard cut keeps the estimate of the whole wall (GH #1225).
    # GH #1427 (OR-d38-1.k6.4): the raw part rides along -- the messages of
    # the wall rows above the plan's cover and the rounds they belong to.
    raw_cover = plan_cover(plan, []) if plan else 0
    # GH #1434 (OR-38-29 B3, OR-d38-1.k6b.1): measured as the budget
    # measures it (`raw_estimate`: block characters over the rate, a shrunk
    # or released row at its one-line form), not `estimate_tokens` of the
    # elements -- the bench read that at 1.37-1.40x the budget.
    # Review I-1 of GH #1434: only the rows the call sends -- the seqs of its
    # `items`, after the guard's cut and the quick filter. Over the whole wall
    # a quick call (the running round and `keep_recent` 4 elements) named six
    # rounds it never sent, 3005 tokens over a projection of 1164.
    sent_seqs = set(p for p, _, _, _ in items)
    # A final answer `render` cut at its sidecar block counts at the text it
    # sends (`with_cut`, the cap `render` was handed); a shrunk, released or
    # expired row at its one-line form (`gone_ids`, as `render` only with a
    # plan) -- review m-2 and the rest list of GH #1434.
    raw_cap = budget_chars(c_budget["soft"], SIDECAR_SHARE)
    raw_wall = [with_cut(dict(r, chars=(blocks.get(str(r.get("hash") or "")) or {}).get("chars") or 0),
                         element_of(r), raw_cap)
                for r in wall if int(r.get("seq") or 0) > raw_cover
                and int(r.get("seq") or 0) in sent_seqs]
    raw_gone = (gone_ids(raw_wall, plan.get("shrunk") or [], plan.get("released") or [],
                         plan.get("as_of_ms"), (session, turn)) if plan else set())
    raw_rate = c_budget["rate"] or float(CHARS_PER_TOKEN)
    raw_part = {"raw_tokens": int(raw_estimate(raw_wall, raw_gone, raw_rate)),
                "raw_rounds": len(set((str(r.get("session_id") or ""), str(r.get("turn_id") or ""))
                                      for r in raw_wall))}
    ops += put("f-est", "window_est:" + call, est_row(way, overflow["before"] if overflow else
                                                  estimate_tokens(
        {"system": [[path, text] for path, text, _ in leaves], "messages": out["messages"]}),
        raw_part, c_plan))
    # A call no tap answered (a lost answer) left its projection behind: the
    # next call of the round takes it down, the round keeps one (KF2 review N3).
    prev_est = state.get(rkey("est_call"), "")
    if prev_est and prev_est != call:
        ops.append(("f-est-old", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                                  "where": {"key": "window_est:" + prev_est}}))
    ops += put("f-estc", rkey("est_call"), call)
    # GH #1448 (R-38-4 Nr. 5): the call's plan as a snapshot -- its block ids
    # with their prio and tokens, one row per call under the round; the
    # round keeps its newest `snapshot_keep`.
    # OR-d38-3.o10.2 (review I1): every block the call sends -- the system
    # part and the identity as `frame`, the plan's, the notes block's lines
    # as `state`/`note` -- the text sent unchanged; the call's own, never
    # the plan's (rebuilt each call, built ahead later).
    # GH #1448 (OR-38-65 b, review I2): a recall block's prio is the call's:
    # a brain call of a stamped turn without `memory` lowers the running
    # turn's ambient recall (every one in the wall), never a stub, and the
    # plan keeps `prio_of(kind)` -- a later turn sees the preset.
    low = set()
    if way == "brain" and RECALL_BY_NEEDS and recall_unneeded(seam_hop, ctx):
        low = set("recall:" + short_id(r.get("hash")) for r in wall
                  if (str(r.get("session_id") or ""), str(r.get("turn_id") or "")) == (session, turn)
                  and ambient_of(loads(str(r.get("body") or ""), {})) == "recall")
    c_aud = round_canon(the_round)
    call_blocks = [block_of("frame", {"path": p, "text": t}, {"source": "system", "hash": h}, c_aud)
                   for p, t, h in leaves] \
        + ([block_of("frame", full_el, {"source": "system", "hash": block_hash(full_el)}, c_aud)]
           if full_el is not None else []) \
        + [dict(b, prio=prio_of("recall_unneeded" if b.get("id") in low else "recall"))
           if b.get("kind") == "recall" else b for b in c_plan["blocks"]] \
        + note_blocks(lead, notes_in, c_aud)
    # GH #1450 (OR-d38-3.c3b.2): the second half of the snapshot -- the cut.
    c_cell = cut_cell(way, is_spec)
    c_cut = cut(call_blocks, wall, c_stages, catalog_row(c_cell, state), c_cell or way,
                {"soft": cw_int(c_budget["soft"]) or None, "target": c_budget["target"] or None,
                 "hard": int(HARD_HEADROOM * c_budget["line"])}, (session, turn), c_spent,
                scope_names(out.get("tool_scope")))
    # Review o15-Rv1 m1 (V5): the snapshot says why a recall pair is absent.
    in_wall_cut = [{"id": str(b.get("id") or ""), "why": "recall_in_wall"} for b in in_wall]
    if in_wall_cut:
        c_cut["dropped"] = c_cut["dropped"] + in_wall_cut
    s_prev = sorted((cw_int(r.get("seq")) for r in rows(lg, "w-snap")), reverse=True)
    s_seq = max([epoch_us(stamp)] + [x + 1 for x in s_prev])
    # Review o15-R1 I3: the bridge is a call of its own and takes its own
    # snapshot row, one seq past this one; the round still keeps its newest
    # `snapshot_keep`.
    has_bridge = way in ("consult", "research") or tool_round
    # Review m6 of c3b: with `snapshot_keep` 1 and a bridge the two new rows
    # are one too many -- the call's own row goes too, the bridge's is kept.
    s_keep = SNAPSHOT_KEEP - (2 if has_bridge else 1)
    ops.append(("f-snap", ins("snapshots", with_audience({
        "seq": s_seq, "call_id": call,
        "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn, "at": stamp,
        "body": canonical([{"id": b.get("id"), "prio": b.get("prio"), "tokens": b.get("tokens")}
                           for b in call_blocks]),
        "cut": canonical(c_cut)}, the_round))))
    if s_keep < 0 or len(s_prev) > s_keep:
        ops.append(("f-snapgc", {"operation": "delete", "table": "snapshots", "where": {
            "audience_set": with_audience({}, the_round)["audience_set"],
            "seq": {"lte": s_seq if s_keep < 0 else s_prev[s_keep]}}}))
    also, a_cells = [], [cut_cell(way, is_spec)]
    if has_bridge:
        # GH #1248 (T4-12): the bridge -- the quick window, the system part
        # without the sidecar contract plus `instructions.bridge`, no tool.
        # GH #1260 (OR-WG-6): the tool round of a simple turn has one too.
        b_way = "tool" if tool_round else way
        b_text = bridge_text(b_way, running_tools(q_scope) if tool_round else None)
        b_leaves = sorted([x for x in with_frame(quick_leaves(leaves), stamp)
                           if x[0] != CONTRACT_PATH
                           and not x[0].startswith(CONTRACT_PATH + ".")]
                          + [(BRIDGE_LEAF, b_text,
                              block_hash({"path": BRIDGE_LEAF, "text": b_text}))],
                          key=lambda x: path_key(x[0]))
        b_head = {k: v for k, v in head.items()
                  if k not in ("consult_id", "consult_class", "consult_wait_ms")}
        b_head["route"] = "quick"
        b_head["curator_call"] = call + "-bridge"
        b_head["bridge"] = b_way
        if LEAD.get("quick_speculative"):
            # GH #1398 (V1): talky gives a speculating curator's bridge a
            # cell of its own (`./quick_bridge`, on `hop.spec` "bridge"), so it
            # never queues behind a spec call or the tool round on `./quick`
            # (one `handle()` at a time). Off, it goes to `./quick` as before.
            b_head["spec"] = "bridge"
        if tool_round:
            # GH #1260: the round goes on with the tool result, so the
            # bridge's sentence is interim -- as final answer it ended the
            # round (the collector drops it) before the result came back.
            # talky lifts it into the context, the dispatcher marks it.
            b_head["interim"] = "1"
        # The bridge reaches `./quick` too (re-check I1): its gated and session
        # families go whole, empty included, like those of a quick call.
        b_system = {f: family_node(f, b_leaves) for f in family_hashes(b_leaves)}
        for f in GATED_FAMILIES + SESSION_FAMILIES:
            b_system[f] = family_node(f, b_leaves)
        # GH #1260 (lock W6): the bridge is a model call of its own and has
        # its own `calls` row, so the tap of its answer books its usage --
        # without it the update by `call_id` met no row and its tokens fell
        # out of the ledger.
        ops.append(("f-bcall", ins("calls", with_audience({
            "call_id": b_head["curator_call"], "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn,
            "iter": it, "trigger": "bridge", "started_at": stamp, "model": "",
            "tokens_prompt": None, "tokens_completion": None, "tokens_cached": None,
            "tokens_cache_write": None, "cost": None, "cache_expires_at": "",
            "system_hash": block_hash(family_hashes(b_leaves)), "actions": []},
            the_round))))
        # Review o15-R1 I3 (OR-d38-3.o15.3): the bridge is cut by the one
        # stage 2 -- its window (`cut_bridge`), its budget and its cell
        # (`./quick_bridge` on `hop.spec` "bridge", else `./quick`), its
        # snapshot and its catalogue question like every other call.
        b_spent = [0.0]
        b_cell = cut_cell("quick", bridge=b_head.get("spec") == "bridge")
        b_budget = cut_timed(b_spent, cut_budget, b_cell, "quick", state)
        b_msgs, b_pos = cut_timed(b_spent, cut_bridge, unmoved, wall, b_way, (session, turn))
        b_blocks = [block_of("frame", {"path": p, "text": t}, {"source": "system", "hash": h},
                             c_aud) for p, t, h in b_leaves] \
            + [b for b in c_plan["blocks"] if (b.get("origin") or {}).get("source") == "wall"]
        b_cut = cut(b_blocks, wall, c_stages[:2] + [b_pos, b_pos], catalog_row(b_cell, state),
                    b_cell, {"soft": cw_int(b_budget["soft"]) or None,
                             "target": b_budget["target"] or None,
                             "hard": int(HARD_HEADROOM * b_budget["line"])},
                    (session, turn), b_spent, [])
        if in_wall_cut:
            b_cut["dropped"] = b_cut["dropped"] + in_wall_cut
        ops.append(("f-bsnap", ins("snapshots", with_audience({
            "seq": s_seq + 1, "call_id": b_head["curator_call"],
            "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn, "at": stamp,
            "body": canonical([{"id": b.get("id"), "prio": b.get("prio"),
                                "tokens": b.get("tokens")} for b in b_blocks]),
            "cut": canonical(b_cut)}, the_round))))
        a_cells.append(b_cell)
        also.append({"header": b_head,
                     "messages": b_msgs,
                     "system": b_system,
                     "tool_scope": {"allow": []}})
    # GH #1260 fix round 1 (OR-WG-8): in the tool round both calls go to the
    # one `./quick`, a stateful llm cell that runs one `handle()` at a time
    # (`max_concurrency` is a stateless knob), so they cannot run side by
    # side. The bridge goes FIRST, on the same edge, so its sentence comes
    # after its own call and not after the required call plus its own.
    # consult/research keep the order: their main call goes elsewhere.
    # GH #1398: with speculation on the bridge goes to `./quick_bridge`, so
    # the order no longer makes one wait for the other.
    sends = also + [out] if tool_round else [out] + also
    a_asked = 0
    for a_cell in [c for i, c in enumerate(a_cells) if c and c not in a_cells[:i]]:
        if not CATALOG_ASK or state.get(CATALOG_KEY + a_cell) \
                or state.get(CATALOG_ASKED + a_cell, "") == session:
            continue
        # GH #1450 (OR-d38-3.c3b.1): no row of the target yet -- ask its cell
        # once this session, beside the call and never instead of it (the
        # call runs on the window known so far; latency is KEY). One round
        # trip: the cell answers with its row on `in_catalog`; no polling.
        _ALSO.append({"header": {"route": "catalog_ask", "catalog_for": a_cell,
                                 "session_id": session},
                      "system": {}, "params": {}})
        ops += put("f-ask" + (str(a_asked) if a_asked else ""), CATALOG_ASKED + a_cell, session)
        a_asked += 1
    if ESCALATE in flags and str(LEAD.get("shown") or ""):
        # GH #1432 (Telegram round 4, turn 5): the stored call of a failed
        # speculation failed as well and the round went to the brain, which
        # wrote anew what the shown spec sentence had said. The brain call
        # carries that sentence as its own words, like the stored call did
        # (the lead reads the row `spec_shown` for an escalation).
        sends = with_shown(sends, str(LEAD.get("shown")))
    h_ops = []
    if HORIZON_ADVISE and str(seam_hop.get("engine") or ctx.get("engine") or "") == "duplex" \
            and str(seam_hop.get("call_id") or ctx.get("call_id") or "") \
            and str(seam_hop.get("spec") or "") != "1" and it_now == 0 \
            and (tool_round or way in ("consult", "research")):
        # GH #1400: the turn's horizon rides WITH its round's sends -- held
        # with them for an awaited spec, sent with them, gone with them when
        # the round never goes. Its turn row times the round for the booking.
        # No `at_turn_end`: that holds to the caller's NEXT turn, and this one
        # has just ended -- the voice holds a horizon only while the model
        # speaks and says it when that section ends (o8.5).
        h_fams = names_list(seam_hop.get("families") or ctx.get("families")) or [way]
        h_fam, h_ms = horizon_plan(h_fams, loads(state.get(HORIZON_KEY, ""), {}))
        h_row = {"family": h_fam, "way": way, "at_ms": epoch_ms(stamp), "seconds": None,
                 "parked_at": now()}
        if h_ms is not None:
            h_row["seconds"] = -(-int(h_ms) // 1000)
            h_head = {"route": "live_feed", "section": "horizon",
                      "call_id": str(seam_hop.get("call_id") or ctx.get("call_id")),
                      "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn}
            if audience_of(the_round) is not None:
                h_head["audience_set"] = audience_of(the_round)
            sends = sends + [{"header": h_head, "messages": [], "section": "horizon",
                              "seconds": h_row["seconds"], "way": way, "family": h_fam}]
            h_ops.append(("f-hzm", ins("marks", with_audience({
                "seq": epoch_us(stamp) + 9, "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn,
                "kind": "horizon_sent",
                "value": canonical({"seconds": h_row["seconds"], "family": h_fam}),
                "at": stamp}, the_round))))
        h_ops += put("f-hzt", HORIZON_TURN_KEY + "%s#%s" % (session, turn), canonical(h_row))
        # Its mark and turn row are written where the sends go: held with an
        # awaited spec or a delta, they go with the stored sends (`horizon_go`)
        # and never when the spec answer wins.
    if spec_wait is None and s_raw and str(s_row.get("call") or "") == call \
            and str(s_row.get("state") or "") == "normal":
        # GH #1279: the `normal` claim goes with the call it guarded (the
        # lead's `spec_called:` row is the guard from here, OR-d38-3.c1.8).
        _ALSO.append(lead_note("spec_normal", session, turn, raw=s_raw))
    if d_verdict == "reused":
        # GH #1279: the reused call is stored in the lead and the row moved
        # `fired` -> `delta` by CAS; its `delta-send` hands it back (`spec_act`
        # "delta") only when the move took. The call's records go now.
        emit([lstore(ops, "done", call, ""),
              lead_spec("delta_fb", session, turn, call, sends=sends, horizon_ops=h_ops,
                        raw=s_raw, delta_raw=dl.get("raw"))])
    if spec_wait is not None:
        # GH #1275: the built call is the fallback of an awaited spec answer --
        # stored in the lead (`spec-await` there), sent when the answer is
        # dropped (`spec_act` "settle"/"fb_go"). The call's records go now.
        emit([lstore(ops, "done", call, ""),
              lead_spec("fb", session, turn, call, sends=sends, needs=spec_wait,
                        families=spec_fams, horizon_ops=h_ops, raw=s_raw)])
    emit([lstore(ops + h_ops, "done", call, "")] + sends)

if phase == "tap":
    report_errors(lg)
    t_failed = failed_legs(lg)
    t_err = [store_error_mark("t-err", phase, t_failed)] if t_failed else []
    if "b-state" in t_failed:
        # GH #1225 (A3): the answer's usage (`pending:tap-<call>`) is out of
        # reach -- read as empty, the fallback row's limits would overwrite
        # the model's own (`input_hard`, `aim`, `curate`). The call is the
        # round's last; the rest waits for the next answer.
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: the store refused the tap of call %s -- its usage is"
                         " not known, nothing derived from it is written (%s)\n"
                         % (call, STORE_ERROR))
        emit([lstore(put("t-last", rkey("last_call"), call) + t_err, "done", call, "")])
    state = state_of(lg, "b-state")
    stash = loads(state.get("pending:tap-" + call, ""), {})
    usage = stash.get("usage") or {}
    fields = {}
    for k in ("model", "tokens_prompt", "tokens_completion", "tokens_cached",
              "tokens_cache_write", "cost", "cache_expires_at"):
        if usage.get(k) is not None:
            fields[k] = usage.get(k) if k != "cache_expires_at" else str(usage.get(k))
    if "cost" in fields:
        # `calls.cost` is a `json` column: the llm cell stamps a fraction and
        # the store has no real type, so the number is kept as its JSON text
        # (review M4). Anything that is not a number is not a cost.
        c = fields.pop("cost")
        try:
            if not isinstance(c, bool):
                fields["cost"] = canonical(c if isinstance(c, (int, float)) else float(str(c)))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            pass
    # GH #943: the round's last call, PUT -- the row of a new round is not
    # there yet, and an `update` would set nothing.
    ops = put("t-last", rkey("last_call"), call)
    consults = [str(c) for c in (stash.get("consults") or []) if str(c)]
    if consults:
        # GH #1280 (review I1): the brain started a consult itself
        # (`consult_cogny` in its output, `./intake`). Since `talk:brain`
        # (GH #1260) the brain holds the tool on talk turns, and without a
        # mark the next turn's brain had it on its menu again -- the same
        # double consult as a curator's one. The mark is the curator's own
        # form, under the call's id (cogny's advice comes back under it), and
        # written only while none stands (`if_absent`): a consult the curator
        # sent keeps its mark. Advice, backstop and deny then work unchanged.
        # GH #1447: the mark is the lead's row -- a note, the lead writes it.
        _ALSO.append(lead_note("consult", str(stash.get("session") or "default"),
                               str(stash.get("turn") or ""), consult_id=consults[0],
                               at=now()))
    if fields:
        ops.insert(0, ("t-call", upd("calls", fields, {"call_id": call})))
    # Review M1 of F2: the way the call left on, kept with its projection
    # (`window_est:<call>`, phase `win`); a bridge keeps none and is quick.
    projected, a_way, raw_part = est_of(state.get("window_est:" + call, ""))
    if not a_way and call.endswith("-bridge"):
        a_way = "quick"
    if not a_way and not call.endswith("-bridge") \
            and str(stash.get("tool_round") or "") != "1" \
            and state.get("pending:" + call + ESC_SUFFIX, ""):
        # GH #1382: the projection fell with the next call of the round
        # (`f-est-old`) while this one was out -- in rollout R034's lab run 2
        # the stored quick call of a failed spec came back 275 s late, after
        # the session's next turn had built its call, and its `error` read no
        # way: no escalation, the turn ended in silence. The `-esc` copy says
        # the way still: `win` keeps it for quick calls only (no spec, no
        # bridge, no brain call), so this is a quick call, and its error goes
        # to the brain once like any other (GH #1352); any other end drops it.
        a_way = "quick"
    t_plan = loads(state.get("window_est:" + call, ""), {}).get("plan")
    if isinstance(t_plan, dict) and isinstance(t_plan.get("blocks"), list):
        # GH #1448 (Z1.2): the plan is built after the answer -- the call's
        # plan and the answer's blocks, ahead of the next turn.
        t_blocks = [b for b in t_plan["blocks"] if isinstance(b, dict)]
        t_blocks += blocks_of_rows(
            [{"el": m} for m in (stash.get("messages") or []) if isinstance(m, dict)],
            [str(b.get("id") or "") for b in t_blocks], round_canon(the_round))
        seen = str(t_plan.get("seen") or "")
        ops += plan_cas("t-plan", rkey("window_plan"), canonical(dict(
            loads(seen, {}), blocks=t_blocks, blocks_to=cw_int(t_plan.get("blocks_to")))), seen)
    cw = cw_of(usage.get("context_window"))
    if usage.get("context_window") not in (None, ""):
        # The window the model reported, for the aim of the next rebuild (the
        # rebuild starts on a strike of the clock, which carries no usage).
        ops.append(("t-cw", upd("state", {"value": str(cw)}, {"key": "context_window"})))
        if a_way:
            # Review m1 of c3b: the way's own copy, the one `cut_budget` cuts
            # that way's row to.
            ops += put("t-cww", WAY_WINDOW_KEY + a_way, str(cw))
    # The usable window: the model's own (R-IG-1, GH #1085). Until 1.11.2 a
    # role's `quality_cap` cut it (GH #892, talky 120000): luna's 250000 was
    # 120000, and without the row's limits a rebuild came at 60000.
    usable = cw
    try:
        soft_now = int(float(usage.get("input_soft")))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        soft_now = 0
    if soft_now > 0:
        # GH #1040: the answering model's `input_soft` (the llm cell's stamp,
        # GH #1037), kept for `./push`: the memory ask of the NEXT turn leaves
        # before this model answers again, and the memory hive sizes its
        # bundle and its query by it. Cut to the model's own window (review
        # M1) and to nothing else (GH #1085): luna's row is 250k for every
        # role. An answer without a stamp leaves the last value standing;
        # since GH #1037 every llm answer of a model with a package stamps
        # one.
        if usable > 0:
            soft_now = min(soft_now, usable)
        ops += put("t-soft", window_key("input_soft", a_way), str(soft_now))
        if ctx.get("sa_stage") and a_way in ("brain", ""):
            # The bare key stays the last answer's: `./push` sizes the memory ask by it.
            ops += put("t-soft0", "input_soft", str(soft_now))
    tp = usage.get("tokens_prompt")
    due, why = None, ""
    t_now = now_ms()
    # GH #1038: the answering model's limits and prices decide first; the
    # usable window's share orders a rebuild only without them.
    limits = limits_of(usage)
    # GH #1225 (K-3, OR-KF-7): no package and no window known -- the
    # fallback row stands in (`FALLBACK_LIMITS`), said once per round.
    stand_in = "input_soft" not in limits and usable <= 0 and "input_soft" in FALLBACK_LIMITS
    if stand_in:
        limits = dict(FALLBACK_LIMITS, **limits)
    if "chars_per_token" in limits:
        # The answering row's rate, for the estimate of the next rebuild (it
        # starts on a strike of the clock, which carries no usage; review #5).
        ops += put("t-rate", "chars_per_token", repr(float(limits["chars_per_token"])))
    window = tp
    nxt = 0
    if "input_soft" in limits:
        # The package's rule measures the window, never a continuation's sum
        # (review M2), and looks one window ahead at the cell's estimate
        # (review M3). Without the package the rule of before is untouched.
        window = window_of(tp, projected)
        nxt = (projected + estimate_tokens(stash.get("messages") or [])) if projected else 0
    # GH #1272 (mark `day`): a role with a day horizon rebuilds when its
    # turn is on another UTC day than the newest round of its last rebuild.
    # The turn's day is its own time where `./intake` stamped one (a replay
    # channel's `happened_at`, the clock the rows age by) and this tap's
    # clock otherwise. A round that never rebuilt starts the count at the
    # day of its first answer.
    day_due = False
    if HORIZON == "day":
        t_day = day_of(stash.get("turn_at") or t_now)
        try:
            last_day = int(state.get(rkey("last_rebuild_day")) or 0)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            last_day = 0
        if t_day is not None and last_day <= 0:
            ops += put("t-day", rkey("last_rebuild_day"), str(t_day))
        elif t_day is not None and t_day != last_day:
            day_due = True
    # Review I-1 (GH #1272): the window of the round's last `target` order,
    # kept while the window stays over the target -- `curate_mark` waits for
    # new load before it orders the next one. A later turn lowers it to its
    # own window (review I-3): the hold counts the growth since the lowest
    # window after the order, the one the rebuild left, not since the order.
    target_at = cw_int(state.get(rkey("target_at")))
    cm = curate_mark(window, limits, None, nxt, day_due, target_at)
    mark = cm["mark"]
    if mark == "target" and isinstance(window, (int, float)):
        ops += put("t-tat", rkey("target_at"), str(int(window)))
    elif target_at and isinstance(window, (int, float)) and window < WINDOW_TARGET:
        ops += put("t-tat", rkey("target_at"), "")
    elif target_at and isinstance(window, (int, float)) and window < target_at:
        ops += put("t-tat", rkey("target_at"), str(int(min(target_at, window))))
    if "input_soft" in limits or mark in ("target", "day"):
        aim = cm["rebuild_to"] or (int(limits["input_soft"]) if mark == "hard" else 0)
        ops += put("t-aim", rkey("aim"), str(aim) if aim else "")
    else:
        ops += put("t-aim", rkey("aim"), "")
    tc = usage.get("tokens_cached")
    said_now = {"call": call, "curate_mark": mark,
                **({"target_hold": cm["hold"]} if "hold" in cm else {}),
                "window_tokens": window if isinstance(window, (int, float)) else None,
                "cached_tokens": tc if isinstance(tc, (int, float)) else None,
                "cost_cents": cost_cents(window, tc, limits)}
    if projected:
        said_now["window_estimate"] = projected
    # GH #1427: the raw part of the call's window (`raw_tokens`, `raw_rounds`).
    said_now.update(raw_part)
    for k in ("input_soft", "input_hard"):
        if k in limits:
            said_now[k] = int(limits[k])
    ops += put("t-cur", rkey("curate"), canonical(said_now))
    if "input_hard" in limits:
        # GH #1225 (K-2): the hard line of the model that answers, for the
        # guard of the next call (`win`, OR-KF-6).
        ops += put("t-hard", window_key("input_hard", a_way), str(int(limits["input_hard"])))
    done_reason = ""
    if stand_in:
        # One `no_package` mark per round (OR-KF-7): written only while the
        # round has none, in one statement (`if_absent`); `done` says it on
        # stderr when this one was written.
        missing = [k for k in PACKAGE_KEYS if usage.get(k) in (None, "")]
        mrow = with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(now()) + 1, "session_id": str(stash.get("session") or ""),
            "turn_id": str(stash.get("turn") or ""), "kind": "no_package",
            "value": canonical({"call": call, "missing": missing,
                                "row": str(P.get("input_soft_fallback_row") or "")}),
            "at": now()}, the_round)
        ops.append(("t-nopkg", dict(ins("marks", mrow), if_absent={
            "kind": "no_package", "audience_set": mrow["audience_set"]})))
        done_reason = "no_package:" + ",".join(missing)
    if limits:
        # One row per turn in the ledger, with the round of the call.
        ops.append(("t-mark", ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(now()), "session_id": str(stash.get("session") or ""),
            "turn_id": str(stash.get("turn") or ""), "kind": "curate",
            "value": canonical(said_now), "at": now()}, the_round))))
    if mark != "none":
        # Over a limit, or dearer to keep than to rebuild: rebuild now --
        # through the clock, like the line below.
        due, why = t_now + 1000, mark
    elif "input_soft" not in limits and usable > 0 and isinstance(tp, (int, float)) \
            and tp >= COMPRESS_AT * usable:
        # The prompt crossed the line: rebuild now -- through the clock, so the
        # rebuild starts on a message of its own and the call that crossed the
        # line is already on its way.
        due, why = t_now + 1000, "compress"
    else:
        expiry = epoch_ms(usage.get("cache_expires_at"))
        if expiry is None and stand_in and FALLBACK_TTL_S > 0:
            # No stamp of the cache: the row's TTL from this answer on.
            expiry = t_now + FALLBACK_TTL_S * 1000
        if expiry is not None:
            # A stamp already past (at_in_past) is a cold cache NOW: the earliest
            # second the timer accepts.
            due, why = max(expiry, t_now + 1000), "cache"
    clock = []
    if due is not None:
        # One order per round, re-armed in place (GH #904, GH #943): whatever
        # the round's row holds -- its last call's order, active or already
        # struck -- it now holds this one. No `remove` + `add` pair, no row
        # per call, and no call of another round re-arms it.
        #
        # THE ROUND RIDES WITH THE ORDER (GH #925, OR-BD.A.6). A strike is a
        # fresh root (the timer emits it through its OriginSink) and carries
        # no context, and every rebuild starts on one -- so without this no
        # rebuild would ever have a round, and a rebuild without a round makes
        # no summary: in operation, never one. The order carries the round of
        # this call (the tap brings its context) as `emit_headers`; the timer
        # emits them as hop keys of the strike, and the edge `./clock ->
        # ./policy` lifts `hop.audience_set` into the context. `rearm`
        # replaces the whole order of the round. A call without a round
        # orders an empty one: that rebuild makes no summary and cuts the
        # window all the same (review I-3).
        clock.append({"header": {"route": "clock"}, "messages": [], "op": "add",
                      "schedule_id": clock_id(the_rk), "rearm": True,
                      "schedule_name": "cache",
                      "at": iso_z(due), "emit_to": "../policy",
                      "emit_body": dict({"messages": [], "curator_call": call, "reason": why},
                                        **({"curate_mark": mark} if limits else {})),
                      "emit_headers": {"audience_set": audience_of(the_round) or ""}})
        ops += put("t-armed", rkey("armed_call"), call)
    if a_way in ("brain", "") and not call.endswith("-bridge") \
            and str(stash.get("finish") or "") != "tool_calls" \
            and str(stash.get("tool_round") or "") != "1" and str(stash.get("turn") or ""):
        # Review m3 of F2: the brain's answer ends the turn -- its system row
        # goes (the next turn builds its own). F2d: so does an answer whose
        # way is not known -- its projection fell with the next call of the
        # round (`f-est-old`) while another turn of the session ran; a final
        # answer ends its turn whatever the way, and an ended turn keeps no row.
        ops.append(("t-tsys", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                               "where": {"key": turn_system_key(
                                   str(stash.get("session") or "default"),
                                   str(stash.get("turn") or ""))}}))
    esc = []
    if str(stash.get("tool_round") or "") == "1":
        esc_call = call + ESC_SUFFIX
        if str(stash.get("finish") or "") == "tool_calls":
            ops.append(("t-escd", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                                   "where": {"key": "pending:" + esc_call}}))
        else:
            # GH #1260 (OR-WG-9): the tool round ended without its call (lab
            # r026c: an HTTP 404 of a host that refuses a forced call, three of
            # three turns silent after the bridge; elsewhere prose with a
            # made-up answer). The round goes to the brain, from the parked
            # turn `win` kept.
            sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: call %s of a tool round came back without a"
                             " tool call (finish %r) -- the round goes to the brain\n"
                             % (call, str(stash.get("finish") or "")))
            detail = {"finish": str(stash.get("finish") or "")}
            if stash.get("error_code"):
                detail["error"] = str(stash.get("error_code"))
            esc = [lstore(slim_reads(esc_call), "win-plan", esc_call,
                          ESCALATE + "no_tool_call:" + canonical(detail))]
    elif a_way == "quick" and not call.endswith("-bridge"):
        # GH #1352: a quick call that came back without an answer -- the llm
        # cell's error (a `tool_call_limit` cut, a timeout, a provider error)
        # or a content filter -- goes to the brain like a tool round without
        # its call (GH #1260), from the copy `win` kept; reason `no_answer`.
        # Before, the error left for the drain and the turn ended in silence.
        # A bridge keeps none: its errand
        # answers the turn. Every other end drops the copy.
        esc_call = call + ESC_SUFFIX
        q_finish = str(stash.get("finish") or "")
        if q_finish in ("error", "content_filter"):
            sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: quick call %s came back without an answer"
                             " (finish %r) -- the round goes to the brain\n"
                             % (call, q_finish))
            detail = {"finish": q_finish}
            if stash.get("error_code"):
                detail["error"] = str(stash.get("error_code"))
            esc = [lstore(slim_reads(esc_call), "win-plan", esc_call,
                          ESCALATE + "no_answer:" + canonical(detail))]
        else:
            ops.append(("t-escd", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                                   "where": {"key": "pending:" + esc_call}}))
    t_turn = str(stash.get("turn") or "")
    if t_turn:
        # GH #1279 / #1432 (GH #1447: the rows are the lead's): a delta row of
        # the turn ends with it; the turn's answer is in -- a shown spec
        # sentence has done its work (an escalation keeps it for the brain).
        _ALSO.append(lead_note("turn_end", str(stash.get("session") or "default"), t_turn,
                               shown_end=bool(not esc and not call.endswith("-bridge")
                                              and str(stash.get("finish") or "") != "tool_calls"
                                              and str(stash.get("tool_round") or "") != "1")))
    if HORIZON_ADVISE and t_turn and not esc and a_way in ("brain", "quick", "") \
            and not call.endswith("-bridge") \
            and str(stash.get("finish") or "") not in ("tool_calls", "error", "content_filter") \
            and str(stash.get("tool_round") or "") != "1":
        # GH #1400: the turn's answer is in -- its horizon round is booked on
        # reads of its own (phase `hz-close`); a turn without a row books
        # nothing.
        h_ses = str(stash.get("session") or "default")
        _ALSO.append(lstore([("h-st", sel("state", ["key", "value"], {"key": {"in": [
            HORIZON_TURN_KEY + "%s#%s" % (h_ses, t_turn), HORIZON_KEY]}}))], "hz-close", call,
            canonical({"s": h_ses, "t": t_turn})))
    if LIVE_FEED and t_turn and not esc and a_way in ("brain", "quick", "") \
            and not call.endswith("-bridge") \
            and str(stash.get("finish") or "") not in ("tool_calls", "error", "content_filter") \
            and str(stash.get("tool_round") or "") != "1":
        # GH #1279: the turn is closed -- its live feed is decided on reads
        # of its own (phase `live`).
        l_ses = str(stash.get("session") or "default")
        _ALSO.append(lstore(live_reads(l_ses, t_turn), "live", call,
                            canonical({"s": l_ses, "t": t_turn})))
    emit([lstore(ops + t_err, "done", call, done_reason)] + clock + esc)

if phase == "rb-probe":
    # A13: the parked rows past their age fall beside whatever this probe
    # decides, in a bundle of their own (`swept`).
    swept, swept_keys = sweep_ops(rows(lg, "p-pend"), now_ms())
    if swept:
        # The keys ride as the reason: the mark names only what went.
        _ALSO.append(lstore(swept, "swept", call, canonical(swept_keys)))
    # A refused read of the parked rows sweeps nothing this time, said
    # (review M-1 of KR-P2); the rebuild runs on, the next probe reads again.
    pend_failed = failed_legs(lg, ("p-pend",))
    failed = failed_legs(lg, ("p-state", "p-sum", "p-call"))
    if pend_failed and not failed:
        report_errors(lg)
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: the store refused the read of the parked rows (%s)"
                         " -- nothing swept this time\n" % STORE_ERROR)
        _ALSO.append(lstore([store_error_mark("q-err", phase, pend_failed)], "swept", call, ""))
    failed = dict(failed, **pend_failed) if failed else failed
    if failed:
        # GH #1225 (A3): a probe the store refused knows neither the round's
        # lock nor its plan -- a rebuild from it would start over an empty
        # plan. It stops with its mark; nothing is claimed, the old window
        # stays, the next trigger probes anew.
        report_errors(lg)
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: the store refused the probe of a rebuild (%s) --"
                         " no rebuild, the old window stays (%s)\n"
                         % (", ".join(sorted(failed)), STORE_ERROR))
        emit([lstore([store_error_mark("e-mark", phase, failed)], "done", call, "")])
    state = state_of(lg, "p-state")
    # GH #943: stale against the last call of THIS round -- a call of another
    # round makes no strike of this one stale.
    if call and call != state.get(rkey("last_call"), ""):
        park("a fire for call %s, the last call is %s -- stale, dropped"
             % (call, state.get(rkey("last_call"), "")))
    running = state.get(rkey("rebuild_running"), "")
    if running:
        info = loads(running, {})
        started = epoch_ms(info.get("at")) or 0
