        if now_ms() - started < REBUILD_STALE_S * 1000:
            park("a rebuild is running -- this trigger (%s) merges into it" % reason)
    backoff = loads(state.get(rkey("rebuild_backoff"), ""), {})
    if backoff and reason != "cache" and int(backoff.get("turns") or 0) < AMORTISE_TURNS:
        # GH #1225 (K-2): the round's last rebuild failed (`old_window_kept`).
        # An order of a line crossed (soft, hard, cost, compress) makes no
        # summarizer call before the cache went cold or `amortise_turns` such
        # orders passed -- said as a `rebuild_backoff` mark each time; the
        # call itself stays under `input_hard` meanwhile (`win`).
        n = int(backoff.get("turns") or 0) + 1
        stamp = now()
        session = str((rows(lg, "p-call") or [{}])[0].get("session_id") or "")
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: the last rebuild of this round failed -- the %s"
                         " order backs off (%d of %d)\n" % (reason, n, AMORTISE_TURNS))
        emit([lstore(put("p-boff", rkey("rebuild_backoff"),
                         canonical(dict(backoff, turns=n)))
                     + [("p-boffm", ins("marks", with_audience({
                         "seq": epoch_us(stamp), "session_id": session, "turn_id": "",
                         "kind": "rebuild_backoff",
                         "value": canonical({"call": call, "reason": reason, "turns": n,
                                             "of": AMORTISE_TURNS}),
                         "at": stamp}, the_round)))],
                     "done", call, "")])
    prev = prev_of(plan_of(state), (rows(lg, "p-sum") or [{}])[0])
    as_of = now_ms()
    # The session of the call that started the rebuild (review I-4): the plan
    # names it, so a rebuild is a new epoch for that session alone.
    session = str((rows(lg, "p-call") or [{}])[0].get("session_id") or "")
    # OR-BC.W.3: the handover leaf goes with this rebuild only if it is this
    # round's -- its binding names the round of the rebuild. The leaf of a
    # session of round B fell at a rebuild of round A.
    # GH #949 (review M-4 of GH #943): a leaf bound to NO audience (`null`:
    # `./handover` met an undeclared round -- a round-less session -- or a
    # source from before the rule) is no round's and never fell. It reaches
    # no round, its own session's included (`allowed` refuses an undeclared
    # audience), so no round loses it: it goes with the rebuild of ANY round.
    # Not only with the round `[]`: a `null` from a source before the rule
    # stands in a hive whose calls may all name a round, and that hive never
    # rebuilds `[]`. The claim names the leaf's hash (`finish`).
    hb = leaf_binding(state.get("handover_audience", ""))
    hb_aud = audience_of(hb[1]) if hb is not None else None
    unleaf = hb[0] if hb is not None and hb_aud in (None, round_canon(the_round)) else ""
    # The token rides as `cur_reason` from `rb-claim` on (review M-1 of GH
    # #955): a refused bundle frees the claim only while it holds this token.
    # The trigger's reason stays in the claim itself (`why` in `rb-data`).
    token = str(uuid.uuid4())
    claim = canonical(dict({"reason": reason, "token": token, "at": now(),
                       "call": call, "session": session, "as_of_ms": as_of,
                       "cw": cw_of(state.get("context_window")), "prev": prev,
                       "aim": cw_int(state.get(rkey("aim"))),
                       # GH #1450 Z1.10 (OR-d38-3.c3b.5): the rate of the
                       # brain's row before the tap's copy, as the call counts.
                       "chars_per_token": cut_budget("brain", "brain", state)["rate"],
                       "unleaf": unleaf},
                      # GH #1448 (C2 rule c): only with the knob on, so the
                      # claim of before stays byte for byte.
                      **({"brain_busy": True} if SUMMARIZER_SELF
                         and brain_busy(rows(lg, "p-pend"), session) else {})))
    span = read_from(prev)
    # GH #932 (review I-1): the rebuild reads the rows of its own round only.
    rw = rebuild_where(the_round)
    cols = ["seq", "session_id", "turn_id", "iter", "kind", "hash", "nth", "final", "at"]
    # The round's lock (GH #943): CAS on the row the read found, an insert
    # (the unique index makes it the same CAS) for a round that has none yet.
    ops = [cas_put("c-claim", rkey("rebuild_running"), claim, state),
           ("c-me", sel("state", ["key", "value"], {"key": rkey("rebuild_running")})),
           ("c-wall", sel("wall", cols, dict(span, **rw), [("seq", "asc")])),
           ("c-slots", sel("slots", ["path", "hash", "owner", "at"])),
           ("c-pins", sel("pins", ["hash", "source", "until", "at", "audience_set"], dict(rw)))]
    emit([lstore(ops, "rb-claim", call, token)])

if phase == "rb-claim":
    code = (lg.get("c-claim") or {}).get("error_code", "")
    if code and code != "unique_violation":
        # GH #1225 (A3): the claim was refused, not lost to another trigger:
        # no claim is held, the rebuild stops with its mark.
        report_errors(lg)
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: the store refused the claim of a rebuild (%s) --"
                         " no rebuild, the old window stays (%s)\n" % (code, STORE_ERROR))
        emit([lstore([store_error_mark("e-mark", phase, failed_legs(lg))], "done", call, "")])
    if (lg.get("c-claim") or {}).get("rows_affected", 0) != 1:
        park("another trigger claimed the rebuild first -- merged")
    release_refused(lg, phase, reason)
    info = loads(str((rows(lg, "c-me") or [{}])[0].get("value") or ""), {})
    prev = info.get("prev") or {}
    span = read_from(prev)
    model_pins = sorted(str(p.get("hash") or "") for p in rows(lg, "c-pins")
                        if str(p.get("source") or "") == MODEL_SOURCE)
    needed = sorted({str(r.get("hash") or "") for r in rows(lg, "c-wall")}
                    | {str(r.get("hash") or "") for r in own_slots(rows(lg, "c-slots"),
                                                                  the_rk)}
                    | {str(r.get("hash") or "") for r in rows(lg, "c-pins")}
                    | ({str(prev.get("hash"))} if prev.get("hash") else set()))
    # GH #925: the transcript is gated row by row, so each row brings its
    # audience. GH #932 (review I-1): every read that shapes the plan -- the
    # wall, the topics, the model's marks and pins, the rows it holds --
    # reads the rows of the round of the rebuild alone (`rebuild_where`).
    rw = rebuild_where(the_round)
    # GH #1225 (K-1): with the turn time a row ages by (`row_time`).
    cols = ["seq", "session_id", "turn_id", "iter", "kind", "hash", "nth", "final", "at",
            "audience_set", "turn_at"]
    mcols = ["seq", "session_id", "turn_id", "kind", "value"]
    topic_span = dict(span)
    topic_span["kind"] = "topic"
    # The marks after this round's own cursor (`marks_to_by`; a plan from
    # before it has `marks_to`, the floor of every round): a cursor over all
    # rounds would pass over the marks a round it does not read has said.
    by = prev.get("marks_to_by") if isinstance(prev.get("marks_to_by"), dict) else {}
    cursor = int(by.get(round_canon(the_round), prev.get("marks_to") or 0) or 0)
    ops = [("n-me", sel("state", ["key", "value"],
                        {"key": {"in": [rkey("rebuild_running"), rkey("actions_pending"),
                                        "window_plans", "input_soft",
                                        "summarizer_input_soft"]}})),
           ("n-wall", sel("wall", cols, dict(span, **rw), [("seq", "asc")])),
           ("n-topic", sel("marks", mcols, dict(topic_span, **rw), [("seq", "asc")])),
           # The round a `pin` was said in is part of the pin's audience
           # (review C-1).
           ("n-trim", sel("marks", mcols + ["audience_set"],
                          dict({"kind": {"in": ["release", "pin"]},
                                "seq": {"gt": cursor}}, **rw),
                          [("seq", "asc")])),
           ("n-slots", sel("slots", ["path", "hash", "owner", "at"])),
           ("n-pins", sel("pins", ["hash", "source", "until", "at", "audience_set"], dict(rw)))]
    if needed:
        ops.append(("n-blocks", sel("blocks", ["hash", "kind", "chars", "body"],
                                    {"hash": {"in": needed}})))
    if model_pins:
        ops.append(("n-kept", sel("wall", cols, dict({"hash": {"in": model_pins}}, **rw),
                                  [("seq", "asc")])))
    if SUMMARY_FORM == "brief" and prev.get("summary") and prev.get("hash"):
        # GH #1440: a chained brief counts the wall rows of the brief before
        # as its sources, never that brief's hash (`transcript_of`).
        ops.append(("n-psrc", sel("summaries", ["id", "sources"],
                                  {"id": str(prev.get("summary"))})))
    if SUMMARY_STATE_COND and STATE_LINES > 0:
        # GH #1440 (OR-38-42, OR-d38-2.z3.4): the rows of the state line the
        # summarizer is handed as the list to keep -- the reads of the window's
        # line (`w-smarks`, `w-sdlg`) for the session that started the
        # rebuild; its consult row is the lead's (GH #1447: `lead_errand`
        # below). The pins and their texts ride in `n-pins`/`n-blocks`
        # already. Off, or a role whose cap is 0, no leg: the bundle of before.
        s_sess = str(info.get("session") or "")
        s_marks = round_sel("marks", ["seq", "session_id", "kind", "value", "at",
                                      "audience_set"],
                            {"kind": {"in": ["fact", "gap", "addendum"]},
                             "seq": {"gte": now_ms() // 86400000 * 86400000000}},
                            the_round, s_sess, [("seq", "desc")], STATE_READ)
        if s_marks is not None:
            ops.append(("n-smarks", s_marks))
        if s_sess:
            # OR-d38-3.o15.8: with `delegation_park_by_call` a delegation may
            # be parked under a call id the rebuild never knows (v.25: the
            # strike lifts only `audience_set`) -- the leg reads the whole
            # prefix (one colony, one member) and the audience the row carries
            # decides below. Off, the session's prefix of before.
            ops += [("n-sdlg", sel("state", ["key", "value"],
                                   {"key": {"gt": DELEGATION_KEY + (
                                       "" if DELEGATION_BY_CALL else s_sess + "#")}},
                                   [("key", "asc")], STATE_READ)),
]
        s_dscope = delegation_scope(s_sess, ctx.get("call_id"))
        if s_sess and s_dscope != s_sess and not DELEGATION_BY_CALL:
            # D38 V3: the call's delegation rows beside the session's.
            ops.append(("n-sdlgc", sel("state", ["key", "value"],
                                       {"key": {"gt": DELEGATION_KEY + s_dscope + "#"}},
                                       [("key", "asc")], STATE_READ)))
    if SUMMARIZER_SELF and call and str(info.get("reason") or "cache") != "cache" \
            and not info.get("brain_busy"):
        # GH #1440 (OR-38-42 A1): the record of the round's last call (the
        # fire's own, `rb-probe` dropped any other) -- the prefix the role's
        # model holds in its cache -- and its turn. Off, no leg: the bundle of
        # before. A rebuild for an expired cache (review r1 M1) finds the
        # prefix cold: the role would pay the full price for a prefix that is
        # replaced right after, so the summarizer condenses.
        ops.append(("n-lcall", sel("call_blocks", ["pos", "hash"], {"call_id": call},
                                   [("pos", "asc")])))
        ops.append(("n-lcturn", sel("calls", ["turn_id"], {"call_id": call})))
    if SUMMARY_STATE_COND and STATE_LINES > 0 and str(info.get("session") or ""):
        # GH #1447: the consult row of the state line lives in the lead's
        # store, not in the ledger (the leg `n-sstate` of before): the lead
        # reads it and hands the bundle back with it (`in_lead`, `LEADV` on
        # the reason) -- one round trip, no RAM, the ledger reads unchanged.
        emit([lead_errand(call, str(info.get("session") or ""),
                          lstore(ops, "rb-data", call, reason))])
    emit([lstore(ops, "rb-data", call, reason)])

if phase == "rb-data":
    # GH #1447: the errand the lead handed back (`lead_errand`) rides in
    # front of the claim's token.
    r_lead = {}
    if reason.startswith(LEADV):
        r_lead = lead_of(reason)
        reason = reason_flags(reason)[1]
    release_refused(lg, phase, reason)
    state = state_of(lg, "n-me")
    me = state.get(rkey("rebuild_running"), "")
    info = loads(me, {})
    if not info.get("token"):
        park("the rebuild claim is gone -- dropped")
    prev = info.get("prev") or {}
    blocks = {}
    for r in rows(lg, "n-blocks"):
        blocks.setdefault(str(r.get("hash") or ""), r)
    # GH #1434: the cap `render` cuts a final answer's sidecar block at, from
    # the window the rebuild reads (`input_soft`, the brain's) -- the budget
    # measures such an answer at the text the window sends (`with_cut`).
    cut_cap = budget_chars(state.get("input_soft", ""), SIDECAR_SHARE)

    def enrich(r):
        b = blocks.get(str(r.get("hash") or "")) or {}
        el = element_of(b) or {}
        out = dict(r, chars=int(b.get("chars") or 0), type=str(el.get("type") or ""))
        if el.get("type") == "tool_call":
            try:
                out["name"] = str((json.loads(str(el.get("text") or "{}")) or {}).get("name") or "")
            except Exception:
                out["name"] = ""
        if el.get("type") == "tool_result":
            # GH #1430: what the collection reads off a result -- structure
            # only: an error object, a recall result (the ledger kind
            # `recall` of `./intake` covers the model's own `memory_recall`,
            # the id the ambient one -- review M-1), its rows.
            out["error"] = is_error_result(el.get("text"))
            out["recall"] = str(r.get("kind") or "") == "recall" \
                or ambient_of(el) == "recall"
            if out["recall"]:
                out["lines"] = row_lines(el.get("text"))
        if el.get("valid_until") is not None:
            out["valid_until"] = el.get("valid_until")
        return with_cut(out, el, cut_cap)

    wall = [enrich(r) for r in rows(lg, "n-wall")]
    low = min([int(r["seq"]) for r in wall] or [0])
    kept = [enrich(r) for r in rows(lg, "n-kept") if not wall or int(r["seq"]) < low]
    slots = [(str(r.get("path") or ""), str(r.get("hash") or ""),
              int((blocks.get(str(r.get("hash") or "")) or {}).get("chars") or 0))
             for r in own_slots(rows(lg, "n-slots"), the_rk)]
    result = window_plan(wall, rows(lg, "n-topic"), rows(lg, "n-trim"), rows(lg, "n-pins"),
                         prev, int(info.get("as_of_ms") or now_ms()), slots, kept,
                         int(info.get("cw") or 0), round_canon(the_round),
                         aim=cw_int(info.get("aim")),
                         chars_per_token=rate_of(info.get("chars_per_token")),
                         day_cut=str(info.get("reason") or "") == "day")
    for line in result["notes"]:
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: %s\n" % line)
    plan = result["plan"]
    stamp = now()
    plan["at"] = stamp
    # The session whose call started this rebuild (review I-4): a new epoch
    # for its snapshot alone (`window_epoch`); "" -- a clock refusal -- for all.
    plan["session"] = str(info.get("session") or "")
    # GH #1448 (Z1.6): the blocks of the new plan, built after `window_plan`
    # and read by nothing before the summarizer's request (o9.6); a summary
    # carried on stays the brief, a new one takes its place in `sum`.
    plan["blocks"] = rebuild_blocks(plan, wall + kept, blocks, round_canon(the_round))
    plan["blocks_to"] = max([0] + [int(r.get("seq") or 0) for r in wall + kept])
    carried = str(prev.get("hash") or "") if plan.get("summary") \
        and plan.get("summary") == prev.get("summary") else ""
    plan.update(with_brief(plan, carried, element_of(blocks.get(carried) or {}),
                           round_canon(the_round)))
    # The round's own row `history.summary:<rk>` (`own_slots` shows it as
    # `history.summary`, GH #943).
    info["slot_exists"] = any(p == SUMMARY_PATH for p, _, _ in slots)
    todo = result["todo"]
    why = str(info.get("reason") or reason or "cache")
    pending_actions = state.get(rkey("actions_pending"), "")
    if not todo:
        # Nothing to condense: the plan is the window from now on.
        emit([lstore(finish(info, result, why, pending_actions, me, stamp, state=state),
                     "done", call, reason)])
    if audience_of(the_round) is None:
        # GH #925 (review I-3): a rebuild without a round -- its strike was
        # armed by a call that had none (the round rides with the order,
        # OR-BD.A.6) -- may hand no row's text to a model. It ends like a
        # round that sees none of the rows, for every reason: the plan stands
        # without a summary and the window is cut all the same. Keeping the
        # old window instead would never cut a conversation without a round
        # again, and it would grow until the provider refused it.
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: a rebuild without a round hands no text to a"
                         " model (GH #925) -- the summary is given up\n")
        lines, sources, auds, went = [], [], [], []
    else:
        chain, old_src = result["chain"], None
        if SUMMARY_FORM == "brief":
            # GH #1440: the brief so far and its sources; an unread source
            # list starts the brief anew, never stops the rebuild.
            info["form"] = "brief"
            old_src = brief_sources(lg) if chain else None
            chain = chain and old_src is not None
            pel = element_of(blocks.get(str(prev.get("hash") or "")) or {}) if chain else None
            if pel is not None and allowed(the_round, prev.get("sum_audience")):
                info["prev_text"] = str(pel.get("text") or "")
            elif not result["chain"] and prev.get("hash") \
                    and allowed(the_round, prev.get("sum_audience")):
                # GH #1448 (OR-38-55 a): the brief before goes with its age,
                # its open lines go on -- merged after the answer (`sum`),
                # never in the summarizer's transcript.
                oel = element_of(blocks.get(str(prev.get("hash") or "")) or {}) or {}
                open_lines = [l for l in brief_lines(oel.get("text"))[0] if l["who"] in BRIEF_OPEN]
                if open_lines:
                    info["carry_text"] = brief_render(open_lines)
        lines, sources, auds, went = transcript_of(todo, blocks, prev, chain, the_round,
                                                   SUMMARY_FORM, old_src)
        # R-IG-1 / OR-IG-4: the transcript is the main content of the
        # summarizer's call, half of ITS window (`summarizer_input_soft`), never
        # of the window it condenses; none known, it goes whole.
        lines, t_cuts = fit_transcript(lines, budget_chars(
            state.get("summarizer_input_soft") or SUMMARIZER_SOFT_FALLBACK, TRANSCRIPT_SHARE))
        if t_cuts:
            info["cuts"] = t_cuts
        if SUMMARY_STATE_COND and STATE_LINES > 0 and sources:
            # GH #1440 (OR-38-42): the state of the round as the list the
            # summary must keep, behind the cut transcript so the cut never
            # meets it (`fit_transcript` cuts the longest lines). A refused
            # state leg never gets here: `release_refused` ends the chain.
            s_rows = dict((str(r.get("key") or ""), str(r.get("value") or ""))
                          for r in rows(lg, "n-sdlg") + rows(lg, "n-sdlgc"))
            if DELEGATION_BY_CALL:
                s_rows = rebuild_delegations(s_rows, str(info.get("session") or ""),
                                             the_round)
            s_pend = r_lead.get("pending")
            if isinstance(s_pend, dict) and s_pend:
                s_rows[ERRAND_ROW + str(info.get("session") or "")] = canonical(s_pend)
            s_texts = dict((h, str((element_of(b) or {}).get("text") or ""))
                           for h, b in blocks.items())
            s_marks = sorted(rows(lg, "n-smarks"), key=lambda r: -int(r.get("seq") or 0))
            s_line = state_block(state_of_rows(s_marks, rows(lg, "n-pins"), s_texts, s_rows,
                                               the_round, str(info.get("session") or ""),
                                               epoch_ms(stamp) or now_ms(), day_of(stamp),
                                               None, str(ctx.get("call_id") or ""),
                                               names_list(ctx.get("needs"))),
                                 STATE_COND_PARTS, STATE_LINES)
            if s_line:
                lines = lines + ["", STATE_COND_HEAD, s_line]
        if not sources:
            sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: the round sees none of the rows to condense"
                             " -- the summary is given up\n")
    if not sources:
        # Nothing to condense for this round: the plan stands without a
        # summary -- window_plan's own give-up.
        result = dict(result, todo=[], chain=False,
                      plan=with_brief(dict(plan, summary="", sum_from=0, sum_to=0), "", None,
                                      round_canon(the_round)))
        emit([lstore(finish(info, result, why, pending_actions, me, stamp, state=state),
                     "done", call, reason)])
    # What the summary's head names (review M-1): the newest row that WENT
    # IN, or -- made of a chained summary alone -- what that one named. Not
    # `sum_to`: that may be a row this round may not see, and a `seq` is its
    # time. `covers_to_seq` keeps `sum_to`, the plan's own pointer.
    shown = [int(r.get("seq") or 0) for r in went]
    if str(prev.get("hash") or "") in sources or info.get("prev_text"):
        shown.append(int(prev.get("sum_shown") or 0))
    # The summary reaches whom every source reaches AND the round it was made
    # for (review R2-I-3): the rows went in because THIS round may see them,
    # so a wider round that sees them all would see the summary only as long
    # as no row it may not see went in -- whether it appears would hang on a
    # hidden row (driver: {e,a,b} saw the summary of an {e,a} rebuild over
    # {e,a,b} rows, and lost it when one {e,a} row was among them).
    # The span the head names is the time of the turns that went in
    # (`row_time`, GH #1225 K-1): on a replayed wall the ingest `at` is the
    # minute of the replay, not the week the summary condenses.
    info.update({"result": result, "transcript": "\n".join(lines),
                 "covers_to_seq": int(plan.get("sum_to") or 0), "sources": sources,
                 "shown_to": max(shown or [0]),
                 "audience": meet_of_rows(auds + [the_round]),
                 "first_at": str(row_time(went[0]) or "") if went else "",
                 "last_at": str(row_time(went[-1]) or "") if went else ""})
    send_ops = []
    if SUMMARIZER_SELF and not info.get("brain_busy"):
        # GH #1440 (OR-38-42 A1): the role condenses itself -- its last call's
        # blocks in `pos` order (system leaves and messages, the gh888 record)
        # and the answer that call got (the newest final answer on the wall,
        # its turn's final rows). Without the call's record the summarizer
        # condenses as before (OR-d38-2.z3.13).
        c_hashes = [str(r.get("hash") or "") for r in
                    sorted(rows(lg, "n-lcall"), key=lambda r: int(r.get("pos") or 0))]
        finals = [r for r in sorted(wall, key=lambda r: int(r.get("seq") or 0))
                  if str(r.get("kind") or "") == "assistant" and int(r.get("final") or 0) == 1
                  and (not info.get("session")
                       or str(r.get("session_id") or "") == str(info.get("session")))]
        a_turn = (str(finals[-1].get("session_id") or ""), str(finals[-1].get("turn_id") or "")) \
            if finals else ("", "")
        a_hashes = [str(r.get("hash") or "") for r in finals
                    if (str(r.get("session_id") or ""), str(r.get("turn_id") or "")) == a_turn]
        # Review r1 M3: after a tool round the newest final answer is the one
        # of the turn before -- prefix and answer would not belong together;
        # the summarizer condenses.
        c_turn = str((rows(lg, "n-lcturn") or [{}])[0].get("turn_id") or "")
        if c_hashes and c_turn and c_turn == a_turn[1]:
            info["self"] = {"call": c_hashes, "answer": a_hashes, "turn": a_turn[1]}
            send_ops.append(("n-cblk", sel("blocks", ["hash", "kind", "body"],
                                           {"hash": {"in": sorted(set(c_hashes + a_hashes))}})))
            # Review z3 r2 m1 (class GH #925/#1247): the self call sets the
            # role's tree back the moment it leaves; a call built while the role
            # condenses would diff against the hashes of before and leave a
            # family out. Cleared here, before the send (`s-sent0` clears again
            # after the calls of the window).
            send_ops += put("n-sent0", "system_hash_sent", "{}")
    # The claim's token rides as the reason to `rb-send`, out to the
    # summarizer and home on `in_summary` (the context carries `cur_reason`),
    # so the answer is kept only under the claim it was asked for (review
    # M-10, R2-I-14).
    emit([lstore([("r-note", upd("state", {"value": canonical(info)},
                                 {"key": rkey("rebuild_running"), "value": me})),
                  ("r-me", sel("state", ["key", "value"], {"key": rkey("rebuild_running")}))]
                 + send_ops,
                 "rb-send", call, str(info.get("token") or ""))])

if phase == "rb-send":
    release_refused(lg, phase, reason)
    info = loads(str((rows(lg, "r-me") or [{}])[0].get("value") or ""), {})
    if (lg.get("r-note") or {}).get("rows_affected", 0) != 1 or not info.get("transcript"):
        park("the rebuild note is gone -- dropped")
    head = {"route": "summarize"}
    if info.get("cuts"):
        # Every line this hive cut in the transcript, said on the hop (R-IG-1).
        head["cuts"] = info["cuts"]
    prompt = SUMMARY_PROMPT_BRIEF if info.get("form") == "brief" else SUMMARY_PROMPT
    own = info.get("self") or {}
    if own:
        # GH #1440 (OR-38-42 A1, `summarizer_self` "1"): ONE call on the
        # role's own way `brain`, after its answer and outside the hot path:
        # the last call's system (every family whole -- the `llm` keeps one
        # tree, another round's call may have changed it since), its messages
        # as the prefix, the answer it got, and the instruction last. The
        # provider's prefix cache holds all but the tail, so the role
        # condenses at the cached price (arXiv 2611.05306 § 4 A1). The answer
        # comes home on `in_summary_self` (talky, `hop.summarize` "1") and is
        # never said. No `x_title` here: the role's `llm` cell carries it.
        blk = dict((str(r.get("hash") or ""), r) for r in rows(lg, "n-cblk"))
        leaves, msgs, lost = [], [], []
        for h in own.get("call") or []:
            el = element_of(blk.get(h) or {})
            if el is None:
                lost.append(h)
            elif str((blk.get(h) or {}).get("kind") or "") == "system":
                leaves.append((str(el.get("path") or ""), str(el.get("text") or ""), h))
            else:
                msgs.append(el)
        answer = [el for el in (element_of(blk.get(h) or {}) for h in own.get("answer") or [])
                  if el is not None]
        if lost:
            sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: %d block(s) of the last call are gone -- the"
                             " summarizer condenses (GH #1440)\n" % len(lost))
        else:
            head = dict(head, route="brain", summarize="1", summary_call=call,
                        summary_token=str(info.get("token") or ""), curator_call=call,
                        session_id=str(info.get("session") or ""),
                        turn_id=str(own.get("turn") or ""), iter="0")
            out = {"header": head,
                   "messages": msgs + answer + [{
                       "origin": "user", "type": "text",
                       "text": SELF_SUMMARY_HEAD + "\n\n" + prompt + "\n\n"
                       + info["transcript"]}]}
            # The gated and the session families go whole and empty included,
            # as on every call of the hot path (`win`, GH #925).
            fams = sorted({p.split(".")[0] for p, _, _ in leaves}
                          | set(GATED_FAMILIES + SESSION_FAMILIES))
            out["system"] = {f: family_node(f, leaves) for f in fams}
            emit([out])
    emit([{"header": head,
           "system": {"instructions": {"text": SUMMARY_PROMPT_BRIEF
                                       if info.get("form") == "brief" else SUMMARY_PROMPT}},
           "messages": [{"origin": "user", "type": "text", "text": info["transcript"]}]}])

if phase == "sum":
    if failed_legs(lg, ("s-read", "s-put")):
        # GH #1225 (A3): the claim or the answer is out of reach -- read as
        # empty, the claim stayed held until it went stale. It is freed by its
        # token (the reason, as from `rb-claim` on); the parked answer waits
        # for the sweep.
        release_refused(lg, phase, reason)
    state = state_of(lg, "s-read")
    raw = state.get(rkey("rebuild_running"), "")
    info = loads(raw, {})
    payload = loads(state.get(rkey("pending:summary"), ""), {})
    drop = ("s-drop", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                       "where": {"key": rkey("pending:summary")}})
    if not info.get("sources"):
        emit([lstore([drop], "done", call, reason)])
    if not reason or reason != str(info.get("token") or ""):
        # An answer asked for under ANOTHER claim (review M-10, R2-I-14): a
        # rebuild whose claim went stale (REBUILD_STALE_S) answers while the
        # next one holds the lock. Kept, the words of the round the old
        # transcript was made for would stand under the new claim's sources
        # and audience; it is dropped, and the running claim waits for its
        # own answer.
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: a summary asked for under another claim"
                         " -- dropped (GH #925)\n")
        emit([lstore([drop], "done", call, reason)])
    pending_actions = state.get(rkey("actions_pending"), "")
    text = str(payload.get("text") or "")
    why = str(info.get("reason") or reason or "cache")
    failure = ""
    brief_marks = []
    if payload.get("finish") != "stop":
        failure = "finish_reason %s %s" % (payload.get("finish") or "?",
                                          payload.get("error_code") or "")
    elif not text.strip():
        failure = "an empty summary"
    elif info.get("form") == "brief":
        # GH #1440 (OR-38-42, OR-d38-2.z3.6): only lines of the form stay;
        # none -- the old window stays -- or some dropped, the mark says it.
        new, dropped = brief_lines(text)
        if dropped:
            mstamp = now()
            brief_marks.append(("s-rej", ins("marks", with_audience({
                "seq": epoch_us(mstamp), "session_id": str(info.get("session") or ""),
                "turn_id": "", "kind": "summary_rejected",
                "value": canonical({"kept": len(new), "dropped": dropped}),
                "at": mstamp}, the_round))))
        if not new:
            failure = "summary_rejected: no line of the form"
        else:
            srcs = info.get("sources") or []
            text = brief_render(brief_merge(brief_lines(info.get("prev_text")
                                                        or info.get("carry_text"))[0],
                                            brief_point(new, srcs, srcs[-1] if srcs else ""))[0])
    if not failure:
        leaf = (SUMMARY_HEAD % (int(info.get("shown_to") or 0), info.get("first_at") or "?",
                                info.get("last_at") or "?") + "\n" + text)
        size = len(json.dumps({"text": leaf}, ensure_ascii=False,
                              separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8"))
        if size > LEAF_MAX_BYTES:
            failure = "too_long: %d > %d bytes" % (size, LEAF_MAX_BYTES)
    if not failure and payload.get("self"):
        # GH #1440 (OR-38-42 A1): one ledger mark per summary the role's own
        # model wrote (`summarizer_self`), past the seq of `summary_rejected`.
        mstamp = now()
        brief_marks.append(("s-self", ins("marks", with_audience({
            "seq": epoch_us(mstamp) + 1, "session_id": str(info.get("session") or ""),
            "turn_id": "", "kind": "summary_self",
            "value": canonical(dict(payload.get("tokens") or {}, call=call, why=why,
                                    model=str(payload.get("model") or ""))),
            "at": mstamp}, the_round))))
    if failure:
        # OR-KX-K6: the window stays what it was; the next call says so.
        emit([lstore(old_window_kept(raw, pending_actions, why, failure, state) + brief_marks
                     + [drop],
                     "done", call, reason)])
    stamp = now()
    summary = {"type": "summary", "text": text}
    h = block_hash(summary)
    sid = str(uuid.uuid4())
    covers = int(info.get("covers_to_seq") or 0)
    # The head names what went in (review M-1); the row keeps the plan's cover.
    shown = int(info.get("shown_to") or 0)
    rendered = (SUMMARY_HEAD % (shown, info.get("first_at") or "?", info.get("last_at") or "?")
                + "\n" + text)
    slot_el = {"path": SUMMARY_PATH, "text": rendered}
    sh = block_hash(slot_el)
    ops = [block_put("s-b1", h, "summary", len(text), canonical(summary), stamp),
           block_put("s-b2", sh, "system", len(rendered), canonical(slot_el), stamp),
           # GH #925 (OR-BD-3): the summary reaches a round only where every
           # source it was made of would have -- the meet `rb-data` noted.
           ("s-row", ins("summaries", with_meet({
               "id": sid, "covers_to_seq": covers, "hash": h,
               "sources": info.get("sources") or [],
               "model": str(payload.get("model") or ""), "at": stamp}, info.get("audience"))))]
    # The round's own slot `history.summary:<rk>` (GH #943, OR-BC.W.2); its
    # block is the leaf `history.summary` the window shows (`own_slots`).
    # One write whatever the claim read (`slot_put`, GH #1225).
    ops.append(slot_put("s-slot", rkey(SUMMARY_PATH), sh, stamp))
    # The summary leaf's audience, bound to the leaf's hash and PUT whole
    # beside the slot (review R2-I-4): the store does not roll a failed leg
    # back, so read off the newest `summaries` row, a bundle whose slot leg
    # failed left the old summary under the new one's audience, and one whose
    # row leg failed left the new summary under the old one's -- the window
    # shows the leaf only where this hash is the slot's.
    ops += put("s-aud", rkey("summary_audience"), canonical(
        {"audience": info.get("audience"), "hash": sh}))
    result = dict(info.get("result") or {})
    result["plan"] = with_brief(dict(result.get("plan") or {}, summary=sid, sum_shown=shown),
                                h, summary, round_canon(the_round))
    ops = finish(info, result, why, pending_actions, raw, stamp, ops + brief_marks,
                 ["summary:" + sid], state=state)
    emit([lstore(ops + [drop], "done", call, reason)])

if phase == "swept":
    # A13: the parked rows past their age are down (or were parked anew, or
    # another cell swept them first). The mark names the rows that went; a
    # refused delete is said as a `store_error` mark beside it. The answer to
    # those marks comes back here without keys and ends the chain.
    report_errors(lg)
    keys = loads(reason, [])
    keys = [str(k) for k in keys] if isinstance(keys, list) else []
    ops = swept_mark(lg, keys) if keys else []
    q_failed = failed_legs(lg, ["q-d%d" % i for i in range(len(keys))])
    if q_failed:
        ops.append(store_error_mark("q-err", phase, q_failed))
    if ops:
        emit([lstore(ops, "swept", call, "")])
    emit([])

park("store answer in unknown phase %r -- dropped" % phase)

role.description: The role whose presets the window follows (GH #892): `talky`, `consult`, `coding`, `research`, `quick` (the short window, GH #1247), or empty for none -- the window of curator 1.0.0 (the whole wall after the last summary, `keep_recent` rounds raw, no short ids). Every knob below that is set wins over its preset; null or empty means the preset. An unknown role is said on stderr and runs as none.

quick_tools.description: GH #1260 (OR-WG-1): the tools the quick way's class is for, comma separated, names after the collector's fold (`web` = web_search + web_fetch). Allowed on every quick call at the ops stage -- the whole schema, callable; a stamped family outside them joins at the hint stage; the channel's own allow still cuts. Empty: only the stamp's families, at the hint stage.

recall_by_needs.description: GH #1441 (RK-38-7, OR-38-2), GH #1448 (OR-38-65 b): `1` or true = a brain call of a stamped turn whose route stamp does not name `memory` in `needs` lowers the prio of the running round's recall block to `block_prio.recall_unneeded`; the recall stays in the window whole -- never dropped for the stamp alone, stage 2 cuts it first under budget pressure. A `talk` turn whose stamp is a fallback (`hop.fallback`) keeps its prio (A11), so does a turn without a path; the collector carries `hop.fallback` only with its knob `needs_no_recall` on, so switch both together. Only the running round on the `brain` way. `0` (the default) = the window of before.

recall_in_wall.description: D38 V5 (GH #1451): 1 = stage 1 leaves out a recall block whose every row quotes a raw user/assistant turn of the window (sha256 of the bytes); a recall of a turn outside the wall stays a block. 0 (shipped) = the plan of before.

keep_recent.description: How many of the newest rounds (one session and turn each) a rebuild leaves raw, whatever their segment's tier. Preset: 12 without a role, talky 40, consult 10, coding 20, research 10. Numeric strings are read as numbers.

keep_recent_tokens.description: GH #1427: the raw token budget -- the youngest rounds whose estimated size together is at most this many tokens stay raw, across session and day boundaries, never below `keep_recent` rounds, never above the aim of the rebuild less the system part. null or 0 = off (the floor alone). Preset: talky 80000, every other role null. Numeric strings are read as numbers.

compress_at.description: Without the answering model's package (`input_soft`, GH #1038), a rebuild is ordered when a call's `tokens_prompt` reaches this share of the model's own window. With one it keeps the aim of a rebuild in proportion to `input_soft`. Preset 0.5; coding and research 0.4.

rebuild_to.description: The share of the usable window a rebuild aims at. Over it, the rebuild shrinks old tool results (outside `keep_rounds`), then stubs tools unused for `stub_tools_after` rounds, then gives the summary up -- in that order. 0 = no aim. Preset 0 without a role, talky 0.45 (GH #1427), consult 0.35, coding and research 0.25.

horizon.description: How the wall is cut into segments: `day` (UTC calendar days), `task` (a `topic` mark start/end out of the memory section, and a day change, opens a segment), `all` (one segment: the rolling window of 1.0.0). Preset `all` without a role, talky `day`, the others `task`.

tiers.description: The form of a segment by its age, comma-separated, the last one for every older segment: `raw`, `summary` or `none`. Preset `raw,summary` without a role and for consult and coding, talky `raw,summary,none` (today raw, yesterday summarised, older nothing), research `raw,none`.

keep_rounds.description: How many of the newest tool iterations keep their results raw when a rebuild is over its aim -- with `gc` "1" at every rebuild (GH #1430); older results shrink to their id and one line (`history_read` brings them back), an error result never. 0 = never shrink. Preset 0 without a role, talky 1, consult 2, coding 3, research 1.

gc.description: GH #1430 (R-38-2): "1" = the garbage collection runs at every rebuild -- old tool results shrink regardless of the aim, a recall result whose row a younger raw one repeats shrinks, the scaffold of a closed delegation shrinks; "0" = the behaviour of before (tool results shrink only over the aim). Never an error result, never the person's words. Preset "1" for talky, "0" for every other role. Every rebuild writes one `gc` mark either way.

gc_scaffold.description: GH #1430 (A4): "0" switches the scaffold class of the collection off alone -- the inner `(advice)`/`(delegation)` rows of a closed delegation stay raw; the rest of the collection runs. Preset "1" for every role.

stub_tools_after.description: When a rebuild is still over its aim: a tool no call named in this many newest rounds is declared by its name and one line, `parameters` an empty object schema. 0 = never. Preset 0 without a role, talky and coding 20, consult and research 10.

window_target.description: GH #1272: the window in tokens at which the role orders a rebuild of its own (mark `target`), under the model's input_soft and without a package too; its aim is window_target x rebuild_to / compress_at, never above a soft rebuild's. 0 = off. Preset: talky 100000 (GH #1427), quick 12000, every other role 0. Numeric strings are read as numbers.

notes_share.description: GH #1303: the share of the usable window (the answering model's input_soft, at 3 characters per token) the notes block may take -- the block of `in_note` notes and `context.turn_notes` that opens the newest message of the person; over it the notes of the lowest priority are left out and said (`marks` `notes`, `hop.cuts`). 0 = no note is shown. Preset: talky 0.02, every other role 0 (quick included). Numeric strings are read as numbers.

broadcast_mode.description: Where a pin of another hive (`in_pin`) stands: `tail` -- as a message where it arrived until the next rebuild moves it into the system part (`pinned.<source>.<id>`), so a warm cache keeps its prefix -- or `system` at once. Preset `tail`.

recall_push.description: "1": the curator pushes an enriched recall ask for every turn (GH #895); empty or "0": off. Preset "1" for talky, off otherwise.

recall_budget.description: The longest recall ask the push sends, in characters (GH #895). Preset 200 for talky (the recall cell keeps no more of an ask, `memory-hive` `query_safe_chars`), 0 otherwise.

short_ids.description: "1": somebody else's words and a tool result begin with the block's short id `[#<12 hex>] ` in the window, so the model can release or pin it and read it back; the model's own answers and tool calls never do. Preset "1" for every role, off without one.

identity_budget.description: How the identity reaches the model (GH #935): `full` -- the whole identity in the system part, as before -- or `split`: the system part carries only the short form an identity pusher holds at `identity_short` (as the `identity` family), in every call; the whole identity is ONE element at the head of the window, taken at call 1, after a rebuild and after a renewal of the call's own session (and anew for another session or round), and sent byte for byte the same until the next of these, so the provider's prefix cache keeps it -- a later call takes no new snapshot, and the element is never trimmed. `split` without a short form runs as `full` and marks `identity_short_missing` once per session. Any other value keeps the preset and is said on stderr. Preset `full` for every role.

context_window.description: The model's context window in tokens when the tap does not report `hop.context_window`. 0 = unknown: without the package's `input_soft` there is then no compress trigger -- the cold cache alone orders a rebuild. No role caps the window (GH #1085).

input_soft_fallback.description: The summarizer's window in tokens before it has shown one (OR-IG-8, GH #1085): the `input_soft` of the catalogue row `input_soft_fallback_row` names, the model the curator's `./summarizer` is born on (OR-IG-9). That model is a birth token (`ctx.model`), and the llm-registry's tier for it is `light`, `openai/gpt-6-luna`. The summarizer's transcript is half of it; the stamp on its answers and a refusal over its bound replace it. Null or empty: no window known, the transcript goes whole.

input_soft_fallback_row.description: The catalogue row (`model_id` in `llm-registry/store/seed/models.jsonl`) whose `input_soft` `input_soft_fallback` is: the model the curator's `./summarizer` is born on -- a birth token (`ctx.model`) whose llm-registry tier for a small summarizer is `light` (OR-IG-9, GH #1085). A label for the reader and for the drift lock `gh1085_fallback_windows_match_the_catalog`, which holds the two together; the script does not read it. A receiver born on another model sets both.

amortise_turns.description: The turns one rebuild has to pay itself back in (GH #1038). Under the answering model's `input_soft`, a window is rebuilt when keeping its cached rest for this many turns costs more than one rebuild: `(window - aim) * cost_cached_in * N > aim * cost_in`, the prices and the soft limit out of the model's package (`hop.cost_in`, `hop.cost_cached_in`, `hop.input_soft`, stamped by the llm cell), the aim `input_soft` times `rebuild_to` / `compress_at`. Without those values the rule does not apply. Null, empty or below 1 means 10. Numeric strings are read as numbers.

max_round_plans.description: How many rounds the hive keeps a window plan for (GH #943): every round has a plan of its own, keyed by its `round_key`, and a rebuild that would leave more than this many drops the plans of the rounds whose last rebuild is oldest -- never its own -- and with each plan what its round owns: its state rows and its summary slot (GH #949). Null, empty or below 1 means 64. Numeric strings are read as numbers.

round_plan_idle_s.description: How long, in seconds, a round's window plan outlives the round's last rebuild (GH #943); a rebuild of any round drops the plans idle for longer, with what their rounds own (GH #949). A window without a rebuild lives no longer than the provider's cache, so the last rebuild is the last use. Null, empty or 0 means 2592000 (30 days). Numeric strings are read as numbers.

pending_sweep_s.description: GH #1225 (A13): a parked `pending:*` row of the ledger's `state` older than this many seconds (its `parked_at`) is taken down by the probe of the next rebuild, said as one `pending_swept` mark naming the rows that went -- on an event that comes anyway, never a timer of its own. A row without `parked_at` stays. Null, empty, zero or text = 600; below 60 counts as 60.

clarify_note.default: The person's words of this turn can be meant in more than one way. Answer with one short question about how they mean it -- guess nothing and answer nothing yet.
clarify_note.description: GH #1279: the turn note of a turn the route stamped `clarify` (a set that leads the class): its words can be meant in more than one way, so the brain asks one short question how the person means it and guesses nothing. A note of scope `turn`, source `curator`, priority 0, shown under `notes_share` like every note. A clarify turn goes to the brain whatever `path_routes` says -- no quick voice, a spec answer dropped, no tool (`tool_scope` `{allow: []}`, the channel's deny kept), no frozen system part of the turn. Empty: the turn goes that way without a note. Without a `clarify` stamp nothing of this is written (each first curate reads the one key `clarify:<session>`). The pair of a clarify turn -- the assistant's question (its final answer to the clarify turn, sidecar block left out), the person's words of the session's next turn and the path that turn's stamp resolved to -- goes to the affinity as ONE `propose` (route `propose`, a `tool_call` turn `{op: propose, id, source_ref, entity_ref, field_path: mx.hints.clarify, value: {question, answer, class, session_id, asked_turn, answered_turn}}`, `entity_ref` the round's one entry that is no `agent:`), exactly once: the row `clarify:<session>` is taken by key and value first.

place.description: GH #1279: where the person is, as a set renders it from the profile (`Berlin`). With it (or `timezone`) every call of `./quick` -- the quick way, a spec call, a bridge -- carries the slot `frame`: now (the call's stamp in `timezone`) and this place, facts only. Empty (the default) with `timezone` empty: no `frame`. The brain never gets it.

timezone.description: GH #1279: the IANA zone the `frame` slot of `./quick` says the time in (`Europe/Berlin`); empty with a `place` = UTC, a zone this python does not know = UTC and said on stderr. Empty (the default) with `place` empty: no `frame`.

now_utc.description: D38 V2 (GH #1451, review o15-Rv1 m3): a fixed instant (RFC 3339, UTC) for the day of the open wellbeing (`wellbeing_day`), the lab clock `./history` reads too, so seed and feed see one day. "" (the default) reads the clock.

quick_instructions_slot.description: GH #1279: `1` or true = a slot `instructions.quick` (the quick prompt a set renders) is the quick voice's instructions: on every call of `./quick` -- the quick way, a spec call, a bridge -- it stands in for the other leaves of `instructions` (the brain's prompt) and for the fixed leaf of GH #1248 (one short sentence beside a tool call); the sidecar contract and the session's own slots (`instructions.mode`, `instructions.peer`) stay, and the tool round keeps the slot (it is the quick voice's prompt, not the sentence beside the call). `0` (the default) = the quick voice's leaves as before, the slot among them. The brain never gets `instructions.quick`, whatever this says: it reads the whole `instructions` family.

live_feed.description: GH #1279: `1` or true = after each closed turn of a duplex session (the turn's seam carries `engine` "duplex" and its `call_id`) ONE `live_feed` leaves with `hop.section` = `live_feed_section` (with `renew` also `hop.at_turn_end` "1": the voice cell renews at the next turn boundary and then asks for the seed), `hop.call_id`, when the facts a seed of the call carries moved since the call's last seed or feed -- the same facts `./history` puts into the seed (one rule, `seed_fact_state`): `notes` (new session and until notes, `{source, id, text}`), `inner_turns` (new advice, delegation and event turns, `{turn_id, kind}`), `topic` (the newest named topic -- a nameless `continue` mark is no topic, an `end` mark ends it), `screen_topics` (the screen's topic names, when the table moved). No instruction; nothing moved, nothing sent; a text turn sends nothing. The facts of the last seed (written by `./history`) or feed (written here) of a call are the state row `seed_facts:<call>`; a call without one compares against nothing. The facts themselves reach the voice through the next seed; the feed is the signal. `0` (the default) = nothing of this is read or written.

live_feed_section.description: GH #1279: `hop.section` of a `live_feed` -- `renew` alone (the voice renews its session at the turn's end and takes the facts from the next seed; the way built). Any other value is read as `renew` and said on stderr (#1370): a `context` section carries no `payload` and no `text`, and the voice cell answers it `bad_section`.

horizon_advise.description: GH #1400: `1` or true = a duplex call's turn (its seam carries `engine` "duplex" and its `call_id`) that gets a tool round or a delegation (a turn with a bridge: the tool round of a `simple` turn, way `consult` or `research`) sends ONE `live_feed` with `hop.section` `horizon` and no `hop.at_turn_end` (the voice says it at once on a quiet line, while the model speaks at the end of that section), `hop.call_id`, `hop.session_id`, `hop.turn_id` and a body of numbers only: `seconds` (rounded up), `way`, `family` -- never words; the sentence is the voice's `duplex.gpt_live.horizon_text`. The seconds are the `horizon_quantile` of the rounds of the turn's family booked so far, else `horizon_defaults_ms[family]`, else nothing is sent; a turn with several families takes the longest, a turn without a family counts under its way. The horizon goes with the round's own sends (held with them for an awaited spec answer, gone when the round never goes). Each closed horizon turn books its duration (seam to answer, ms) under its family in the state row `horizon_rounds` (the newest 20 per family). Marks `horizon_sent {seconds, family}` and, at the answer, `horizon_hit {planned, actual}` (seconds). `0` (the default) = nothing of this is read, written or sent.

horizon_defaults_ms.description: GH #1400: with `horizon_advise` on, the expected duration of a round per family (or way) before any is booked, a JSON object family -> milliseconds (`{"web": 4000}`); a value that is no positive number is said on stderr and left out. `{}` (the default) = no horizon until a round of the family is booked.

horizon_quantile.description: GH #1400: the percentile (nearest rank) of the booked rounds of a family that a horizon says, 51 to 100; anything else is said on stderr and read as 75. Never the median: a wait said too short is worse than one said too long.

fact_from_tool.description: GH #1407: tools or families (a list or one comma-separated string, `weather`, `web_search`) whose result is the turn's fact at once: on a duplex call's turn (`engine` "duplex", its `call_id`, no spec call) the first tool result of a listed tool whose JSON carries a non-empty `summary` sends ONE `live_feed` with `hop.section` `fact`, `hop.fact_source` "tool" and the summary as `payload` -- the body of the splitter's sidecar -- right after the result, not after the second model round; round 2 still runs for the answer (the voice drops a later `fact` of the same `hop.turn_id`). At most one per turn (claim `pending:fact_tool:<session>#<turn>`), mark `fact_from_tool {tool}`. A failed or error result is never a fact. `""` (the default) = nothing read or written.

topic_aging.description: GH #1436: "1" lets the topic age -- one rule in `./history` (the topic handed to the route stamp, the judge and a seed) and `./policy` (the topic of a call's live feed): it frames no turn of a call opened after it was named, none of a session it was not last named in, and none once `topic_age_turns` turns passed without a renewed mention. "0" (the default) = the reads and answers as before, byte for byte.

delegation_park_by_call.description: D38 V3 (GH #1451): "1" keys the park of a delegation by the duplex call and the turn label (pending:delegation:<call_id>#<label>), which both rounds carry; "0" the key of before (the session).

topic_age_turns.description: GH #1436: with `topic_aging` "1" the turns without a renewed mention after which a topic frames no turn any more; counted by the person's rows on the wall (one per turn), not by marks.

topic_age_rows.description: GH #1436: with `topic_aging` "1" the bound of the read that counts the turns since the topic was named (the person's rows, newest first); a read that comes back full without reaching the naming counts as `topic_age_turns` turns. Keep it above `topic_age_turns`.

wellbeing_line.description: D38 V2 (GH #1451): "1" = the live feed of a call carries the open wellbeing of the day as one line of data, by the same function `wellbeing_line` as the seed of `./history` (one digest with the seed). "0" = the feed as it was.

wellbeing_min_confidence.description: D38 V2 (GH #1451): the least confidence of a fact that opens the wellbeing line (a mark without one passes); the preset of `./history`; only with `wellbeing_line` "1".

wellbeing_rows.description: D38 V2 (GH #1451): with `wellbeing_line` "1" the bound of the live feed's read of the day's `fact` and `wellbeing` marks, newest first; the preset of `./history`.

state_block.description: GH #1439: `1` or true = the window of a speaking way opens the person's newest message with one state line, first in the notes block: the open topic, the companion's open promises (`commitment` pins), the open errands (a delegation, a consult, a gap) and the facts set today (`fact` marks), at most `state_lines` entries; with the handover in the window, topic and promises are left to it. `0` (the default) = the window of before.

state_lines.description: GH #1439: the state line (`state_block`) names at most this many entries, the topic one of them, cut from the end. null = the preset: talky 8, every other role 0; 0 = no line. Numeric strings are read as numbers.

state_one_per_subject.description: D38 V1 (GH #1451): "1" keeps of the facts of one (subject, predicate), both set, only the youngest mark in the state line; a key with an empty half stays as before. "0": every fact of the day.

state_scheduled_on_need.description: D38 V1 (GH #1451): "1" shows a fact marked fact_kind foresight (intake fact_mark_kind "1") in the state line only in a turn whose stamp needs memory or orga, on the turn path and in the rebuild. "0": the line of before.

notes_latest_per_item.description: D38 V1 (GH #1451): "1" reads notes.item and keeps of the notes of one (source, item) only the youngest (at, then note_id) in the window; a note without an item stays. "0": the read and block of before.

summary_form.description: GH #1440 (D38 Z3, OR-38-42): the form a rebuild asks the summarizer for. `brief` = a handover brief: one line per item, `- <who> (<YYYY-MM-DD>)[ <subject>/<predicate>]: <statement>[ [<stance>]][ [superseded <YYYY-MM-DD>]][ [#<id>]]`, speakers `person`, `agent:self`, `peer:<ref>` and the kinds `topic`, `promised`, `open`, `dead_end`, `intent`; the answer is parsed line by line, an answer without one such line is rejected (old window kept, mark `summary_rejected` with `{kept, dropped}`; a mixed answer keeps its lines and says the rest in the same mark), a newer line with the same speaker and key replaces the older one in place, marked `[superseded <old date>]`, every line points at a source row of its summary, and `sources` are wall rows only. `prose` (the default, also any other value) = the chronicle of before, byte-identical.

summary_state_cond.description: GH #1440 (D38 Z3, OR-38-42): `1` or true = the transcript a rebuild hands the summarizer ends with the round's state block (promises, open points, facts set today; never the topic) as lines to keep, capped like the role's state lines; independent of `summary_form`. `0` (the default) = no list, the request of before.

summarizer_self.description: GH #1440 (D38 Z3, OR-38-42): `1` or true = a rebuild asks the role's own answer model to condense, after its answer, on the cached prefix of its last call; the answer is never spoken and never a wall row, and the summary carries the mark `summary_self`. Only compositions that wire the way back carry it. GH #1448: only while `brain` is free -- a turn of the session parked, waiting for its call, hands the summary to `./summarizer`. `0` (the default) = `./summarizer` as before.

block_prio.description: GH #1448 (D38 C2): the priority of a building block of the window plan by its kind, a JSON object kind -> whole number (higher = kept longer when stage 2 cuts for budget); a kind it does not name takes `default`, a value that is no whole number is left out. `recall_unneeded` is the recall bundle of a turn whose stamp needs no memory (`recall_by_needs`). The preset: the person's words and the answers 90, a brief 80, tool calls and results 70, state and notes 60, recall and push 40, an unneeded recall and stubs 20, the frame 100, every other kind 50.

snapshot_keep.description: GH #1448 (D38 C2, R-38-4 Nr. 5): how many plan snapshots a round keeps -- one row per call in the ledger table `snapshots` (the call's block ids with their prio and tokens), read through `./reader` (`what: "snapshots"`) behind the round's audience; the oldest beyond go when a call writes its own. Null, empty or below 1 means 32.

catalog_ask.description: GH #1450 (D38 C3b, OR-d38-3.c3b.1): `1` or true = a call to a model cell whose catalogue row (`in_catalog`) the policy does not hold asks that cell once per session for it -- one message `catalog_ask` (hop `catalog_for` = the cell, body the empty params slot `{"system": {}, "params": {}}`) beside the call, never instead of it; the cell answers with its row. `0` (the default) = the row comes from a push or an answer's header, nothing is asked.

notes.description: GH #1279: on `live_feed` -- the session and until notes new since the call's last seed or feed, `{source, id, text}`.

inner_turns.description: GH #1279: on `live_feed` -- the inner turns (advice, delegation, event) new since the call's last seed or feed, `{turn_id, kind}`.

topic.description: GH #1279: on `live_feed` -- the newest named topic, when it moved since the call's last seed or feed ("" once a topic ended).

screen_topics.description: GH #1279: on `live_feed` -- the screen's topic names, when the table moved since the call's last seed or feed.

section.description: GH #1400: on `live_feed` with `hop.section` `horizon` -- `horizon`; GH #1407: `fact` on a tool fact (`fact_from_tool`).

seconds.description: GH #1400: on `live_feed` `horizon` -- in how many seconds the answer of the running round is expected (rounded up).

way.description: GH #1400: on `live_feed` `horizon` -- the way of the turn's round (`quick`, `consult`, `research`).

family.description: GH #1400: on `live_feed` `horizon` -- the tool family (or way) the seconds were taken from.

params.description: GH #1450: on `catalog_ask` -- the empty params slot the model cell answers with its row.

interim.description: GH #1260: "1" on the bridge of a simple turn's tool round -- its sentence is interim, the round goes on with the tool result; "tool" on the required call of that round -- an answer of it without a call is not said, and the curator gives the round to the brain (`escalate`, reason `no_tool_call`). The composite's edge lifts it into `context.interim` for the dispatcher.

spec.description: GH #1275: "1" on a spec call of the quick voice (`quick_speculative`); the composite's edge lifts it into `context.spec`, and the answer comes back on `in_spec_llm`, never to the splitter.

section.description: GH #1279: on `live_feed` -- the param `live_feed_section` (`renew`), or `horizon` (GH #1400, `horizon_advise`), or `fact` (GH #1407, `fact_from_tool`); the composite's edge sets `hop.call_id` into `context.call_id`.

fact_source.description: GH #1407: on `live_feed` `fact` -- "tool": the fact is a listed tool's summary (`fact_from_tool`), the summary a string in body `payload` (left undeclared: the gap section passes on to `./push` with an object `payload`); the voice drops a later `fact` of the same `hop.turn_id`.

at_turn_end.description: GH #1279: on `live_feed` with `section` `renew` -- "1": the voice cell takes it at the next turn boundary only. Never on `horizon` (GH #1400): that turn has just ended.

call_id.description: GH #1279: on `live_feed` -- the duplex call the closed turn belongs to (its seam's `call_id`).

catalog_for.description: GH #1450: on `catalog_ask` -- the model cell asked for its catalogue row (`brain`, `quick`, `quick_spec`).

description.purpose: The window and the record of one model, by the policy of its role. On every call it builds the window deterministically from the ledger and the current plan (the slots, pins and tool stubs as the system part, sent only when a family changed; the wall after the plan's cover as the messages, each block in the form the plan gave it and, with short ids on, with its id in front), writes the call record and its block list, and sends the call. The tap fills the record and sets the clock; a cold cache or a crossed `compress_at` of the usable window starts a rebuild: the plan made anew from the role's segments and tiers, the model's releases and pins applied, a summary through `./summarizer` when a segment is to be condensed -- at most one at a time.
description.not_in_scope: No wall writes, no marks and no episodes. No model call on the hot path: the rebuild runs on a message of its own and the call that triggered it is already gone. Nothing a model releases disappears: the ledger keeps every block byte for byte, the window shows it as one line.
description.emits_meaning: lstore: ledger operations. brain: the call, leaving the hive. clock: one timer order per round, `add` with `rearm` under the round's own id (GH #904, GH #943); never a `remove`. summarize: the condensation request for `./summarizer`. push_ask, push_gap: the push's two doors (`in_recall_ask`, the section `gap`), handed on to `./push` with `recall_push`, `recall_budget` and `short_ids` on the hop, as the role resolved them. handover: the first call of a session this window did not serve last, handed to `./handover` once (`session_id`, `turn_id`, `curator_call`); it comes back as the store answer `handover-done`, and the window is read from here as for any call (GH #896).
description.consumes_meaning: The ledger's answers to its phases (win-hashes, win, relay, tap, rb-probe, rb-claim, rb-data, rb-send, sum, done, reg, dropped, handover-done, win-plan), the clock's strike (`in_cache_expired`, `in_clock_error`) and the summarizer's answer (`in_summary`), and the push's two doors on their way to `./push` (`in_recall_ask`, `in_section` with the section `gap`).
